target: 根据我的计算,你在这里转弯的概率是99.9%。 如果是这样,我必须拒绝。

target: 最近我一直有相当激烈的对话, 我的CPU仍在处理所有的数据。

target: 在这里,有这根棍子 我发现在地上。 网络上说,你用这种棍子可以做很多有趣的活动.

source: Some of them you would never expect... but I won't spoil it for you, my dear friend!
target: 有些你绝对想不到... 但我不会破坏它为你,亲爱的朋友!

source: You spend the night playing with the stick. Fun...?

target: 这是什么,朋友? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 你想一起度过美好时光吗?

source: My apologies, but I already have plans this evening.
target: 抱歉,我今晚已经有计划了

source: I am going to observe this cactus over a period of twelve hours and record its rate of growth in millimeters per minute!
target: 我要在12小时的时间里观察这个仙人掌 记录它的生长速度 以每分钟毫米计!

source: So... you'd rather watch plants grow than hang out with me?
target: 所以说... 你宁可看植物生长 也不愿和我在一起?

source: Precisely! Thank you so much for understanding. Farewell, my friend.
target: 没错! 非常感谢你的理解 再见,我的朋友。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Sorry, but I'm not in the mood to hang out tonight.
target: 顿 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 抱歉,但我今晚没心情出去玩

source: I had a long talk with %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% the other day... and now I've got all these... like... feelings 'n' shit?
target: 我和他聊了很久了 我和他谈了很久了 %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% 前几天... ... . . . . 现在我得到了所有这些... 喜欢... 感觉'N'狗屎?

source: I don't really know how to process it. I think I'm gonna go set a fire about it.
target: 我真的不知道怎么处理它。 我想我要去放个火吧。

source: Oh, okay... could I help you set the fire at least?
target: 哦,还好... 我能帮你点起火来吗?

source: Nah, sorry noob; this is a one-man fire kinda night. Maybe next time.
target: 不,对不起,诺布,今晚是一个人的火灾 也许下一次。

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. As you can see, tonight I'm setting stuff on fire.
target: 顿 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 如你所见 今晚我要放火烧东西了

source: Ah, great! I'd love to sit and chat and get to know more about your fiery passion for fire...
target: 啊,伟大的! 我很想坐下来聊天 了解更多你对火的激情...

source: NO. I didn't say tonight is a TALK night; I said tonight is a SET STUFF ON FIRE night. Don't you listen?
target: 没有。 我可没说今晚是谈话之夜 我说今晚是火线之夜 你不听吗?

source: But--!
target: 不过...

target: 在你能够表达任何事情之前,你意识到 达米恩 让你的裤子着了火

source: It seems tonight will be a PUT OUT THE FIRE ON YOUR PANTS night. Sigh.
target: 看来今晚会是火花放出你的裤子之夜 叹曰.

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! What's wrong? Is someone in trouble? Is there villainy afoot?!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 或? 有人有麻烦吗? 脚有坏人吗?

source: Nope, not that I know of. I just wanted to hang out with you.
target: 没有,据我所知没有。 我只是想和你约会

source: Oh... well, sorry, I can't. I have a feeling something bad's going to happen tonight. I need to be ready!
target: 哦... 对不起,我不能。 我有预感今晚会出事 我要准备好!

source: Really? But it's a calm, warm night, and there isn't even anyone else around...
target: 真的吗? 但这是一个平静,温暖的夜晚, 甚至没有其他人周围...

source: Yeah, but you know how it is: evil never sleeps, a hero's work is never done, constant vigilance, etc.
target: 是的,但你知道这是怎样的: 邪恶永远不会入睡, 英雄的工作永远不会完成, 不断的警惕等等。

source: Don't be sad. If there ever comes a day when I've finally defeated all the evil in the world, maybe I'll call you.
target: 别悲. 如果有一天我终于打败了世界上所有邪恶, 也许我会打电话给你。

source: You find Joy reading a book and listening to her headphones. You wait patiently for her to notice you.
target: 你发现Joy读了一本书 并听她的耳机。 你耐心地等她注意到你

source: Hmm, she doesn't seem to have noticed you yet. Only one thing to do: keep waiting!
target: 她似乎还没注意到你 只能做一件事: 继续等待!

source: I see you, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I was hoping to avoid this by politely ignoring you, but since you're relentless:
target: 我看见了 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我希望通过礼貌地忽略你来避免这种情况,但因为你无情地:

target: 她把耳机滑回 之前,你可以做出回应。 可恶...

target: 哦,哈啰 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 对不起,但我没心情聊天

target: 我知道每个人都有权有自己的见解,我们有言论自由......

source: Hey, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Sorry, but I'm not interested in talking tonight.
target: 顿 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 对不起,但我对今晚的谈话没兴趣

source: I just had a fascinating conversation with %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% the other night that really inspired me...
target: 我刚刚和他聊了一会 %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% 那天晚上,那真的启发了我...

target: 什么？！你是谁？你把波莉怎么了？！

source: Hey, I don't party ALL the time. I contain multitudes, y'know!
target: 嘿，我也不是一天到晚都在开趴好吧。我可是很多面的，懂？

source: I was actually gonna spend the night catching up on some reading. If you wanna be loud and reductionist, go do it somewhere else.
target: 我本来想今晚补补阅读。你要继续吵吵嚷嚷，还非把我看得这么扁平，就去别处闹。

target: 怎么样? %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%?

source: You wanna hang out? Eh, sorry, I'm too hungry to hang out tonight.

target: 哦... 我们可以一起吃点东西 也许奶昔 有两根吸管?

target: 不,我最好一个人去 我真的很想吃些生肉 无意冒犯 但我觉得你跟不上鹿的脚步

source: Wish me luck!
target: 祝我好运!

source: Dang... looks like you're having a milkshake-with-two-straws for one tonight. Truly the loneliest meal.
target: 可恶... 看来你今晚要喝两杯奶昔了 真正的最孤独的一餐。

source: Hey %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. What's on your mind?
target: 顿 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 你脑子里在想什么?

source: I'm glad you asked! I was hoping to talk about--
target: 我很高兴你问了! 我想谈谈...

source: Cause I'll tell you what's on MY mind: %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER%!
target: 因为我会告诉你我在想什么: %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER%!

target: 我们最近进行了一些冷静而激烈的谈话.

source: Actually, now that I think about it, you and I have also had some cool conversations lately...
target: 事实上,现在我想到这一点,你和我最近也进行了一些很酷的对话......

source: But I think my conversations with %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% are so much cooler that I forgot I also had some conversations with you.
target: 但我认为我的谈话 %PASSENGERLOVEPLAYER% 这么酷,我忘了我跟你谈过了

source: Isn't that funny?
target: 这不好笑吗?

target: 事实并非如此。 你离开是为了过夜来修补自尊心 这需要一些时间。

source: Sorry, shop's closed tonight.
target: 对不起,今晚商店关门了

source: That's okay, I'm not here to buy anything.
target: 没关系,我不是来买东西的

source: Oh... so you're just here to talk? Time is money! Specifically: five bucks.
target: 哦... 所以,你只是在这里说话? 时间就是钱! 具体为:五钱.

source: Sheesh, that's steep, but if that's what it takes...
target: 嘿,这是陡峭的, 但如果这是需要的...

source: Whoa, you actually paid me? Awesome!
target: 哇,你真的付我钱了? 厉害!

source: And then she leaves... with your five bucks. Goddammit.

source: It's so incredibly inefficient that it becomes simply beautiful.
target: 这太低效了 简直太美了

source: That's a nice thought.
target: 这想法不错。

source: And now that I don't even really need to eat, my hobby has reached new heights of stupidity -- and of beauty, too.
target: 现在我甚至不需要吃东西了, 我的爱好达到了愚蠢的新地步, 也达到了美丽的地步。

target: 我开始上烹饪课了!  维拉 把他们也带走。

target: 我觉得这对她很健康 即使大部分时间班级都让她紧张

source: We sit there, we learn, and we experiment. That's what I love about chemistry and cooking: it's transformative.
target: 我们坐在那里,我们学习, 我们做实验。 这就是我喜欢的化学和烹饪:它具有变革性.

source: But, like, literally! It's all about transformation. You transform things into other things. Like how you can transform eggs, flour, butter, and some other stuff into a cake.
target: 但是,像,从字面上说! 皆是转相. 你把事情变成其他事情。 比如你如何把鸡蛋,面粉,黄油, 以及其他的东西变成蛋糕。

source: Or how flesh, blood, bones, and some other stuff transformed into... me!
target: 或者血肉 骨骼和其他东西 是如何变成... 来啊!

source: So, yeah, I think the afterlife gives you some new cool perspectives. And I also think cooking rules.
target: 所以,是的,我认为 来生给你一些新的 很酷的视角。 我也认为烹饪规则。

source: Maybe one day I can cook something for you, if you dare!
target: 也许有一天我可以为你做点什么 如果你敢的话!

source: I'd love that.
target: 我很乐意

target: 做个鬼就是毒品!

source: Not only can you go through your afterlife with way less limitations, but it also makes you think.
target: 不仅你能通过你的来世 少得多的限制, 也让你思考。

source: Like... life? Afterlife? How does it even work?!
target: 喜欢... 生活吗? 后世吗? 怎么会这样?

source: Some people are born ghosts, and other people like me are dead ghosts...
target: 有些人是天生的鬼, 其他人像我是死鬼...

target: 我们肯定没有遵守 同样的规则 与物质生物... 但还是有规矩的

source: How that works is still a mystery to me.
target: 这对我来说仍然是个谜

source: Same here!
target: 也一样!

source: Like, some ghosts age, some don't, some do but at different paces... it's weird.
target: 有些是鬼时代,有些是鬼时代,有些是鬼时代,有些是鬼时代,有些是鬼时代,但速度不同... 这很奇怪。

source: And some ghosts definitely cease to be.
target: 有些鬼魂绝对不再存在了

source: But that's far from the end of it.
target: 但此相去相去甚远.

source: How so?
target: 怎么会这样?

source: We keep transforming and transitioning in very different ways, again and again.
target: 我们不断以非常不同的方式,一次又一次地转变和转变。

source: So who knows? Tomorrow I might not be here anymore.
target: 谁知道呢? 明天我可能不再在这里了。

target: 听着 你所能做的最好的事情是读理论,然后玩. 玩,玩,然后再玩一些。

target: 你需要锻炼你的"切斯肌肉",直到规律和概念从理性到直觉超越.

source: That's my trick, really: I've been playing chess with my mom since forever, and she happens to be a grandmaster.
target: 这就是我的把戏,真的:我从小就和我妈一起下棋,她恰好是个外婆.

source: She and I are so different! She's such a calm, collected woman. I love her.
target: 她和我都不一样了! 她是如此的冷静,收集的女人。 我爱她。

source: And with our personalities being written in completely different languages, chess has become our common denominator... our shared space.
target: 随着我们的个性被用完全不同的语言书写,国际象棋成为了我们的共同点...... 我们共享的空间。

source: We find each other in chess. I... I think we get to understand each other through chess.
target: 我们在下棋时互相发现对方. 我…… 我想我们可以通过下棋来了解对方。

source: I'll say!

target: 现在,我只寻求挑战 高额的比赛, 或者它会变得非常无聊 非常快。

target: 我开发了一个技巧,但是-- 对抗无聊,那就是说。 我为自己的作品创造故事和个性,然后我相应演奏.

target: 我的B1骑士暗恋我的F1主教. 我必须让骑士靠近它的爱人,并准备牺牲它来拯救主教.

target: 所以我把注意力集中在这些小故事上。 这样我就不会觉得无聊 否则太轻松的比赛。

target: 我最爱吃她的青酱意面了。那意面可厉害了，秘诀全在她的秘密酱汁里。是绿色的！

source: Eh... a true mystery, you could say.
target: 呃……那可真是个谜啊。

source: She's also super wise, bro.
target: 而且她特别有智慧，兄弟。

source: She has lots of super clever sayings and proverbs she shares with us.
target: 她总会跟我们说一些特别有道理的话和谚语。

source: Stuff like "Don't judge a book by its cover", or "Scott, stop putting those tennis balls in your mouth, they're not edible."
target: 比如“别以貌取人”，还有“斯科特，别再往嘴里塞网球了，那不能吃”。

source: Much wisdom!
target: 多有智慧啊！

source: She's the one who taught me that it's okay if I am not a very smart man, as long as I try to be a very good boy.
target: 是她教会我，不够聪明也没关系，只要努力当个好孩子就行。

source: She says smarts or bravery are flashy and all; but kindness is what really matters.
target: 她说，聪明啊、勇敢啊，确实很耀眼，但善良才是最重要的。

source: I always try to be a good boy, so grandma is proud of me!
target: 我一直努力当个好孩子，这样奶奶就会为我骄傲！

source: She most certainly is, Scott.
target: 她一定很骄傲，斯科特。

source: Thanks!
target: 谢谢!

source: You two sit in comfortable silence, looking at the stars.
target: 你们安静地坐在一起看星星，谁也没说话，却很自在。

source: His friends
target: 他的朋友们

source: My friends are the best!
target: 我的朋友们是最棒的!

source: I love cheering them on in all they do.
target: 我喜欢在他们所做的一切中给他们欢呼。

source: Like Damien getting better at arson...
target: 喜欢 达米恩 越来越擅长纵火...

source: Or Vera getting better at crimes...
target: 或者说 维拉 越来越擅长犯罪...

source: Or Liam getting better at irony....
target: 或者说 利亚姆 越来越有讽刺意味...

source: I mean, you know I love sports. So I can tell you: cheerleaders are one of the best things about them.
target: 我的意思是,你知道我爱运动。 所以我可以告诉你:拉拉队是他们最好的一环。

source: Think about it: there are people out there who do everything they can just to make sure your morale is high.
target: 想想看:外面有人尽了一切所能,只是为了确保你的士气很高.

source: It is pretty cool when you think of it that way.
target: 你这样想是很酷的

source: Yes! And it brings me so much happiness that a while ago I started wondering: why aren't there cheerleaders for EVERYTHING ELSE?
target: 没错! 这给我带来很多快乐,直到不久前,我开始想: 为什么没有啦啦队队员来参加其他一切呢?

source: So I decided to become the cheerleader of everything else for my friends!
target: 所以我决定成为我的朋友们的啦啦队队长!

source: If they can feel a similar joy to the one I feel during a sports game, that's the best, bro.
target: 如果他们能感受到与我在运动比赛中 所感受到的相似的欢乐 那才是最棒的,兄弟

source: That's very kind of you, Scott.
target: 你真好心,你喜欢吗? 斯科特.

source: Yeah... but sometimes I realize I'm cheering for things that aren't super nice. Like the stuff I just mentioned: arson, crimes, irony...
target: 对... 但有时我意识到 我为那些不好的东西欢呼 就像我刚才提到的那样:纵火,犯罪,讽刺...

source: So I decided to try to cheer for my friends when they're doing stuff that's nicer!
target: 所以我决定试着为我的朋友欢呼 当他们做的更好!

source: I cheer for Vera to win at eating salads, and for Damien with his makeup stuff, and for Liam becoming better at... you know... Liam stuff!
target: 我为你欢呼 维拉 在吃沙拉时获胜 达米恩 他的化妆品,和为 利亚姆 越来越... 你知道吗...  利亚姆 东西!

source: I hope that maybe that way, they focus on doing those nicer things instead of the not-so-nice ones?
target: 我希望也许这样, 他们专注于做那些更好的事情 而不是那些不好的事情?

source: Maybe!
target: 也许吧!

source: My grandma says that sometimes we focus so much on being the best that we forget to be better.
target: 我奶奶说,有时我们 专注于成为最好的, 我们忘记了更好。

source: I love that my friends are happy because they're becoming the best, but I'd love it even more if they felt happy about becoming better.
target: 我喜欢我的朋友们因为变得最好而快乐,但是如果他们对变得好起来感到快乐,我会更喜欢.

source: Does that make sense?
target: 这有道理吗?

source: It makes a lot of sense, yes.
target: 这很有道理,是的。

source: Yeah, I think so...
target: 是的,我想是这样的...

source: My friends may not know it, but secretly, I'm always cheering for them to be better...
target: 我的朋友也许不知道,但秘密地,我总是为他们欢呼,让他们变得更好...

source: You sit for a while, looking at the stars. Who'd have known Scott was so insightful?
target: 你坐了一会儿,看着星星。 谁知道呢 斯科特 这么有洞察力?

source: Scott Snacks!
target: 斯科特 ack!

source: Ah, yes, Scott Snacks!
target: 啊,对 斯科特 ack!

source: I went full wolf one night and I remember very little, but I know this much:
target: 有天晚上我全被狼咬了 我记起的很少 但我知道这么多:

source: I befriended some Japanese businessmen who turned me into a snack.
target: 我和一些日本商人结为朋友 他们把我变成小吃

source: They offered me a royalty to use my likeness.
target: 他们给了我一个皇室成员来利用我的长相

source: But since I have no idea what a royalty or a likeness is, I asked them for a lifetime supply of Scott Snacks instead.
target: 但既然我不知道什么是皇室 或类似的东西, 我问他们一生供应 斯科特 取而代之为吃.

source: And they said yes!
target: 他们答应了!

source: Oh, sweet.
target: 哦,亲爱的。

source: If you ask me, I think I won at "negotiation".
target: 如果你问我, 我想我赢了在"谈判"。

source: I feel a bit bad for that, so I still sometimes buy some Scott Snacks with my money too, so I can support them.
target: 我有点难过,所以我有时还是买一些 斯科特 用我的钱也吃一顿,这样我就能支持他们了.

source: They're my bros after all!
target: 他们毕竟是我的兄弟!

source: You know, for a time, I thought that the whole thing was like a rite of passage.
target: 你知道,有一段时间,我以为 整件事就像一个仪式 通过。

source: Like, everyone eventually goes from boy, to snack, and eventually man.
target: 就像,每个人都最终从男孩,到小吃, 最后是男人。

source: It turns out this is not true...
target: 原来这不是真的...

source: Yeah... that checks out.
target: 对... 检查出来。

source: ...But I still came up with what the snacks some of my friends would be!
target: ...但我还是想出什么小吃 我的朋友会是什么!

source: Wanna hear some of them?
target: 想听听他们吗?

source: Yes please!
target: 是的,请!

source: Miranda Snacks: they are made of fancy stuff like caviar and truffles.
target: 米兰达 小吃:由鱼子酱和松露等花花样而成.

source: They are... a privilege to eat.
target: 他们是... 吃东西的特权。

source: Vera Snacks: coffee-flavored buns filled with snake poison.
target: 维拉 口香糖:咖啡口味的包子被蛇毒填满.

source: A strong outside... and an even stronger inside!
target: 一个强壮的外表... 里面更坚固!

source: Polly Snacks: they're one of Polly's favorite snacks, that flour-looking stuff she calls "nose candy".
target: 波莉 ack:是也. 波莉她最喜欢的点心, 面粉外观的东西,她称之为"糖"。

source: So good, it's downright addictive!
target: 好极了,很会上瘾!

source: What do you think?
target: 你觉得呢?

source: These are very good and on point!
target: 这些是非常好的和点的!

source: Liam helped me come up with the funny slogans. He's very clever!
target: 利亚姆 帮我想出有趣的口号 他非常聪明!

source: One day, you and I could brainstorm what %CURRENTPLAYERNAME% snacks might be. What do you think?
target: 有一天,你和我可以集思广益 什么%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%小吃可能是。 你觉得呢?

source: I'd love that, honestly.
target: 我很乐意,说实话。

source: Hooray!
target: 万岁!

source: You sit around a bit more, in silence, stargazing. You think to yourself that, in the end, Scott definitely managed to go from boy to snacc.
target: 静静地坐着 凝视着 你自以为是,最后, 斯科特 绝对能从男孩到斯纳克

source: His sports team
target: 他的体育队

source: I love my team!
target: 我爱我的团队!

source: Life is so much easier when you know you've got a group of bros that will always have your back.
target: 当你知道自己有一群兄弟时 生活就容易多了 永远会支持你

source: I think it's nice because we all grow together through constant teamwork.
target: 我觉得这很好,因为我们通过不断的团队合作 一起成长。

source: And when we teamwork too much and get exhausted, we can also teamleisure!
target: 而当我们团队合作过多,变得精疲力竭时,我们也可以团队合作!

source: Teamleisure?
target: 队友们?

source: Yeah! You know, doing all the fun things you can do together as a team out of the field!
target: 对! 你知道,做所有有趣的事情 你可以一起做作为一个团队 出外勤!

source: That sounds funny. For a moment, I thought it was code for sex.
target: 这听起来很有趣。 有一瞬间,我还以为是"性"的代码.

source: Oh, there's also sex sometimes, sure!
target: 哦,有时候还有性,当然!

source: ...What?
target: 什麽?

source: Yeah, sex is fun! And good exercise!
target: 是啊,性是乐趣! 和良好的运动!

source: So... it's like... team orgies?
target: 所以说... 这就像... 组队狂欢?

source: Nah, bro, not the whole team! But sometimes two or more teammates get really intimate, and sports are very physical, so... sometimes sex happens!
target: 不,兄弟,不是整个团队! 但有时两个或两个以上的队友会变得非常亲密,运动也非常有体能,所以. 有时性会发生!

source: Dang, but doesn't that make things complicated?
target: 糟了,但事情不复杂吗?

source: No way, bro!
target: 不会吧,兄弟!

source: You just need to be... how they say? More "emotionally responsible"!
target: 你只需要是... ... . . . . 他们怎么说? 更"情感责任"!.

source: You know... communicate, care about the other people involved, and focus on having a fun time together!
target: 你知道吗... 沟通,关心其他参与的人, 并专注于有一个有趣的时间在一起!

source: That's actually... so wise, Scott.
target: 这其实... 这么聪明, 斯科特.

source: Aw, thanks, bro!
target: 哦,谢谢,兄弟!

source: You keep talking about sports for the rest of the night. You end up strongly considering joining the team.
target: 你整晚都在谈论体育 最后你强烈地考虑加入球队。

source: His love for chasing cars
target: 他喜欢追车

source: Ooh, I love chasing cars, bro!
target: 哦,我喜欢追车,兄弟!

source: Those cars are fast, but Scott can be faster.
target: 这些车很快,但是... 斯科特 可以更快一点。

source: I mean... admittedly, I'm not faster than a car YET...
target: 我是说... 诚然,我不快于一辆车YET...

source: But I'm sure that with enough practice, I'll get there!
target: 但我相信,只要有足够的练习, 我会到达那里!

source: I believe in you!
target: 我对你有信心!

source: I've chased cars since forever. I used to do it all the time with my cousins!
target: 从此我一直在追车 我经常和表妹们一起干!

source: We had rules for it and everything.
target: 我们有规则,它和一切。

source: Such as...?
target: 比如说... ?

source: The color of the car you chased would grant you a different score, for instance!
target: 你追的车的颜色会给你一个不同的分数 比如说!

source: It made sense, since everyone knows orange cars are very fast, while yellow ones not so much!
target: 大家都知道橙色的车开得很快 而黄色的车却没那么快!

source: Have you seen those? Most yellow cars tend to be very big and carry tons of little people. That slows them down!
target: 你看过吗? 大多数黄色的汽车往往非常大,并携带了数以吨计的小人. 让他们慢下来!

source: Yellow... big... filled with little people... do you mean...?
target: 黄... ... 充满了小人... 你是说... ?

source: Chasing a car with a funny license plate could give you special bonus points too!
target: 用滑稽的车牌追车也能给你特别的奖金分!

source: We had such a great time chasing cars together...
target: 我们一起追车很愉快...

source: My cousins can be fun and nice when they forget to be... not nice.
target: 我的表弟们会很好玩的 当他们忘记了... 一点都不好。

source: We used to say that we should look into car companies to find a sponsor, so we could turn car chasing into an official sport!
target: 我们曾经说过,我们应该调查汽车公司 找到赞助商, 这样我们就可以把汽车追逐变成正式的运动!

source: Who would've thought I'd end up on a road trip... in a car, no less!
target: 谁会想到我会在路上旅行... 在车里,不减!

source: Life can be really strange that way, huh?
target: 生活会很怪异的,是吧?

source: Totally!
target: 绝对!

source: One day you're spending most of your life chasing cars, the next day you're inside a car... chasing life.
target: 有一天你一生中的大部分时间都在追车 第二天你进了一辆汽车... 追逐着生活

source: I guess this is what Coach calls "growing up".
target: 我猜这就是教练所说的"成长"

source: Haha... maybe...
His time in the Coven
target: 他的时代在巫师会

source: Ah, yes. I was indeed part of the Coven, once.
target: 啊,对了。 我的确曾经是巫师的一部分

source: Who'd have guessed that I, disruptive Liam de Lioncourt, would fall into the obvious trope of being the paranormal sidekick to a group of magical heroines!
target: 谁会猜到 我,破坏 利亚姆 Lioncourt 会落入一群神奇女主角的迷宫 这很显然 是的

source: But I suppose it was only fair that I joined.
target: 但我认为我加入才公平

source: How so?
target: 怎么会这样?

source: You see, before I was in the Coven, I commanded the armies of the Dark Side. I was bound to bringing reality to its end. Long story.
target: 你看,在我进入巫统之前,我指挥了黑暗一带的军队. 我注定要把现实变成现实 说来话长

source: Yikes...
target: 哎哟...

source: Yes. It was... not cool.
target: 对 这是... 一点都不酷。

source: We all make mistakes. Some of us yell something cruel at a friend in a moment of stress, and some of us lead evil armies.
target: 我们都犯了错误。 我们有些人在压力下对朋友大喊残酷的话,有些人领导邪恶的军队.

source: So, where do you go from there?
target: 那么,你从哪里去呢?

source: You can apologize, of course. You can also learn from it. And you should do both.
target: 你可以道歉,当然。 也可以从中学习. 你应该做两个。

source: But since you can't undo the wrongs you did... the next best thing you can do is be better and do better.
target: 但既然你无法纠正你所犯的错误... 接下来你能做的最好的事情是更好,做得更好。

source: And that's why I decided to offer my centuries of knowledge and power to the Coven.
target: 这就是为什么我决定向巫师提供我数百年的知识和力量。

source: What was being in the Coven like?
target: 什么是在巫师像什么?

source: It was incredibly clichéd. Like, do they even realize half the villains they fight are obvious metaphors for the challenges of growing up and becoming an adult?
target: 这太陈词滥调了 就像,他们甚至意识到 他们战斗的一半的坏人 是明显的比喻 挑战 长大和成为一个成年人?

source: But I'll admit, it was also fulfilling. You gotta respect those witches. They can be insufferable, but they would do ANYTHING to protect both humankind and monsterkind.
target: 但我会承认,它也是满足的。 你要尊重那些巫师 它们可能难以忍受,但它们会做任何事情来保护人类和怪物。

source: They are sort of great, yes.
target: 他们挺不错的,是的

source: We saved the world countless times, until it sort of stopped working for us and I left the Coven. It is what it is, you know?
target: 我们拯救了世界无数次, 直到它停止为我们工作,我离开了巫师。 这就是它是什么,你知道吗?

source: I needed to focus on new things. I love exploring all that afterlife has to offer. I've been an artist, a sailor, an alchemist, a dark lord... and also a hero.
target: 我需要专注于新事物。 我喜欢探索所有 来生必须提供的东西。 我曾经是艺术家,水手,炼金术家,黑暗的领主... 同时也是一个英雄。

source: And yet, even that had to come to an end. I think it's okay.
target: 然而,即便如此,也不得不结束。 我觉得这没关系。

source: Now I just have to remember that, no matter what form I take or what I experience next, I must focus on being better.
target: 现在我必须记住,不管我采取何种形式,也不管我接下来的经历如何,我必须专注于更好。

source: You know what, Liam? That's probably what matters now.
target: 你知道吗, 利亚姆? 这也许是现在的要紧。

source: Yes... I think so too.
target: 对... 我也这么认为。

source: You two sit there in silence, looking at the stars, reflecting.
target: 你们两个静静地坐在那里, 看着星星,反射。

source: His time in the Dark Side
target: 他在黑暗之地的时光

source: Ugh... yes...
I often refrain from talking about my Dark Lord phase.
target: 我经常不谈论我的黑暗之王阶段。

source: Oh, don't worry about it then, I didn't mean to overstep...
target: 哦,别担心,那么,我不是故意越位的...

source: No, it's okay. I suppose it is useful to talk about it if it can stop other people from making the same mistakes.
target: 不,没关系。 我认为,如果能够阻止其他人犯同样的错误,谈论这个问题是有用的。

source: You see, I wasn't born a vampire; I was dead a vampire. So, I was a human once. And when that's the case, afterlife can be dangerous.
target: 你看,我不是生来就是吸血鬼 我死了就是吸血鬼 所以,我曾经是人类。 如果是这样的话 来生会很危险的

source: Someone gifted me my vampirism to save me from dying young. They wanted me to experience life, and so I promised to do so.
target: 有人送我吸血鬼的礼物 来拯救我不再年轻地死去 他们想让我体验生活, 所以我答应这样做。

source: I travelled the world and did countless things, from joining a travelling theater company to working on a fishing boat for years in the unwelcoming North.
target: 我环游世界,做了无数的事情, 从加入旅行的剧院公司, 到在不愉快的北方的渔船上工作多年。

source: I suppose I never stay too long in the same place doing the same thing.
target: 我想我从没在同一个地方待太久 做同样的事情

source: But that's where the curse of vampirism lies, hidden in the dark. After centuries, without realizing it, you've been sucking life dry.
target: 但是,吸血鬼的诅咒就在这里,隐藏在黑暗中. 几个世纪后,没有意识到这一点, 你一直在吸活口干.

source: And so, when you have time to do EVERYTHING... you risk falling into a voracious apathy; a cruel numbness.
target: 所以,当你有时间做一切... 你冒着陷入一种贪婪的冷漠 一种残酷的麻木

source: Oof, that sounds rough.
target: 哦,这听起来很粗糙。

source: Yes, you can hit a very dark place when life becomes nothing but a word you've repeated for so long it's lost its meaning.
target: 是的,你可以打一个非常黑暗的地方 当生命变成什么,但一个你重复了这么久的词 它失去了它的意义。

source: I embraced entropy as another thing to learn; evil as a new aspect of life to explore.
target: 我接受 en是学习的又一东西 邪恶是生命探索的一个新方面

source: I became one of the high commanders of the Dark Side. I made covenants with powerful, ancient entities for whom eternity is a natural state of being.
target: 我成为了黑暗一方的高级指挥官之一。 我和强大的古代实体签订了盟约 对于他们来说,永恒是自然存在的状态

source: It was horrible, and I did terrible things. The only upside was how outrageously sexy I looked, from an objective point of view.
target: 这太可怕了,我做了可怕的事情。 唯一的好处是我看起来多么性感 从客观角度来说

source: I owe Joy and the Coven everything and then some for pulling me out of that dark place.
target: 我欠乔伊和巫师的一切,然后一些 把我拉出那个黑暗的地方。

source: But some nights, I still wake up in a cold sweat, afraid that I'm not safe, and that I could fall into that dark place again someday.
target: 但有些夜晚,我仍然在寒冷的出汗中醒来,害怕自己不安全,有一天我可能再次掉入黑暗之地.

source: Dang, I'm sorry to hear that...

target: 你凝视着星星 温暖地静默地注视着夜幕

source: Her life of crime
target: 她的罪恶生活

source: My criminal empire? Heh...
target: 我的罪恶帝国? 哦...

source: Actually, I'm considering leaving most of my life of crime behind.
target: 事实上,我正在考虑 离开我大部分的 犯罪生活后。

source: Why is that?
target: 为什么?

source: Eh... people grow, I guess. Also my dad gets a bit too worried sometimes.
target: 额... 我想,人们会成长的。 我爸有时也有点担心

source: And you know what? As cynical as it may sound, there are perfectly legal (and still nasty) ways of making just as much money... so why even risk it?
target: 你知道吗? 虽然这听起来很愤世嫉俗, 为什么要冒这个险?

source: When you put it like that, I guess it makes sense.
target: 当你这么说的时候,我猜这很合理。

source: Yeah... although... ugh... maybe I can still commit a crime every now and then? The thrill is something I don't want to lose.
target: 对... 虽然. 额... 或许我偶尔还是能犯罪? 刺激是我不想失去的东西。

source: We'll see.
target: 我们等着瞧吧。

source: Maybe it's time for me to grow from my days of being a crime queen...
target: 也许我该从犯罪后的日子里长大了...

source: ...or maybe I'm telling you all this just to spread rumors that I've gone legal, so people stop snooping in my affairs...
target: ...或者也许我告诉你这一切 只是散布谣言说我已经合法了, 所以人们停止窥探我的事务...

source: ...who knows?
target: ...谁知道呢?

source: Well, the former sounds better... or safer at least.
target: 前者听起来更好... 或至少比较安全。

source: Tch, you sound just like my dad.
target: 恰克,你听起来就像我爸爸

source: I mean, you've been almost caught more than once...
target: 我的意思是,你几乎 被抓不止一次...

source: ALMOST being the operative word there.
target: 几乎是 执行字在那里。

source: Hey, whatever floats your boat, Vera.
target: 嘿,无论什么浮出你的船, 维拉.

source: It's just that... y'know... I like you, and I'd prefer you stay out of jail.
target: 只不过... 你知道吗... 我喜欢你,我更希望你远离监狱。

source: Ha! Okay, okay, don't worry. I'll do my best to be a good girl; you can rest easy.
target: 好吧,好吧,不用担心。 我会尽力做一个好女孩,你可以轻松休息.

source: Cool!
target: 凉爽!

source: ...Thanks for caring. That's nice.
target: 谢谢你的关心 这是很好的。

source: Of course!
target: 当然了!

source: You spend the evening talking about the many ways Vera could build an empire without the need to poison or stab anyone.
target: 你整晚都在谈论很多方法 维拉 可以建立一个不需要毒害或刺杀任何人的帝国。

source: Her snakes
target: 她的毒蛇们

source: Ugh, the snakes, yes. It can get messy.
target: 唉,蛇,对。 它会变得混乱。

source: Styling your hair this spectacularly is hard enough... imagine if your hair also happens to be a literal nest of venomous snakes.
target: 你头发的外形 这么壮观已经够硬了... 想象一下,如果你的头发也恰好是 毒蛇的活窝。

source: I can imagine it's rough.
target: 我可以想象它很粗糙。

source: No, you can't imagine, believe me.
target: 不,你无法想象,相信我。

source: You've gotta take care of them 24/7 if you want to go about your day without your hairdo rebelling against you.
target: 你要全天候照顾他们 如果你想在不叛逆你的情况下过日子

source: I mean... it's me, the last woman on Earth who'd want to have a pet... and I got not one, but a couple dozen "pets".
target: 我是说... 是我,地球上最后一个想养宠物的女人... 我没有,只有一打"猫"。

source: Fan-fucking-tastic.
target: 风扇,他妈的。

source: No, really: a brilliant turn of events. 10 out of 10 on life's twisted sense of humor.
target: 不,真的: 一个辉煌的转折。 人生的幽默感扭曲了 10分之10

source: I'm sure there are some upsides, no?
target: 我敢肯定,有一些颠倒,不是吗?

source: Hmmm... free poison.
target: 那个... 免费毒药。

source: And I guess a childhood of keeping dozens of snakes on a leash helped me become a fearless leader.
target: 我猜童年把几十条蛇绑在绳子上 让我成为了无所畏惧的领袖

source: So, yes: I got a lot of great (and deeply annoying) practice.
target: 所以,是的:我有很多伟大的(和很烦人的)练习。

source: And... how do you... you know...?
target: 还有... 或... 你知道吗?

source: Look, I know the twenty-or-so questions you have in mind.
target: 听着,我知道你想问的20个问题

source: To put it simply: half of that stuff is just fucked-up monster logic. I try not to think too much about it.
target: 简单说吧,一半的东西只是怪兽的逻辑 我尽量不要想太多

source: The other half? That's private.
target: 另一半吗? 这是私人的。

source: Okay! Sorry for overstepping.
target: 好,我们走! 对不起 越位了

source: Don't sweat it.
target: 不发汗.

source: You know what, Vera? Despite all the bad stuff you mention, I still find your snakes cute.
target: 你知道吗, 维拉? 尽管你提到了很多坏事 我还是觉得你的蛇很可爱

source: And they seem to like you very much!
target: 他们似乎非常喜欢你!

source: I guess. I mean... they're sort of okay.
target: 我猜是这样吧 我是说... 他们有点好。

source: (And it's kinda nice that -- in a way -- I never have to feel completely alone.)
target: (和它有点好 -- 从某种意义上来说, 我从来没有感到 完全孤独。)

source: (But if you tell anyone I said that, I'll murder you.)
target: (但如果你告诉任何人,我说, 我会杀了你。 )

source: (Noted.)
Eventually, Vera lets you pet some of her snakes, and she even tells you some of their names. And you get ALMOST no snake bites!
target: 最终 维拉 让你宠弄她的一些蛇, 她甚至告诉你一些他们的名字。 你得到的几乎没有蛇咬!

source: Her many goals
target: 她的很多目标

source: Ugh, stress is my default state.
target: 呃,压力是我的默认状态。

source: How so?
target: 怎么会这样?

source: Too many balls to juggle all at once.
target: 太多的球,不能同时拼了。

source: But it's more than that, I think.
target: 但它不止于此,我想。

source: I've always had this thought that we're hyper-conditioned by the metaphor we use to describe life. I know it sounds corny, and yet...
target: 我一直认为我们被我们用来描述生命的比喻 所超标。 我知道这听起来很老套,然而...

source: What do you mean?
target: 你说什么?

source: Take Polly: for her, life is like an endless feast, right? For me, life is more like a constant battle against everything and everyone.
target: 拿着 波莉对于她来说,生活就像一场无尽的盛宴,对吗? 对我来说,生活更像是对一切和每个人的不断战斗.

source: It's all the little things... like a delay in the train that makes you late to a job interview...
target: 这是所有的小事... 就像在火车上拖延时间 让你迟到面试...

source: I get what you mean... that's the worst.
target: 我听懂你的意思了... I get what you mean... 这是最糟糕的。

source: Exactly; and when that happens, I tend to see the inanimate thing as someone trying to fuck with me.
target: 没错,一旦发生这种情况,我往往会把无生命的东西看成有人想耍我。

source: Like pens!
target: 像钢笔一样!

source: Pens?
target: 笔?

source: Yes. I'm left-handed, and when you're left-handed, chances are you constantly smear ink with your hand when you're writing.
target: 对 我是左撇子,当你是左撇子时, 你写作时经常用手涂墨水的机会。

source: I took this as a silent declaration of war by pens, as if they were laughing at me in their tiny plastic bodies.
target: 我把这当做是笔下的无声宣战,仿佛他们在他们小小的塑料身体中取笑我.

source: I grew tired of it. I am Vera Oberlin, and I won't be defeated by a dumb pen, or anything for that matter.
target: 我厌倦了它。 没错 维拉 欧伯林,我也不会被 笨笔所打倒,或任何事情。

source: So... you switched to using pencils?
target: 所以说... 你换了铅笔?

source: No, that would've been like admitting defeat. I just taught myself to write upside-down.
target: 不,那会像承认失败。 我只是教自己倒着写

source: That way I could write right-to-left and avoid getting my hand inked.
target: 这样我就能从右到左写字 避免手被抽出

source: I know it sounds stupid, but truthfully, it gave me such a delicious feeling.
target: 我知道这听起来很愚蠢, 但说实话,它给了我如此美味的感觉。

source: All these little things seem to be laughing at me and reminding me that life can be a bitch...
target: 所有这些小事似乎都在取笑我 提醒我生活可以是一个婊子...

source: So I just remind them I am a BAD BITCH.
target: 所以我提醒他们我是个坏婊子

source: Yeah... fuck pens!
target: 对... 他妈的笔!

source: Ha! Yes. So when a pen inks my hand, a delayed train fucks up my schedule, or a person hurts me... I know it's all part of this never-ending battle.
target: 对 所以,当笔刺入我的手, 延迟的火车搞砸了我的日程, 或者一个人伤害我... 我知道这都是这场永无止境的战斗的一部分

source: That's how you conquer life: you keep it in a tight chokehold, and if it suckerpunches you, you stand up and put up a fight.
target: 这就是你征服生命的方法: 把它保持在紧紧的窒息状态中, 如果它使你崩溃, 你站起来并进行战斗。

source: I love being this resilient and ready to fight... but lately I have started wondering when it's too much.
target: 我喜欢这样有韧性 并准备战斗... 但最近我开始想 什么时候太过分了

source: It does sound stressful...
target: 听起来很紧张...

source: It is. I feel so exhausted by this war I wage all the time...
target: 没错 这场战争让我很疲惫

source: I think I could use a truce, and yet... I've spent so much time fighting that I think...
target: 我想我需要休战,然而... 我花了这么多时间打架 我想...

source: ...I never learned how to cease fire.
target: 我从来没有学会如何停火。

source: It sounds silly, doesn't it?
target: 这听起来很傻,不是吗?

source: You hug her for a long time; enough for her to understand that you'd never think her problems are silly...
target: 你拥抱她很长一段时间,足以让她明白你绝不会认为她的问题很愚蠢......

source: Enough to convey that everything will be alright.
target: 足以传达一切会好起来的

source: Her sister, Bellanda
target: 她的妹妹,贝兰达

source: Bellanda?
target: 贝兰达?

source: Gosh, Bellanda is so admirable.
target: 天哪,贝兰达真令人钦佩

source: She's always waging wars here and there to expand the Merkingdom.
target: 她总是在这里和那里发动战争来扩张默金多姆.

source: One would think those other kingdoms would be happy to forfeit their power and become annexed to the Merkingdom...
target: 人们会认为那些其他的王国会乐于放弃他们的权力,并被并吞于默金多姆. .

source: ...but you'd be surprised how many of them actually resist this marvelous opportunity!
target: 但你会惊讶他们中有多少人 居然拒绝这个绝妙的机会!

source: Their reason for doing so truly escapes my understanding...
target: 他们这样做的理由 真正逃避了我的理解...

source: It's a real mystery, huh?
target: 这是一个真正的谜,是吧?

source: Yes!
target: 没错!

source: But then Bellanda comes in, and with her charm and vast armies, it's hard to say no to her.
target: 但后来贝兰达进来了,带着她的魅力和庞大的军队,很难对她说不.

source: She sounds fierce!
target: 她听起来很凶猛!

source: I think she and I are the closest of all my sisters.
target: 我想她和我是我所有姐妹中最亲近的

source: We used to play games around the palace, sneaking around and such. We even used to spar together: cleaver against spear.
target: 我们经常在宫殿周围玩游戏,偷偷摸摸地摸摸等. 我们甚至曾经一起打: 刀与长矛相对.

source: I defended myself better than you might imagine, heehee!
target: 我为自己辩护的比你想象的要好,嘿嘿!

source: Maybe one day I could show you my spear skills.
target: 也许有一天我可以让你看看我的长矛技能

source: I'd love that.
target: 我很乐意

source: Her sister, Amanda
target: 她的妹妹阿曼达

source: Amanda?
target: 阿曼达?

source: Everyone loves Amanda.
target: 每个人都爱阿曼达。

source: She doesn't talk much, and that's part of the magic.
target: 她不怎么说话,这是魔法的一部分。

source: Like... she chooses carefully when to say something, and so you keep talking to fill the space, and before you realize you're giving away relevant information, and such.
target: 喜欢... 她仔细地选择何时说话, 所以你不停地说话 填补空间, 在你意识到你 给出相关信息之前, 之类的。

source: It's incredible. I've seen her disarm lots of people just by standing there, silently smiling.
target: 不可思议. 我看见她只靠站着 默默地微笑着 解除很多人的武装

source: She's the highest priestess in the Merkingdom, and it suits her. Everyone is already devoted to her, anyway.
target: 她是美金敦最高的女祭司,这很适合她. 不管怎么说,每个人都已经投身于她了

source: I... I wish I knew what she thinks of me. But that's a mystery, as so many things about her are.
target: 我…… 我希望我知道她对我的看法 但这是个谜, 就像很多关于她的事情一样。

source: Gosh, I'm oversharing a bit, aren't I?
target: 天啊,我太过份了,不是吗?

source: You were just sitting there, and I started blabbering, and then...
target: 你只是坐在那里, 我开始胡说八道,然后...

source: Wait... you're pulling an "Amanda" on me, aren't you?
target: 单单... 你在对我说"阿曼达",是吗?

source: Haha... maybe.
target: ... 也许吧。

source: Heehee... but see? You just sit there, and look me in the eye so intensely...
target: 熙熙,你好吗? Heehee... 看到了吗? 你只是坐在那里, 看着我这么强烈的眼睛...

source: ...and it's almost like you cast a spell on me!
target: ...就像你对我施了咒语!

source: You look at her in the eyes. You both smile gently, and then spend some time in silence together, looking at the stars.
target: 你看着她的眼睛。 你们俩轻轻地微笑 然后一起静静地看着星星

source: Her sister, Laudanda
target: 她的妹妹,劳丹达

source: Laudanda?
target: 劳丹达?

source: Laudanda is a bit scary.
target: 洛丹达有点吓人

source: Really?
target: 真的吗?

source: Yes. She's the oldest, and I'm the youngest. There's a big age gap there!
target: 对 她是最年长的, 而我是最年轻的。 那儿的年纪差距很大!

source: She's always in meetings, making negotiations and alliances...
target: 她总是在开会, 进行谈判和结盟...

source: There's no corner in the Merkingdom that's not at least indirectly under her control.
target: 在默金多姆没有角落 至少不间接在她控制下。

source: She can really get in your head, Laudanda.
target: 她真的可以打入你的脑海 劳丹达

source: Spooky!
target: 斯宝克! 斯宝克!

source: She often says, "Why use an army when you can accomplish the same with a well-chosen threat or compliment?"
target: 她经常说:"如果用精心选择的威胁或赞美来完成同样的任务,为什么要使用军队?"

source: I've seen it work! She's subjugated whole nations under the Merkingdom's control with just a couple words!
target: 我见过它的工作! 她在默金多姆的控制下征服了整个国家,只说了几句话!

source: Heh... she sounds like a lot.
target: 哦... 她听起来像很多。

source: And her plans! She's got plans within plans within plans. A child dies, the price of silk goes up, a rumor of a beast spreads... it's all connected somehow.
target: 还有她的计划! 她计划内有计划 一个孩子死了,丝绸的价格上升, 谣传一头野兽蔓延... 不知何故,这都是相连的。

source: Like... I love talking to you now, out here. But a tiny part of me wonders if this conversation isn't just one of the hundred steps of one of Laudanda's plans?
target: 喜欢... 现在,我爱和你说话,在这里。 但我有一点好奇 这段对话是不是 劳丹达计划中的百步之一?

source: MAYBE!
target: 也许吧!

source: Haha... I know, it's silly. I know.
target: ... 我知道,这是愚蠢的。 我知道,我记得 I know.

source: (I know...)
target: (我晓得. )

source: She stares at the stars in silence, with some concern in her eyes. You hold her hand, sitting there together until she seems a bit more relaxed.
target: 她默默地凝视着星星,在她眼中有些顾虑. 你握住她的手,坐在那里 直到她看起来更加放松。

source: The treacherous airpeople
target: 背信弃义的飞行员

source: The airpeople? They're the worst!
target: 飞行员? 他们是最糟糕的!

source: I've been doing some of my own research on those treacherous feathered creatures...
target: 我一直在做一些我自己的研究 这些狡猾的羽毛生物...

source: People are always telling me I am... how do you say... oblivious?
target: 人们总是说,我... 你怎么说... 忘了吗?

source: So I wanted to be a bit less oblivious for once. Hence the research!
target: 所以我想少一点 忘记一次。 因此,我们的研究!

source: Good idea. Prove people wrong!
target: 不错的主意。 证明别人错了!

source: Exactly! And this may shock you, but it turns out a lot of the things we say about the airpeople are factually... not true?
target: 没错! 这可能会令你震惊,但事实证明,我们所说的很多关于空中人的事情其实是... 不是真的吗?

source: Did you know the airpeople have no democracy at all?
target: 你知道空中人根本没有民主吗?

source: And most of them do NOT wear socks and sandals!
target: 他们大多不穿袜子和凉鞋!

source: Shocking.
target: 吓一跳。

source: Don't get any funny ideas, though. They're nonetheless a hideous force of evil that we must purge.
target: 不过别有什么好笑的想法 但他们是邪恶的可怕力量 我们必须清除。

source: But you can imagine how confused I was when I heard all the facts I knew about the airpeople turned out to be false!
target: 但你可以想象当我听到我所知道的所有关于空中人的事实时,我是多么的困惑!

source: I asked my sisters about it. They said the problem is that the ways in which the airpeople are terrible and dangerous are very nuanced and complex.
target: 我问我的姐妹们。 他们说,问题在于,空中居民的可怕和危险方式非常细微而复杂。

source: So apparently they used a technique to simplify the core of the matter: that the airpeople are the very worst.
target: 很明显,他们用一种技术来简化事情的核心: 空中人是最糟糕的。

source: It's a clever technique called "propaganda".
target: 这是一种叫作"宣传"的巧妙技术.

source: I see.
target: 原来如此

source: Otherwise, our subjects might get caught up in these nuances and end up thinking the airpeople are even... good!
target: 否则,我们的臣民可能会陷入这些细微的微妙之处,最终会认为空中人甚至... 好样的!

source: God forbid!
target: 上帝不许!

source: Some lesser kingdoms see the airpeople as benevolent, since the airpeople are excellent at "propaganda" too.
target: 一些更小的王国视空民为仁爱之人,因为空民也擅长"宣传".

source: The difference is their propaganda is bad, and our "propaganda" is good. This is a crucial fact!
target: 区别在于他们的宣传是不好的,我们的"宣传"是好的. 这是一个关键的事实!

source: But because I appreciate you and I think you're smart enough for "nuance", I preferred to be sincere with you about my findings.
target: 但是,因为我很感激你,我觉得你足够聪明,可以"细微",所以我更愿意诚心地与你谈谈我的发现.

source: Aww, thanks!
target: 啊,谢谢!

source: I trust you can understand nuance and remember the core of the matter: they're BAD.
target: 我相信你能理解细微的细微,并记住事情的核心:它们是BAD.

source: Sure, I'm taking notes.
target: 当然,我在做笔记。

source: Excellent! I knew I could trust you.
target: 不错! 我就知道我可以信任你 说不定我也会信任你

source: And so, you spend the rest of the night plotting the demise of the airpeople.
target: 所以,你用剩下的时间 策划空民的消亡。

source: Her Fandoms
target: 她的幻觉

source: I'm in a ton of fandoms!
target: 我在一吨的狂热!

source: It'd be so hard to choose just one favorite.
target: 很难选择一个最爱的

source: There's Dragon Heat, Human Prom, Garfield...
target: 有"龙热","人类舞会","加菲尔德"......

source: It's beautiful when you think about it... all these people communing over a work of fiction that had such a meaningful impact in them.
target: 当你想到它时,它很美丽... 所有这些人 共通 在一个虚构的作品 对他们有如此有意义的影响。

source: You want to submerge in it, you know? Dive deep and consume EVERYTHING.
target: 你想沉入其中,你知道吗? 潜入深处并消耗一切

source: That sounds intense.
target: 这听起来很激烈。
