target: 对... 所以,我们的学校是仿照 人类纪录片 他们的教育制度... 有"被钟所救"之称.

source: It depicts humans in their twenties attending high school. So we figured out high school is something you do at that age.
target: 它描绘了20多岁上高中的人类. 所以我们知道高中是你那个年龄做的。

source: The documentary teaches high school isn't even about the curriculum... it's about friendship, living wacky misadventures, and finding love!
target: 纪录片教高中 甚至不是课程... 这是关于友谊, 活着的疯狂错误冒险, 和寻找爱情!

source: Plot twist: it turns out it's not a documentary but a very inaccurate TV show.
target: Plot曲折:事实证明它不是一部纪录片,而是一部非常不准确的电视节目.

source: Long story short, recently the school learned about this and now it's going through a whole rebranding.
target: 说来话长,最近学校得知了这一点,现在正在经历一个整体的重塑.

source: Now it goes by Spooky Academy.
target: 现在它由Spooky学院。

source: That's a first step, but this "Spooky Academy" should be more like a university. With majors and such.
target: 这是第一步,但这个"斯普克学院"应该更像一所大学. 有专业之类的。

source: Aw... so... no prom?
target: 哦... 所以说... 没有舞会?

source: No, you can totally keep prom. Prom is the pillar of any education system.
target: 不,你完全可以保留舞会。 家长会是任何教育系统的支柱。

source: In any case, it beats me how no one complained before. Some of you are even undead, like... you used to be human! Shouldn't you know better?
target: 无论如何,它胜过我 之前没有人抱怨。 你们中有些人甚至不死,就像... 你曾经是人类! 难道你不该更清楚吗?

source: I don't know, this realm makes so little actual sense that you learn to just go with whatever.
target: 我不知道,这个领域 没有什么实际意义, 你学会了随心所欲。

source: On that, my friend, we totally agree. What a strange beautiful place this realm is...
target: 朋友,我们完全同意 多么奇怪的美丽之地 这个世界是...

source: You stay up all night comparing your prom experiences. Cryptid Prom sounds as cool as the Monster Prom... and equally daunting!
target: 你整晚都熬夜比较你的舞会经历 加密的相机听起来酷毙了 怪物舞会... 和同样令人生畏!

source: His PhD thesis
target: 他的博士论文

source: Ah, yes, I am in fact working on a PhD thesis right now.
target: 啊,是的,我事实上正在写博士论文

source: It's on the relevance of gossip and its place in oral history, and how it helps to build society's perception of reality.
target: 它涉及八卦的相关性及其在口述历史中的地位,以及如何帮助社会建立对现实的认识.

source: What a mouthful!
target: 嘴真脏!

source: A mouthful of hot gossip.
target: 口出热言.

source: Is it hard? Working on a thesis sounds a bit intimidating.
target: 很难吗? 写一篇论文听起来有点吓人

source: Nah, getting a PhD is a lot like partying hard if you squint enough.
target: 不,获得博士学位是很多喜欢 聚会,如果你看够了。

source: Really?
target: 真的吗?

source: Yes! You almost never sleep.
target: 没错! 你几乎从不睡觉。

source: You drink A LOT (although it is mostly coffee in this case).
target: 你喝一多杯(尽管这主要是咖啡)。

source: And I am sure that looking back, you'll never be 100% sure if all those years you poured into that were just years of your life you lost forever.
target: 我敢肯定,回想起来,你永远不会百分百地确定 如果所有那些年你投入到 你生命中仅仅失去的几年。

source: Yikes.
target: 唉哟!

source: Yikes indeed. But it's all worth it as long as you remember the upsides too, such as...
target: 痷 但只要你也记得那些颠倒的话,这都是值得的,比如...

source: ...oh, God.
I'm sure I will remember at some point, it's okay.
target: 我相信我会记得的,没事的

source: Well... you're dedicating yourself to a very narrow field of knowledge you're incredibly passionate about.
target: 这个... 你把自己奉献给 一个非常狭窄的知识领域 你令人难以置信的热情。

source: There's something that feels pure about that, isn't there?
target: 有一点感觉是纯洁的,不是吗?

source: Actually, yes. That's a beautiful way to put it, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 其实是的。 说得真好,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Thanks for giving me some solace on this exhausting path I foolishly took.
target: 谢谢你在我愚蠢地走这条令人疲惫的道路上给我一些安慰。

source: There's bravery in facing a foolish path into something you love and still taking it!
target: 勇敢面对一条愚蠢的道路,走进你所爱的东西,并且仍然拿它去!

source: Look at you! Tonight you chose kindness, my friend. I appreciate it!
target: 看着你! 今晚你选择了善良,我的朋友。 谢谢你!

source: Hehe... it's nothing!
target: 热... 没什么!

source: You two keep talking about Moss' PhD. He really loves it. Apparently, academy life is full of hot gossip, which is another plus.
target: 你们两个继续谈论莫斯的博士学位。 他真的很喜欢 显然,学院生活充满了热闹的八卦,这是另一个附加.

source: That, and the possibility of rocking some dark academia aesthetics with a justification!
target: 以及用一个理由来震撼一些 黑暗的学术美学的可能性!

source: His love for Gossip
target: 他对八卦的爱

source: Ah, gossip... sweet, sweet gossip.
target: 啊,闲话... 甜美的,甜美的八卦。

source: I live for the gossip; I will most likely die for the gossip.
target: 我为八卦而活,我很可能为八卦而活。

source: Gossip makes the world spin, my friend. It adds spice, flavor, pizzazz.
target: 流言蜚语让世界旋转,我的朋友。 它添加了香料,口味,披萨.

source: I dunno, isn't it a bit like lying?
target: 我不知道,是不是有点像在撒谎?

source: Sure, in a way. You know what else is lies? Stories! Fiction! Myths! Legends!
target: 当然,在某种程度上。 你知道什么是谎言吗? 故事! 故事吗? 虚构! 神话! 传奇!

source: When people gathered around a campfire and told stories about heroes and gods, wasn't that a form of gossip?
target: 当人们聚集在营火周围,讲述英雄和神的故事时,难道这不是一种流言蜚语吗?

source: Lies can fuel monsterkind if crafted carefully. They can become a vehicle for truth.
target: 如果精心地设计,谎言可以激起怪物的火花. 他们可以成为真理的载体。

source: A story can teach us something about the world. A story can make us dream. A story can gives us hope.
target: 一个故事可以教我们一些关于世界的东西. 一个故事可以让我们做梦。 一个故事可以给我们带来希望。

source: In being a humble merchant of gossip, I am but a modern storyteller like those who sat and mesmerized the audience around a campfire... a bright, beautiful campfire.
target: 身为八卦的卑微商人,我只是一个现代的讲故事人,就像那些坐在营火周围,迷惑观众的人...... 一个明亮,美丽的营火。

source: You really like campfires, don't you?
target: 你真的喜欢营火,不是吗?

source: What's not to love?
target: 何等为所不爱.

source: The campfire is the most ancient altar of stories. Around campfires and through stories, civilizations arose.
target: 营火是故事中最古老的祭坛. 围绕营火和故事,出现了各种文明。

source: I only hope I can be worthy of continuing the saga of those who dared to reshape the world through stories.
target: 我只希望我能够继续那些敢于通过故事来重塑世界的人的圣训。

source: The bards, the fabulists, the shamans, the chroniclers, the tale-tellers, the kathak dancers, the raconteuses, the verse-tellers...!
target: 酒吧 花花公子 夏曼人 编剧 讲故事者 卡塔克舞者

source: I will devote my life to feed the fire with stories, and one day, eventually, let myself be consumed by it.
target: 我将献出我的一生 以故事喂养火, 有一天,最终, 让自己被它所消耗。

source: And then, freed from a physical body, I will live in the stories I myself weaved.
target: 然后,从肉体中解放出来, 我将生活在我自己编织的故事中。

source: Whoa, that's a bit intense, Moss!
target: 哇,这有点紧张,莫斯!

source: Indeed! Intense, like the fire!
target: 没错! 紧张,像火!

source: That's what stories are for: they're the fire that protects us from the coldness of the world; the stories protect us from the dullness of the world.
target: 这就是故事的意义:它们是保护我们免受世界寒冷的火;故事保护了我们免受世界的沉闷.

source: Well... that all sounds quite poetic and sorta convincing... but I still think gossip is lying and therefore a tiny bit not okay.
target: 这个... 听起来颇有诗意 很有说服力... 但我还是觉得八卦在撒谎 所以有点不对劲

source: Aren't some of your friends straight-up murderers and such? Gossip is really where you draw the line?
target: 不是你的朋友 直立的杀人犯之类的吗? 流言蜚语真的是你画线的地方吗?

source: Actually, that's a good point... hmmm...
target: 其实,这是个好主意... 垛...

source: Moss spends the rest of the night telling you about the beauty of gossip while also sharing some of the latest and hottest gossip. It is, at the very least, quite entertaining!
target: 莫斯用余夜告诉你八卦之美,同时也分享出一些最新而最热闹的八卦. 它,至少,是相当的娱乐!

source: The Items she sells
target: 她卖的东西

source: My items? Which ones?
target: 我的东西? 哪一个?

source: Dunno... what about the dumbest thing you've sold?
target: 不知道... 说不定... 你卖过的最蠢的东西呢?

source: Easy: I once sold a used tampon. Some weirdo wanted the blood in it to perform a blood ritual.
target: 网易:我曾经卖过一款用过的棉条. 一些怪人希望里面的血来进行血祭.

source: It indirectly helped my sister, so I'm quite okay with it.
target: 它间接地帮助了我妹妹, 所以我相当同意它。

source: What about the strangest thing you've sold?
target: 你卖过的最奇怪的东西呢?

source: I once had this powerful totem that had some sort of entity trapped inside of it.
target: 我曾经有一个强大的图腾, 它有某种实体困在里面。

source: I tried to do some research to properly appraise it.
target: 我试图做一些研究来正确评估它。

source: It turns out the entity inside the totem may or may not have been one of the most powerful beings in the universe.
target: 原来图腾内部的实体可能是也可能不是宇宙中最强大的生物之一.

source: Uh, so you made some big bucks off of it, didn't you?
target: 呃,所以你赚了一些大钱 从它,不是吗?

source: Not really!
target: 没有!

source: The moment I realized I had something that dangerous in my shop, I did the sensible thing and sold it for a low price to get rid of it.
target: 当我意识到我店里有危险的东西时 我做了明智的事 以低价卖掉它

source: Next thing I knew, that thing was melting people's faces and making birds fall out of the sky.
target: 接下来我知道的是,那东西正在融化人们的面孔,使鸟从天空中倒出.

source: Good riddance.
target: 善解脱相.

source: You betcha.
target: 当然

source: What's the biggest scam you've run in your shop?
target: 你店里最大的骗局是什么?

source: Uh, bold of you to ask.
target: 呃,大胆的问你。

source: Vera and I once ran a great scam selling some rando cheap rings and said they were membership rings for a super exclusive cult.
target: 维拉 我曾经经营一个伟大的骗局 卖出一些兰多便宜的戒指, 并说他们是会员圈 一个超级独家邪教。

source: Almost everyone in school got one.
target: 几乎每个学校都有

source: I made good money out of it, and Vera controlled all those fools by posing as the cult leader in the shadows.
target: 我从中赚了大钱 维拉 控制了所有那些傻瓜 通过假扮邪教领袖 在阴影中。

source: People can be really gullible, huh?
target: 人会很狡猾的,是吧?

source: Hahaha, totally!
target: 哈哈哈,绝对的!

source: (I definitely don't own one of those rings, heh heh...)
target: (我绝对没有这些戒指之一,heh heh...)

source: What?
target: 什麽?

source: Nothing! Tell me more stories! I like them!
target: 没什么! 告诉我更多故事! 我喜欢他们!

source: My pleasure.
target: 我的荣幸。

source: And so Valerie spends the rest of the night sharing some of the wackiest stories you can imagine. This girl has lived an eventful life!
target: 所以瓦莱丽在夜里 分享一些你能想象到的最糟糕的故事 这个女孩过着多事的生活!

source: Her Shop Business
target: 她的店铺生意

source: Ah, my good ol' shop!
target: 啊,我的好店铺!

source: Why did you decide to open a shop within the school?
target: 你为什么决定在学校里开个店?

source: Because people are stupid and will pay for any dumb shit, and who am I to deny them that?
target: 因为人们是愚蠢的,会付出代价 任何愚蠢的狗屎, 我是谁来否认他们呢?

source: So I just provide and make a nice buck out of it.
target: 所以,我只是提供 和做一个好的钱出来。

source: Dang, girl!
target: 该死的,女孩!

source: No, but for real. Everyone's going through their own personal ordeal.
target: 不,但真实的。 每个人都在经历个人的折磨

source: You know: we all have our little goals and our personal dozen insecurities, and sometimes life looks so incredibly confusing and difficult.
target: 你知道,我们都有自己的小目标 和我们的十几个不安全感, 有时生活看起来如此令人难以置信的混乱和困难。

source: In the end, I think people just want to believe there's some magical ointment that'll make everything suddenly make sense.
target: 最后,我想人们只是想相信 有一些神奇的药膏,会让一切突然变得有意义。

source: A trick to figure life out, you know?
target: 一个把生活弄明白的把戏,你知道吗?

source: Ugh, I'd kill for such a trick.
target: 唉,我会杀了这样的把戏。

source: You and many more! We wish for it so fuckin' hard, most people will take anything that promises to make life easier.
target: 你还有更多的人! 我们希望它如此他妈的'艰难, 大多数人会采取任何 承诺使生活更容易。

source: Here, have these impractical-yet-kinda-funny glasses! They may or may not make you more FUN!
target: 拿着这些不切实际的眼镜! 他们可能或不会让你更有趣!

source: Look at this fake badass tattoo! Get it, and people might think you're a BOLD motherfucker.
target: 看看这个假的坏蛋纹身! 得到它,人们可能会认为 你是一个BOLD的混蛋。

source: I think deep down people can see how ludicrous all that is.
target: 我想在内心深处人们可以看到 这一切是多么可笑。

source: But what if...?
target: 但是,如果,如果... ? ,那会怎么样?

source: You get so desperate to find a cure to feeling so clueless all the time that you force yourself to believe.
target: 你如此绝望地寻找解药 以感到如此无稽之谈 你强迫自己相信。

source: So, if life is not getting easier any time soon... maybe a placebo is the next best thing.
target: 所以,如果生活没有 变得容易任何时间很快... 也许安慰剂是下一个最好的事情。

source: Yeah... maybe a placebo is not that bad of a solution to help you get on with life when it gets hard?
target: 对... 也许安慰剂不是那么糟糕的解决方案 在生活变得困难的时候帮助你继续生活?

source: Who knows? Not me for sure! I'm just the humble shopkeeper that sells dumb shit to make people feel a tiny bit more in control.
target: 谁知道呢? 我肯定不会! 我只是一个谦卑的店主 卖出愚蠢的东西 让人们感觉更控制。

source: No refunds!
target: 不退钱!

source: Yeah, I get it. You saw the demand and just provided some supply.
target: 对,我懂了 你看到了需求,只是提供了一些供给。

source: That, and sometimes the strangest stuff falls in my hands and I gotta dispose of it somehow.
target: 这,有时最奇怪的东西 落入我手中,我必须处理它 不知如何。

source: Blankets with holes, old floppy disks, the blood of an angel... there's always someone weird enough to take it off my hands.
target: 有洞 有软盘 有天使的血迹... 总是有人怪怪的 把它从我手上取走

source: I'm sure you have anecdotes by the dozen!
target: 我敢肯定,你有 传闻由十几个!

source: She does! You spend the rest of the night listening to Val's many stories. She has seen some shit!
target: 没错! 你整晚都在听瓦尔的很多故事 她已经看到了一些狗屎!

source: Where does she get the items she sells
target: 她从哪里买到卖出的物品的

source: Where do I get the items I sell?
target: 我从哪里得到我卖的东西?

source: A shopkeeper never reveals her suppliers!
target: 一个店主从来不透露她的供应商!

source: Oh, sorry...
target: 哦,对不起...

source: Nah, I was kidding. It's still a weird question, but I'm game.
target: 不,我开玩笑的。 这还是个奇怪的问题 但我在玩游戏

source: Let's see...
target: 让我看看...

source: A lot of my items I get from bartering.
target: 我从易货那里得到很多东西

source: I barter and barter until I get stuff that seems valuable enough to be sold for a good price.
target: 我交换和交换 直到我得到的东西 似乎足够贵重 被出售一个好的价格。

source: I tell you what: our school is a strange place to barter items.
target: 我告诉你 我们的学校是用来交换物品的奇怪地方

source: How so?
target: 怎么会这样?

source: You start with an old pair of jeans and somehow end up with the blood of an angel.
target: 你从一条老牛仔裤开始 不知怎么的 以天使之血而来

source: You have some lipstick you may or may have not shoplifted? Barter away until you get an ancient tome of forbidden arts.
target: 你有一些口红 你可能或可能没有 商店盗窃? 交换,直到你得到一个古老的 禁止艺术的玩具。

source: That sounds like a deal!
target: 这听起来像一个协议!

source: It is. Sometimes I get suspicious of how I get such good deals for items that often end up ALMOST destroying reality, and shit like that.
target: 没错 有时我怀疑 我如何得到这样的好交易 物品 往往最终 ALMOST 破坏现实, 和狗屎 像这样。

source: Then again, I make a quick buck out of it... and the quick buck outweighs my suspicions.
target: 再说一次,我赚了快钱... 速战速决胜于我的猜想

source: No, yeah, that makes sense.
target: 不,是的,这有道理。

source: Then there's some stuff that's just scams. But don't tell anyone! Shhhh!
target: 还有一些只是骗局的东西。 但不要告诉任何人! 嘘!

source: Like the time I cut two holes on a blanket and sold it as... dunno... some sort of fashion statement for dumb people?
target: 就像我把毯子上两个洞 卖掉的时候... 不知道... ... 说不定... 给傻子的时尚声明?

source: Or one time I had to dispose of a corpse, so I just put a price tag on it and... sold!
target: 或者有一次我不得不处理一具尸体 所以我在尸体上贴了个价格标签 然后... 卖了!

source: People will buy anything, won't they?
target: 人们会买任何东西,不是吗?

source: YES!
target: 没错!

source: And where there's demand, there's Valerie Oberlin with an endless supply of whatever dumb shit people are willing to pay for.
target: 在有需求的地方,有瓦莱丽·奥伯林 与无休止的供应 任何愚蠢的狗屎 人们愿意支付。

source: Once it was a lemon. A weirdo bought a single lemon from me. Haven't people heard of fruit stores?
target: 曾经是柠檬. 一个怪人从我这里买了个柠檬 人们没听说过水果店吗?

source: Amazing!
target: 厉害!

source: Valerie keeps telling you secrets about shopkeeping. Some of them truly blow your mind. What a night you two share!
target: 瓦莱丽一直告诉你店里的秘密 有些真的让你大开眼界 你们俩共度了多么美好的一晚!

source: Her life beyond the shop
target: 她的人生在店外的某个地方

source: My life beyond my shop? What sort of weird topic is that?
target: 我的生活在我店外吗? 这算什么奇怪话题?

source: Yeah, I mean... in school, everyone just knows you as the one who sells just about everything.
target: 对,我是说... 学校里,每个人都知道你是卖东西的

source: It's so cool that sometimes it feels like you get overshadowed by your role as "shopkeeper".
target: 这太酷了,有时感觉好像被"店主"的角色所蒙蔽了.

source: Fair. I am indeed too cool to only be known as a shopkeeper. So let's see... who's Valerie Oberlin?
target: 公平 公平 公平 公平 公平 公平 公平 我实在太酷了,不能只被称作一个店主。 所以让我们看看... 谁是瓦莱丽·奥伯林?

source: Well, I like vibing and minding my own business, you know?
target: 我喜欢振动和管闲事,你知道吗?

source: Other than that... nothing too out of the blue: I like going to concerts, partying every now and then, watching movies, etc.
target: 除此之外... 没什么大不了的:我喜欢去参加音乐会,偶尔参加派对,看电影等.

source: The sort of things everyone likes.
target: 那种人喜欢的东西

source: What kind of movies?
target: 什么样的电影?

source: Hmmm... a bit of everything. I sometimes go through phases. I love watching super old movies. It soothes me a bit.
target: 那个... 一点点的一切。 我有时会经历阶段。 我喜欢看超老电影 有点安慰我

source: And I also love watching B movies! It does... whatever the opposite of soothing me is. Those movies are wild!
target: 我也喜欢看B电影! 这确实... 不管与安慰我相反的是什么 那些电影是疯狂的!

source: If a movie has a super dumb B movie title, you can be sure I will be down to watch it.
target: 如果电影有超级哑B的电影标题,你可以肯定我会看它。

source: You know, like "Surfer Ninjas from Outer Space" or "The Year I Swapped Minds with a Cantaloupe 3".
target: 比如"探索外太空的忍者" 或者"我用Cantaloupe 3洗脑的那一年"

source: There are a "The Year I Swapped Minds with a Cantaloupe" 1 and 2?
target: 有"我用可口可乐洗脑的一年"一和二?.

source: Not exactly. The first sequel was "The Year I Swapped Minds with a Cauliflower".
target: 不尽然。 第一部续集是"我用花椰菜洗脑的那一年".

source: I guess the cauliflower wasn't clicking with the audience, so they went back with the cantaloupe for the third one.
target: 我猜花椰菜没有和观众一起点击, 所以他们回去了 与cantaloupe为第三个。

source: The more you know!
target: 越多你就会知道!

source: You betcha.
target: 当然

source: I also have lots of gigs other than the shop.
target: 除了店铺,我还有很多演出

source: You see, our dad taught Vera and me to be resourceful and hard-working.
target: 你看,我们的爸爸教的 维拉 和我会是 机智和辛勤工作。

source: Vera uses that to fly as high as she can. She wants to be the best and conquer life, as she usually says.
target: 维拉 用它飞得越高越好 她希望成为最好的,并征服生活,就像她通常所说的.

source: I prefer to be resourceful and hard-working as a way to get just enough to get by and buy some concert tickets and B movies.
target: 我更喜欢有才智和辛勤工作,以此来获得足够多的路程,并购买一些音乐会入场券和B电影.

source: So, well, I get more than enough through my shop and some random gigs I have.
target: 我从我的店里拿到的足够多 和一些零星的演出

source: I walk some dogs; I'm a line-stander-for-hire; I proofread and ghostwrite dating profiles; you name it!
target: 我走狗走狗走狗走狗走狗走狗走狗走狗走狗走狗走狗

source: You and Vera are so similar and so different at the same time.
target: 你和 维拉 如此相似,如此不同 同时。
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: We are, aren't we? I love Vera. She's the best sister I could ever ask for.
target: 我们是,不是吗? 我爱 维拉. 她是我最想要的姐姐了

source: Anyway, that's a scoop on who Valerie Oberlin is. Satisfied now?
target: 总之,这是关于瓦莱丽·奥伯林是谁的独家消息 满意了吗?

source: Pretty much!
target: 相当多!

source: You spend the rest of the night watching the "The Year I Swapped Minds with a Cantaloupe" trilogy. Valerie was right: these movies are wild!
target: 你整晚都在看"我用Cantaloupe洗脑的那一年"三部曲 瓦莱丽说得对,这些电影很疯狂!

source: Slayers
target: 杀害者

source: Slayers? Sure. What you want to know about it?
target: 屠夫吗? 当然可以。 你想知道什么吗?

source: What's the whole deal? I mean... the most I know is that you casually break into Spooky Academy to try to murder students.
target: 这整件事是怎么回事? 我是说... 我最清楚的是 你随便闯进Spooky学院 想谋杀学生

source: Hahaha... yes.
target: 哈哈哈... ... 哈哈,哈哈哈! 哈哈! 对

source: Why, though?
target: 为什么,虽然?

source: We slayers fight monsters; it's our thing. Also, Damien and Liam are dumb -- total murder material!
target: 我们的屠夫与怪物战斗,这是我们的事情。 还有... 达米恩 财务报告和审定财务报表 利亚姆 太蠢了 谋杀材料!

source: But why do you fight monsters? Aren't you like... half-monster at least?
target: 但你为什么要和怪物战斗? 你不是喜欢... 至少是半怪物吗?

source: Hmpf... you aren't wrong. There are legit reasons behind the Slayers' crusade, but I guess over the centuries the whole thing ended up being oversimplified to just "kill monsters".
target: 汉弗莱... 你没有错。 屠夫之役背后有合法的理由 但我猜这几百年来 整件事最终被过度简化为"杀死怪物"

source: The truth is that our lineage has always been part of the most important war. We're the spear of the mortalkind.
target: 事实是,我们的血统一直是最重要的战争的一部分。 我们是凡人之矛

source: There are ancient entities that prey on our reality.
target: 有古老的实体 猎取我们的现实。

source: Our lineage intertwines with a centuries-long journey to end the evil these entities produce and to find a way to end them once and for all.
target: 我们的世系与结束这些实体产生的邪恶并找到彻底结束这些邪恶的方法的数百年历程交织在一起。

source: Sounds intense.
target: 听起来很激烈。

source: It is fucking intense. I dream of being not just a Slayer, but "The Slayer": the legendary hero that manages to pierce the heart of an old deity for the first time.
target: 这是他妈的激烈的。 我梦想的不仅仅是一个屠夫,而是"屠夫":这个传说中的英雄,第一次设法打穿了老神的心.

source: There's more than one, but it takes just one. That will be enough for mortalkind to see they can bleed.
target: 不止一个,但只需要一个。 这足以让凡人看到他们能出血

source: So... how do you go from that to casually trying to murder students at our school?
target: 所以说... 你怎么从这到随意 试图谋杀我们学校的学生呢?

source: Yes, yes... you see, most of us Slayers have human blood. The Human Realm is the safest place away from the ancient entities.
target: 对,对... 你看,我们大多数的屠夫都有人类的血。 人类王国是远离古代实体的最安全的地方.

source: Other realms are infected by the corrupting power of the old deities.
target: 其他域被旧神的腐朽势力所感染.

source: Damien is from Hell, which might be the most corrupted realm.
target: 达米恩 是从火狱发出的,那或许是最恶劣的地盘。

source: And Liam commanded armies for the Dark Side, which was created by the old deities as a passage to invade the Monster Realm.
target: 还有 利亚姆 为黑暗之地指挥了军队,而黑暗之地是被老神所创造的,作为入侵"魔兽王国"的通道.

source: It took me some time, but I now know they're not pawns playing for the other side... not anymore, at least.
target: 花了我一些时间, 但我现在知道 他们不是棋子 玩的另一边... 至少已经不是了

source: I may still murder them, just because they have such stupid faces. We'll see.
target: 我可能还杀了他们, 只是因为他们有这么愚蠢的脸。 我们等着瞧吧。

source: Yikes, Aaravi!
target: 唉哟 阿拉薇!

source: You wanted to know! What can I say? I'm a straight shooter... quite literally.
target: 你想知道吗? 我能说什么呢? 我是一个直枪手... 从字面上说

source: You keep talking about the Slayers for the rest of the night. There's a lot to them, and it feels good to get to know Aaravi better.
target: 你整晚都在谈论屠夫 他们有很多事,知道这件事感觉很好 阿拉薇 好点了。

source: Being Cursed
target: 被诅咒

source: Ugh, yeah, being cursed is... a curse.
target: 被诅咒是... 一个诅咒。

source: You're doing your weekly dungeon-crawling session when you find a cool, powerful necklace, but of course the necklace is cursed.
target: 你每周都在做地牢爬行工作 当你找到一个很酷,强大的项链, 但当然项链被诅咒了。

source: And of course the curse is the most annoying entity that ends up living rent-free inside your soul, or mind... or God knows what.
target: 当然,诅咒是最烦人的实体 最终生活在你的灵魂,或心灵... 或天晓得什么。

source: Relatable!
target: 令人高兴!

source: The truth is I lifted the curse quite fast. But the necklace gives me some kick-ass boosts, so I kept it.
target: 事实是我很快解除了诅咒 但项链给了我一些踢屁股的助推, 所以我留着它。

source: What about Hex? I don't see them around. Are they, like... inside of your soul right now?
target: 那Hex怎么办? 我看不到他们周围。 他们,像... 你的灵魂里面,现在?

source: Nah.
target: 没有。

source: Look, the thing is, after some months together, I must admit I appreciate their company.
target: 听着,事情是,经过几个月在一起, 我必须承认,我很感激他们的陪伴。

source: They're like the most obnoxious roommate ever, but I still like them.
target: 他们就像有史以来最讨厌的室友 但我还是喜欢他们

source: If you ever tell them I said that, I'll deny it... and then I'll probably murder you in your sleep.
target: 如果你告诉他们我这么说,我会否认... 然后,我可能会杀了你 在你的睡眠。

source: Fair warning.
target: 相当的警告。

source: But even like that, it's not healthy to spend 24/7 with someone... with anyone!
target: 但即使这样, 花24/7与某人... ... 与任何人! 与谁!

source: Especially when that someone lives inside of your mind. So we found a solution.
target: 特别是当那个人生活在你的脑海里时 所以我们找到了一个解决方案。

source: Did you put the necklace in a box or something? Isn't that a bit claustrophobic for Hex?
target: 你把项链放进盒子里了吗? 这对Hex来说不是有点幽闭恐惧症吗?

source: No, that'd be unfair, even for that fucker.
target: 不,那不公平, 即使对那个混蛋。

source: We've found some people who are cool with carrying the necklace from time to time.
target: 我们发现有些人不时带着项链很酷

source: Some are friends who seem to really vibe with Hex; some are weirdos who seem to be into being cursed.
target: 有些是朋友,他们似乎真的与Hex有关系;有些是怪人,他们似乎喜欢被诅咒。

source: It's still mostly me, but now the load is much more bearable.
target: 大部分还是我,但现在的负载更能承受.

source: I didn't know that was even possible.
target: 我不知道这甚至是不可能的。

source: It wasn't exactly possible. We went through some shit to make it possible. It was a full adventure of its own!
target: 这不是完全可能的。 我们通过一些狗屎 使它成为可能。 这完全是一场冒险!

source: I have all night!
target: 我有一整晚的时间!

source: Aaravi spends the rest of the night telling you that story. When you think about it, it's inspiring to see how Aaravi turned a curse into a truly healthy relationship.
target: 阿拉薇 整晚都在跟你讲这个故事 想想看,看到 阿拉薇 将诅咒变成真正健康的关系。

source: The Food Truck
target: 食品卡车

source: The food truck is great.
target: 餐车很棒

source: I'd never have pinned you as a cook.
target: 我绝对不会把你当厨师

source: Well, I am an adventurer first, but adventures call for a diverse set of skills.
target: 好吧,我首先是一个冒险家, 但冒险需要 不同的技能组合。

source: I need to craft all sort of things, from weapons to meals.
target: 我需要设计出所有的东西 从武器到食物

source: I use the latter mostly for the food truck and the former only on occasion.
target: 我经常用后者来做餐车,而前者只是偶尔用.

source: But yeah, cooking is an essential skill: many are the times I've sat around a fire with party members to cook and eat a good stew as we prepared to raid a dungeon.
target: 是的,烹饪是一种基本技能:很多时候,我和党员坐在火地上, 一起烹饪和吃好的炖菜, 当我们准备搜查地牢的时候。

source: Hm, I can see it now. If you must go into a dungeon for several days, it's good to be resourceful with food.
target: 嗯,我现在可以看到它。 如果你必须进入地牢 几天,这是很好的 资源与食物。

source: Absolutely. It's a skill all of us Slayers must have at hand. I learned it from my mother.
target: 当然 这是我们所有屠夫必须掌握的技能 我从我母亲那里学的

source: She was a Slayer too?
target: 她也是个屠夫?

source: Yes, being a Slayer is a bit of a lineage thing. She was a strong, fierce woman, my mom.
target: 是的,作为一个屠夫 有点世系的事情。 她是一个强壮,凶猛的女人,我妈妈。

source: She taught me how to add flavor to any strange thing I might be forced to eat in order to survive while adventuring.
target: 她教我如何在任何奇怪的东西中添加口味 我可能被迫吃 以生存的同时冒险。

source: When she left for a mission, her spice rack was almost as important as her weapons.
target: 当她去执行任务时,她的香料架几乎与她的武器一样重要.

source: I imagine focusing a bit on cooking must be nice... like reliving the memories of cooking with your mom, no?
target: 我想专注于烹饪一定很好... 就像和你妈一起做饭的回忆一样,不是吗?

source: Yes, I guess so. I like having the food truck as this little side thing.
target: 是的,我想是这样。 我喜欢有餐车 作为这个小边事。

source: Then there's Calculester, who loves doing stuff that helps him understand organic life better.
target: 接下来是 卡库莱斯特他喜欢做一些能帮助他 更好的理解有机生命的事

source: And Hex, who just REALLY likes food, especially junk food.
target: 还有Hex,他真的很喜欢食物,特别是垃圾食品。

source: It's nice that this food truck project has brought you together.
target: 很高兴这个餐车项目能让你们聚在一起

source: It does. We got the truck, and now we just brainstorm and test different theme ideas.
target: 没错。 我们得到了卡车, 而现在我们只是头脑风暴 测试不同的主题想法。

source: The "Only Breakfast" food truck; the "Soup in a Can" food truck; the "Deep Fried Rattlesnake and Cobra Heart" food truck; the "Just Hot Dogs" food truck...
target: "只吃早餐"的餐车;"罐子里的汤"的餐车;"深煎的老鼠和眼镜蛇心"的餐车;"只吃热狗"的餐车. .

source: We try to take turns so everyone can test their ideas. Some are... better than others.
target: 我们尝试轮到大家来测试他们的想法。 有些是... 比别人好

source: Well, Aaravi, if you ever need a subject for testing new food ideas, here I am.
target: 这个嘛 阿拉薇如果你需要一个测试新食物的课题,我在这里。

source: I may hold you to that!
target: 我可能要你这么做!

source: She actually does. You spend the rest of the night talking about food while you try some hot dogs and soup in a can. The hot dogs are definitely the right way to go.
target: 她真的会的 你整晚都在谈论食物 一边在罐子里吃热狗和汤 热狗绝对是正确的方法。

source: Managing her Inventory
target: 管理她的库存

source: Oof, managing an adventurer's inventory... that's the real adventure.
target: 哦,管理一个冒险家的库存... 这才是真正的冒险

source: The things I have to fit in here...
target: 我在这里必须适应的东西...

source: I always wonder what you carry in that adventurer's bag. It looks like it weighs a ton.
target: 我一直想知道你把什么放在冒险家的包里 看起来像重一吨。

source: Wanna take a look with me? I'm never against managing my inventory a bit more.
target: 想和我一起看看吗? 我从不反对管理我的库存

source: Sounds like a plan!
target: 听起来像一个计划!

source: Okay, lemme see...
target: 好吧,让我看看...

source: There are the weapons, of course...
target: 当然还有武器...

source: Sword, broadsword, long sword, short sword...
target: 剑 宽剑 长剑 短剑...

source: Isn't that one a dagger?
target: 那不是匕首吗?

source: Eh, sure... daggers are just really short swords in the end.
target: 嗯,当然... 匕首最终只是很短的剑.

source: Then there's the equipment.
target: 然后是设备。

source: At first you tell yourself you'll only keep the stuff with the better stat boosts.
target: 一开始你告诉自己,你只会把东西 保存在更好的调压器上。

source: But, ugh... then you run into things with cool modifiers and shit, and it becomes really hard NOT to keep most of what you get.
target: 不过,呃... 然后用冷却剂和狗屎碰到一些事情, 变得很难不保存你得到的大部分东西。

source: Like, look at this special hood and cape. It increases the amount of time I can stay underwater.
target: 喜欢,看看这个特别的罩子和披风。 这能增加我留在水下的时间

source: How can fabric affect your lung capacity?
target: 织物如何影响你的肺容量?

source: Because it's blue! Blue equipment tends to be for breathing underwater. Or resisting cold better.
target: 因为是蓝色的! 蓝色设备往往用于在水下呼吸. 或更能抗拒寒冷.

source: ...Okay.
target: ...当然了。

source: There's my rack of spices to add flavor to whatever meat I hunt; this tuba that lets me perform magical songs; this eyeshadow...
target: 我的香料可以添加香味, 加入我猎取的肉; 这个大管,让我表演神奇的歌; 这个眼花...

source: Ooh, that looks nice. Does it give you something cool like night vision when it's applied?
target: 哦,看起来不错。 应用时,它会给你一些像夜视一样酷的东西吗?

source: Nah, it's just eyeshadow. Sometimes a girl likes looking fierce, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 不,只是眼睛湿了。 有时一个女孩喜欢看起来凶猛, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: Fair.
target: 公平 公平 公平 公平 公平 公平 公平

source: That's fifty turnips. I collect them because you never know when they might be part of a quirky sidequest.
target: 这是50个萝卜。 我收集它们,因为你永远不知道 什么时候它们可能是一个怪异的附带遗赠的一部分。

source: Hmpf... that's the problem with adventuring: everything could come in handy eventually, so you end up hoarding A LOT.
target: 汉弗莱... 这就是冒险的问题: 最终一切都会好起来的, 所以你最后会囤积一大笔钱。

source: I literally have rocks and branches and iron, because what if they're future material for crafting stuff?!
target: 我确实有石头和树枝和铁, 因为如果它们是未来的材料 用于工艺的东西呢?

source: But most of the time it's just junk I carry around like an idiot...
target: 但大多数时候,它只是垃圾 我携带周围像一个白痴...

source: Then you need to learn a new adventurer skill: to let things go!
target: 然后,你需要学习一种新的冒险者技能:让事情消失!

source: Let's start by throwing away some of those rocks and eating some of the turnips. How does that sound?
target: 我们先扔掉一些石头 然后吃一些萝卜 听起来怎么样?

source: You... you might be right. Yes. Let's do that.
target: 你们... 你也许是对的。 对 让我们做到这一点。

source: You spend the rest of the night throwing all the stuff that does not bring joy to Aaravi and eating some turnips... that she has carried in her bag for like three months. Yummy!
target: 你整晚都扔那些不带欢乐的东西 阿拉薇 和吃一些萝卜... 她已经背了三个月的包 好吃! 好吃吗?

source: Grace, from the Coven
target: 格蕾丝,来自巫师

source: Grace... sure, I can tell you a bit about her.
target: 格蕾丝... 当然,我可以告诉你一些关于她的事。

source: She was the leader of the Coven before you, right?
target: 她是你之前的巫统领袖,对吧?

source: Yes, she was, for a bit...
target: 是的,她是, 一点点...

source: We witches are either born to become part of the Coven, or remain "dormant".
target: 我们女巫要么生来就成为巫统的一部分,要么继续"活活".

source: If one of us dies, a "dormant" witch can take her place.
target: 如果我们中的一个死了,一个"多曼特"女巫可以取代她的位置.

source: A backup player, waiting in the benches!
target: 一个后备球员,在长椅上等着!

source: Sort of, yes. There are exceptions, though... like how our Hope can never be replaced by a different witch.
target: 有点,是的。 有一些例外,虽然... 就像我们的希望永远不能被另一个女巫所取代

source: In time she can be replaced by a new Hope. But for that to happen, she CANNOT die before the ritual takes place.
target: 在时间上,她可以被一个新的希望所取代. 但是要做到这一点,她不能死 在仪式举行之前。

source: This is because Hope is the vessel for something very old and powerful, something that's passed from Hope to Hope...
target: 因为"希望"是一件非常古老而有威力的东西的载体 从"希望"传到"希望"

source: The rest of us? We can die. We MUST die, if it's what it takes to save the world.
target: 其他人吗? 我们可以死。 我们一定要死,如果这是拯救世界所必须的。

source: And so Grace did.
target: 格蕾丝也这么做了

source: I'm sorry, Joy...
target: 对不起,乔伊...

source: Hope and Faith have told me she was a brave and just leader.
target: 希望和信仰告诉我 她是一个勇敢和公正的领导者。

source: It's hard. There's always a thin, lingering feeling that I'm in her shadow.
target: 阿难. 我总是觉得自己在她的阴影中

source: There's a different universe in which she survived and remained the rightful leader of the Coven.
target: 在另一个宇宙中,她活了下来,并且仍然是"巫统"的合法领袖.

source: A universe in which I remained just another human.
target: 宇宙里,我仍然是另一个人类。

source: What would be my life then? Would the Coven be in better hands?
target: 那我的人生会怎样? 巫师会得到更好的照顾吗?

source: I do my best to be a good leader for the Coven, to protect all realms.
target: 我尽我所能,为巫统做一个好领袖,保护一切疆域.

source: But is it enough?
target: 但是,这还不够吗?

source: Grace was brave and just and strong... and yet it wasn't enough.
target: 格蕾丝是勇敢的,正义和坚强的... 但它还不够。

source: Sometimes I dream I traded places with her again.
target: 有时我梦见我和她又换了地方

source: A part of me dreams this out of the thought that she would be better for the Coven.
target: 我梦见这一切 是因为她对巫师来说会更好

source: A part of me maybe just wants to drop this unbearable weight on my shoulders... to find some rest.
target: 我的一部分也许只是想 把这种难以承受的重量 放在我的肩膀上... 寻找一些休息。

source: It sounds like a lot, Joy. Maybe we can get some rest, even if only for the duration of the night?
target: 听起来像很多,乔伊。 也许我们可以休息一下,即使只在晚上休息?

source: Maybe... yes... that sounds good.
target: 也许... 对... 这听起来不错。

source: You both close your eyes. Breathe in... breathe out... you hold hands and just... are.
target: 你们两个闭上眼睛。 吸进去... 呼吸出来... 你握起手来... 已经是了

source: Moving from one realm to another
target: 从一个领域转移到另一个领域

source: Ah, yeah, we witches are a special case when it comes to that...
target: 啊,是的,我们女巫是一个特殊的情况 当它涉及到...

source: How much do you know about realms?
target: 你对世界了解多少?

source: Eh... explain this to me like I'm five, okay?
target: 额... 跟我解释一下,就像我五岁,好吗?

source: Heh... okay.
target: 哦... 还好。

source: Reality is divided into different realms.
target: 现实被分为不同的领域.

source: This is the Monster Realm, what many consider the "main realm".
target: 这是魔兽王国,许多人认为"主域".

source: With the right means and powers, you can traverse the realms.
target: 用正确的手段和力量,你可以穿越世界。

source: Some realms are... more accessible than others.
target: 有些领域是... 比别人更方便

source: Take Hell, for instance: it's only recently started serious diplomatic relationships with the Monster Realm, and now travelling between these two realms has become a bit easier.
target: 例如"取地狱":它只是最近才开始与"魔兽王国"建立严肃的外交关系,而现在在这两个领域之间旅行已经变得有些容易了.

source: One of the most mundane and yet special realms of them all is my birthplace: the Human Realm.
target: 其中最平凡而又特殊的领域之一 就是我的出世地:人类王国。

source: It's a realm that is built to reject anything "extraordinary".
target: 它是一个用来拒绝任何"异乎寻常"的王国。

source: I guess there's no place for me there, then!
target: 我想那里没有我的地方了!

source: It's way more complex than that, but to sum it up, it's a protective measure against the old deities who seek to destroy everything.
target: 比这要复杂得多,但概括起来,这是针对那些想毁灭一切的老神祇的保护措施.

source: We Coven witches are born human. It hasn't always been like that, but again, it's the safest way to protect us while we're young and weak.
target: 我们巫师是天生的人类 它并不总是这样,但再次,它是最安全的方式 保护我们 当我们年轻和弱小。

source: As soon as a being starts acquiring an "extraordinary" nature, it usually gets "vomited" out of the Human Realm.
target: 一旦一个被体开始获得"异常"的性能,它通常会从"人类王国"得到"被放出".

source: Think of how when dead humans turn into ghosts or zombies, they are slowly but surely phased out of the Human Realm and into the Monster Realm.
target: 想想当死去的人类变成鬼或僵尸时,他们慢慢但肯定地被淘汰出"人类王国"并进入"魔兽王国".

source: We witches are a rare exception, though. We're part of a select few who can actually move in and out the Human Realm.
target: 我们女巫是一个罕见的例外,虽然。 我们是少数能真正进出人类王国的人的一部分。

source: But we rarely go back these days. The stakes have become so high that it's dangerous for us to be there. We need to stay here, closer to the enemy.
target: 但我们这些天很少回去。 利害关系变得如此之高,以至于我们在那里是危险的. 我们要呆在这里 靠近敌人

source: Yikes.
target: 唉哟!

source: Yeah, yikes. But it is what it is. If we make a mistake, there could be no realm at all anymore.
target: 是啊,yikes。 (笑声) 但这是它是什么。 如果我们犯了一个错误, 就不可能有任何王国了。

source: Was it hard to stay in the Monster Realm for good? Like... in a way, you left your home.
target: 永远留在魔兽王国很困难吗? 喜欢... 从某种意义上说,你离开了你的家。

source: Absolutely. The Monster Realm is super messed up in a hundred different ways.
target: 当然 "魔兽王国"在百种不同方面都超级糟糕.

source: Then again... the Human Realm is also super messed up in its own particular ways.
target: 再说一遍... 人类王国也以自己独特的方式 陷入了超级混乱

source: But there are good things in both realms... and I guess that's enough to devote my life to protect both of them.
target: 但这两个领域都有好东西... 我想这足以让我的命 用来保护他们两人

source: Well, I hope I'm one of those good things!
target: 好吧,我希望我是那些好东西之一!

source: Heh... on a good day, you sort of are, sure.
target: 哦... 在一个美好的一天, 你有点,当然。

source: You both spend the rest of the night talking about the differences between the Monster Realm and the Human Realm.
target: 你们俩整晚都在谈论 魔兽王国和人类王国之间的区别

source: Her Studies in Magic
target: 她的魔法研究

source: The study of magic is complex, but it can be very rewarding.
target: 对魔法的研究很复杂,但可能非常有回报.

source: When we're not saving the world, we witches spend a good amount of time reading arcane tomes and learning new ways of channeling magic.
target: 当我们没有拯救世界时,我们女巫们花了很多时间来读取电弧调音符并学习新的传导魔法的方法.

source: Channeling magic?
target: 流畅的魔法?

source: Yes. Magic is a powerful energy that exists almost everywhere.
target: 对 魔法是一种几乎存在于各地的强大能量.

source: It has the worst of sources, though. It's the residual power of ancient entities whose only goal is to destroy reality.
target: 不过,它的来源最差。 这是古代实体的剩余力量,其唯一目的就是毁灭现实.

source: Magic is their fuel; their will. And they have so much of it that magic has been pouring out of them for eons, permeating everything.
target: 魔法是他们的燃料,是他们的意志。 他们拥有如此多的财富, 魔法从他们身上涌出, 充斥着一切。

source: So, it's like old deities' excretions? Their stinky sweat laying everywhere? Or even worse... their jizz?
target: 所以,这就像老神的排泄物? 他们到处出臭汗? 更惨的是... 他们的吉兹?

source: I'll try to NEVER AGAIN remember the metaphor you came up with today, thanks.
target: 我会试着永远记住你今天想到的比喻,谢谢。

source: The important thing here is that, in time, mortals learned to use it.
target: 这里最重要的是,在时间上,凡人学会了使用.

source: Magic was devised as the combustible to power these all-powerful machines of flesh and pain whose main directive was to destroy everything...
target: 魔法被设计成可以燃起力的 万能的肉体和痛苦机器 其主要指令是摧毁一切...

source: ...and yet we realized destruction is just one possible face for transformation. And there's many more.
target: ...然而我们意识到破坏 仅仅是一个可能的转变面孔。 且道还多来.

source: The hammer they used to tear reality apart could be used to build something up, too.
target: 他们用来撕裂现实的锤子 也可以用来制造一些东西

source: Whoa, that's cool.
target: 哇,这很酷。

source: Yes, it speaks volumes of mortals' will for survival; of their ambition to thrive no matter the odds.
target: 是的,它代表着人类生存的意志; 以及他们无论多么渺茫地繁荣的雄心。

source: Still, magic is an extremely complex energy, and there's so much for us to learn and discover new ways of using this mysterious material to shape reality; to fight back.
target: 尽管如此,魔法是一种极其复杂的能量,我们有很多东西可以学习和发现新的方法来利用这种神秘的材料来塑造现实;来反击.

source: Ah, the mysterious properties and uses of the jizz from the gods...
target: 啊,神秘的属性和用途 吉兹从神...

source: Stop it!
target: 停下来!

source: Anyway, that's how we learn magic. It's hard work, but it pays off.
target: 无论如何,这就是我们如何学习魔法。 苦行而能取报.

source: And here I was thinking you attended a very British school with color-coded houses and broom-based sports.
target: 我想你们在英国的学校里 有彩色标记的房屋 和扫帚运动

source: You're silly tonight, aren't you?
target: 你今晚很傻,不是吗?

source: Always!
target: 永远!

source: After some more discussion about magic, Joy teaches you some little magic tricks. It's neat!
target: 经过更多关于魔法的讨论,乔伊教你一些小魔术. 这很整洁!

source: The Coven and its origins
target: 巫统及其起源

source: The Coven is the shield of mortalkind.
target: 巫师是凡人之盾.

source: Fighting evil and all that, yeah?
target: 和邪恶战斗,是吗?

source: We do fight all kinds of evil... but the origin of the Coven is tied to the roots of all evil.
target: 我们确实与各种邪恶作斗争... 但巫师的起源与一切恶根相联.

source: Ominous!
target: 令人发指!

source: A bit, yes. Since the beginning of time, old entities have sought to undo all existence.
target: 有一点,是的。 自古以来,老实体一直试图消除一切存在。

source: And yet, life managed to thrive against all odds. But it has never been easy.
target: 然而,生活却在万事大吉的情况下蓬勃发展。 但从来就不是那么简单

source: Mortalkind slowly but steadily built two fronts of resistance.
target: 迫击炮慢慢但稳步地建立了两道抵抗战线.

source: One of them was defined by their ingenuity: mortals who dared to explore the very entities that aimed for their destruction.
target: 其中之一被其才智所定义:凡人敢于去探索那些旨在毁灭它们的实体.

source: That's how we came to hone magic.
target: 这就是我们如何来 光电魔法。

source: Magic wielders fought the old ones, sure; but they also focused on improving the means of survival.
target: 当然,魔法手与老手们作战,但他们也注重改善生存手段。

source: For instance, it was through magic that the realms came to be, as a way of distancing ourselves from our predators.
target: 例如,通过魔法,世界才出现, 作为一种使我们自己远离掠食者的方法。

source: A sort of arcane barricade, is it?
target: 某种电弧屏障,是吗?

source: Sort of. They're safer havens for us to keep studying magic and building more powerful tools to resist the attack.
target: 有点 它们对于我们来说是更安全的避难所,可以继续学习魔法并建造更强大的工具来抵抗攻击.

source: But we still remained mortal, and so all that we built could be taken from us so easily.
target: 但是我们仍然是活生生的,所以我们建造的一切可以轻易地从我们手中夺走.

source: Thus came the idea of a lineage... a way of nurturing magic power and passing it on to a new generation.
target: 世系的观念由此而来... 一种培养出魔法的力量 并把它传给新一代的方法

source: We inherit part of the power that has been sharpened for centuries by generations of Coven members.
target: 我们继承了数个世纪以来 数代巫统成员所赋予的部分权力。

source: We inherit responsibilities... we inherit the oldest fight, only dreaming of being the generation that can finally bring an end to it.
target: 我们继承责任... 我们继承了最古老的战斗, 只梦想着成为能够最终结束战斗的一代。

source: No pressure, huh?
target: 没有压力,是吧?

source: You're telling me! But I try to focus on doing my very best and improving my skills enough to pass something useful to the next generation.
target: 你告诉我! 但是,我试图集中精力,尽我的最大努力,提高我的技能,以便把有用的东西传递给下一代。

source: You've saved the world a dozen times at the very least... I'd say you're doing quite well.
target: 你至少拯救了全世界十几次... 我敢说你做得很好。

source: There's always room to do even better.
target: 总是有余地做更好的。

source: You ask Joy to tell you about some of the times she saved the world, and she tells you some epic stories. What a girlboss!
target: 你让乔伊告诉你一些她拯救世界的时间 她告诉你一些史诗故事 真是个娘娘腔!

source: Their gig as a Reaper
target: 他们作为死神的活

source: Oh, darling, being a reaper, amirite?
target: 哦,亲爱的,当死神,阿米丽特?

source: Such a responsibility!
target: 这么重的责任!

source: But how... how does it work, exactly?
target: 但怎样... 确切地说,它是如何运作的?

source: Well, how does anything work in this strange, sometimes-nonsensical world?
target: 那么,什么是工作 在这个奇怪,有时不感知的世界?

source: We reapers are like these mysterious, sexy ferrypeople who row souls across realms.
target: 我们的收割者就像那些 神秘而性感的渡船人 他们把灵魂划出世界。

source: Because you see: death is not the end. Death is transformation; death is transition!
target: 因为你看到:死亡不是结束。 死亡就是转变,死亡就是过渡!

source: You could die and become a ghost... or go to Hell... or reincarnate as a human...
target: 你可能会死,变成鬼... 要么去地狱... 或转生为人.

source: Some people even cease to be... or so I suspect.
target: 有些人甚至不再... 我怀疑是那样的

source: Truth be told, I don't completely understand the exact cycle and its rules.
target: 说实话,我并不完全理解 确切的周期和规则。

source: I get a gig, I follow the directions.
target: 我得到一个演出,我遵循方向。

source: You never wonder about it, though? How it all works exactly and such.
target: 你从没想过吗? 这一切都是如何运作的 确切的和这样的。

source: No, darling; that's above my pay grade.
target: 不,亲爱的,这比我的薪水高

source: The important thing here is we do something that's important.
target: 这里重要的是我们做一些很重要的事。

source: Most poor souls tend to be pretty confused after they die.
target: 大部分可怜的灵魂在死后往往相当困惑.

source: If we do our job well, we can give them some direction, some peace, or at the very least some company.
target: 如果我们做好我们的工作,我们可以给他们一些方向,一些和平,或者至少一些公司.

source: That's such a kind thought.
target: 这想法真贴心

source: You know me, honey: I'm a kind, selfless, and definitely humble person. That's Milo Belladonna for you.
target: 你知道我的,亲爱的:我是一个善良的,无私的,绝对谦卑的人. 这是 迈洛 贝拉多娜给你。

source: It certainly is!
target: 这当然是!

source: Let's hope I can be there for you when it's your time to cross realms.
target: 希望在你穿越世界的时候我能陪着你

source: Let's hope that's not soon!
target: 希望这还不快!

source: Just in case, you two spend the rest of the night making a list of things you'd love to do before dying. Joyful and a bit morbid, just your style!
target: 以防万一 你们俩整晚都想在死前 列出你们想做的事 欢乐和有点病态, 只是你的风格!

source: The Downsides of Fame
target: 名声的下行

source: Ah, yes, fame! That elusive thing so many desire and so few get.
target: 啊,是的,名声! 那种难以捉摸的事物 如此之多的欲望 如此之少得到。

source: I must have done something right; instead of fifteen minutes, they gave me years and years of it!
target: 我一定做了正确的事情, 而不是15分钟, 他们给了我多年的时间!

source: Full buckets of fame for you to bathe in!
target: 满桶的名气让你洗个澡!

source: Such a delightful image, darling.
target: 如此令人愉快的形象,亲爱的。

source: But beware: being Milo Belladonna isn't all glamour and style.
target: 但当心点: 迈洛 贝拉多娜不是所有的魅力和风格。

source: (Although it involves lots of both.)
target: (虽然它涉及很多两者。 )

source: Yeah, so tell me: what are the downsides?
target: 是啊,所以告诉我:什么是缺点?

source: Hmmm... for starters, some people can get weird...
target: 那个... 首先,有些人会变得怪异...

source: I do love my fans; my sweet Milovers.
target: 我爱我的粉丝,我的甜心 迈洛当然

source: I mean, what's not to love? They're cultured people with impeccable taste!
target: 我的意思是,什么是不爱? 他们是有无可挑剔的品味的有教养的人!

source: An undeniable trait of theirs, right?
target: 他们不可否认的特质,对吧?

source: Exactly right! Nonetheless, there are some misguided individuals who misunderstand the depth of our relationship.
target: 说对了! 然而,有些被误导的人误解了我们关系的深度。

source: They expect and sometimes even demand an amount of attention from me that I won't give them. It can get ugly...
target: 他们期待,有时甚至要求我多加注意,以免我给与他们. 它会变得丑陋...

source: And the privacy!
target: 还有隐私!

source: Say goodbye to privacy. It so quickly becomes a sort of mythical beast. I long for privacy so much, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 与隐私说再见。 它很快变成了一种神话般的野兽。 我渴望隐私,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Well, you have some privacy right now, don't you?
target: 你现在有一些隐私,不是吗?

source: It's adorable that you think so!
target: 你这么认为真可爱!

source: But no, we're livestreaming on my Momentgram account right now. Say hi!
target: 但是,不,我们正在直播 我的Momentgram账户现在。 打个招呼!

source: And look: there's the cameras filming my new reality show, "Milo on the Road".
target: 你看,有摄像机 拍摄我的新真人秀, "迈洛 "在路上"

source: Well, what if you ended the broadcast and told the crew to take fifteen? I am sure they'd actually love that.
target: 好吧,如果你结束广播 并告诉船员 采取15? 我敢肯定,他们会真正喜欢这一点。

source: That... doesn't sound half-bad.
target: 那个... 听起来还不错

source: And so they do. You spend some quality time alone with Milo. You make some small-talk, but that's more than enough, since Milo can relax for a hot minute. They really needed this.
target: 所以他们这样做。 你花一些高质量的时间 单独在一起 迈洛. 你做一些小说话, 但这是超过足够的,因为 迈洛 可以放松一下,热一分钟。 他们真的需要这个。

source: The Upsides of Fame
target: 名声的起伏

source: The upsides of fame, darling?
target: 名利的颠倒,亲爱的?

source: There are too many to remember them all!
target: 这么多人都记不住了!

source: Some will do, then!
target: 一定有办法的!

source: Hmmm, okay. There's lots of free stuff, for instance.
target: 嗯,没关系。 比如说有很多免费的东西

source: Free stuff? That's my favorite stuff!
target: 免费的? 这是我最喜欢的东西!

source: Yeah, audience is the hottest currency.
target: 是啊,观众是最热门的货币。

source: Brands shower me in samples of all sorts of things for me to show on my channels.
target: Brands用各种样本给我洗个澡 让我在频道上展示

source: From free scented candles to free cement.
target: 从免费的香味蜡烛到免费水泥.

source: Free... cement?
target: 免费... 水泥?

source: You heard me! Look, at the beginning of the influencer era, only the most chic brands believed in sending samples to people with big audiences.
target: 你听见了! 看,在"影响者"时代的开始,只有最有气质的品牌相信会把样本寄给有较大受众的人.

source: You know: fashionable clothes, accessories, macarons...
target: 时髦的衣服,配件,马卡龙...

source: But now all the more traditional brands are catching up.
target: 但是现在所有更传统的品牌都在追赶.

source: Cement, crossbows, big pharma -- you name it! I get the weirdest samples ever.
target: 水泥、弩、大药 -- 随便你怎么说! 我得到了有史以来最怪异的样本。

source: Wild!
target: 疯狂!

source: Then there's all the famous people double standards.
target: 后有出名者多有双重标准.

source: Like, if you buy your groceries in sweatpants, you could be seen as untidy. If I do so, apparently I'm "down-to-Earth."
target: 比如说,如果你用汗裤买起你的杂货, 你就可以被视为不累. 如果我这样做,显然我是"从地到地"。

source: If you buy your groceries in your PJs they may call you "a weirdo". If I do so, I'm "quirky" or "eccentric."
target: 如果你买你的杂货 在你的PJ,他们可能叫你"怪人"。 如果我这样做,我是"古怪"或"古怪"。

source: I can buy groceries wearing ANYTHING, and people will somehow find a way to think my fashion choice, no matter how outlandish it is, says something positive about my personality.

target: 虽然有点没用... 当表演时间,我通常 最终与经典:

source: "Sure", "Okay", or a version of that.
target: "当然","好的",或者一个版本的。

source: I'm just not very good with words.
target: 我只是不太会说话

source: Tell me about it... socializing can be hard sometimes
target: 告诉我... 社交有时会很困难

source: Yeah... and then, other times, I just go into my worlds.
target: 对... 然后,其他时候,我只是走进我的世界。

source: What do you mean?
target: 你说什么?

source: Like, movies I play in my head, you know? Action scenarios... romcom scenarios... little dream movies I star.
target: 喜欢,电影我玩在我的头上,你知道吗? 行动情景... romcom 假想... 小梦幻电影我主演。

source: Sounds fun!
target: 听起来很有趣!

source: Yeah... all the fun without the work!
target: 对... 没有工作,所有乐趣!

source: So that's what goes in Brian's head when he's all quiet, huh? Hypothetical conversations and imagined worlds?
target: 所以,这是去 布莱恩他安静的时候是头,是吧? 假话和想象中的世界?

source: Pretty much.
target: 相当多。

source: Brian?
target: 布莱恩?

source: Yeah?
target: 是吗?

source: I'm happy we got to chat, instead of just imagining the conversations in our heads. I like talking to you.
target: 我很高兴我们有聊天, 而不是想象我们头上的对话。 我喜欢和你说话。

source: Yeah... same same.
target: 对... 同样的。

source: You spend the night talking. Brian tells you about some of these movies he makes up in his head. They're goofy and cool!
target: 你整晚都在说话.  布莱恩 告诉你一些电影 他编的在他的头上。 他们是愚蠢的和酷!

source: Surviving School
target: 生存学校

source: Oof... surviving school was... not easy.
target: 哦,这... 幸存的学校是... 很难说

source: School was already hard when I was alive...
target: 我活着的时候学校已经很辛苦了...

source: ...but this? This has been on a whole different level.
target: ...但是这个? 这是在完全不同的层面上。

source: I feel you!
target: 我感觉到了!

source: I wanted to focus on passing my tests... maybe playing some football...
target: 我想专注于通过我的测试... 也许打一些橄榄球...

source: But at Spooky Academy, the moment you get distracted, you may very well get murdered!
target: 但是在Spooky学院, 一旦你分心了, 你可能会被谋杀!

source: Yeah, the murder rate at that school is... kind of worrying.
target: 是的,那所学校的谋杀率是... 有点担心。

source: Tell me about it!
target: 告诉我!

source: I still don't know how mortality works, being undead and all...
target: 我还是不知道 死亡是怎样运作的, 是不死和所有...

source: And I'm in no rush to figure that one out by myself.
target: 我并不急于自己去想这个

source: Good call!
target: 好样的!

source: Still, it's not easy when people think a good strategy to win at dodgeball is "a gun".
target: 不过,当人们认为在躲避球中取胜的好策略是"一把枪"时,这并非易事.

source: Ah, yes, the classic gun strategy.
target: 啊,是的,经典的枪术。

source: And even if you manage to not get yourself killed, there are other dangers.
target: 即使你没有自杀, 也存在其他危险。

source: Such as...?
target: 比如说... ?

source: Well, being kidnapped, for one.
