source: Ah, you mean...
target: 啊,你是说...

source: Yeah, that prince guy. What's his deal?
target: 是啊,那个王子的家伙。 他有什么交易吗?

source: Getting married no matter what?
target: 无论怎样都要结婚吗?

source: Ugh...
target: 唉哟...

source: At least we owe him the classic: jaw unhinges...
target: 至少我们欠他经典的:下巴被打出...

source: ...BEES POUR OUT!
Heh... yeah, that one was good.
target: 哦... 是啊,那一个是很好的。

source: Well... let's toast to school finally being behind us!
target: 这个... 让我们敬学校 终于在我们后面!

source: Cheers!
target: 爱狹!

source: You two keep reminiscing about school while looking at the stars. Brian even tells you about the time he got kidnapped by the Interdimensional Prince. It was wild!
target: 你们俩在看星星时 总是回忆起学校的事  布莱恩 甚至告诉你,他被绑架的时间 被跨维度王子。 这是野生的!

source: The Merkingdom
target: 默金多姆

source: The Merkingdom is...
target: 默金多姆是...

source: ...a complicated place.
target: ...一个复杂的地方。

source: The Crown can be truly oppressive and ruthless. It rules with an iron fist and little mercy.
target: 皇室可以真正压迫和无情. 以一铁拳而取小慈.

source: It's as if everything is justified as long as it keeps the Merkingdom strong, united, and in line.
target: 仿佛一切都是正当的,只要它保持了默金多姆的强大,团结,并排成一行.

source: When I was younger, I hated it with all my heart. How could my motherland be so atrocious?
target: 年轻时,我全心全意地厌恶它. 我的祖国怎么会这么残暴呢?

source: And... I mean... I still hate that about the Merkingdom... but now I am conflicted.
target: 还有... 我是说... 我仍然讨厌关于默金多姆的事... 但我现在很矛盾。

source: How so?
target: 怎么会这样?

source: Well, I've become a knight, and I've been on the front lines of the Most Important War... and it scares me.
target: 我成为了一名骑士,我一直站在最重要的战争的前线... 吓我一跳

source: The Most Important War...?
target: 最重要的战争...

source: You see, the Merkingdom is a key player in the war mortalkind wages against ancient deities that want to bring about the end of all things.
target: 你看,默金多姆是关键角色 在战争中死亡工资 与古代神 想要带来所有事物的终结。

source: Years ago I thought that was just an old wives tale... another trick from the Crown to keep our people in line.
target: 多年前我还以为那只是个老太太的故事... 皇室的又一把把把戏 是为了让我们的人保持秩序

source: But it's not.
target: 然则不然.

source: Not so long ago, I was on a mission to stop a cabal that was channeling one of these deities into this realm.
target: 不久之前,我执行了一项任务, 阻止一个将其中一位神灵引入这个圈子的歌舞团。

source: We managed to put a stop to it before it was too late, but... we had to face what I can only imagine was a fraction of this entity's power...
target: 我们设法在为时已晚之前阻止了它,但... 我们不得不面对我只能想象的 是这个实体的一小部分力量...

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... it was dozens of the finest, most valiant merknights I've ever met... and only a handful of us made it back.
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... 那是我见过的好几十个最精彩最勇敢的夜... 我们中只有一小部分人回来了

source: I... I'm truly sorry, Adrien.
target: 我…… 我真的很抱歉,阿德里安。 爱德利安。

source: This is no myth or old wives tale... reality is in danger, and the enemy's power is unfathomable.
target: 这不是神话或老太太的故事... 现实处于危险之中,敌人的力量是不可忽视的。

source: Maybe the only way to survive this is by doing whatever it takes to keep us all strong, united, and in line.
target: 也许生存下去的唯一办法 就是不惜一切代价 保持我们的力量 团结 并排队

source: But... ugh... no... I can't justify what the Crown does...
target: 不过... 额... 没有... 我无法为王室的所作所为辩护...

source: And yet... I feel like... even if I disagree with them... my duty now is to focus all my will and strength on stopping the end of all things.
target: 不过... 我觉得... 即使我不同意他们... 现在,我的职责是 集中我所有的意志和力量 阻止一切的结束。

source: Then, after that, we can finally be reborn a better kingdom for everyone.
target: 然后,在那之后,我们终于可以重新为每个人建立一个更美好的王国了.

source: Look, from where I stand, it sounds like your heart is in the right place.
target: 你看,从我的立场, 它听起来像你的心脏 在正确的地方。

source: And if there are more people in the Merkingdom like you... then I think there's hope for its future.
target: 如果在默金敦有更多的人像你一样... 那么我想它的未来就有希望了

source: ...Maybe.
target: 也许吧

source: Adrien truly is a brave knight, carrying the weight of the world on his shoulders. If you could only help ease that weight...
target: 阿德里安确实是一位勇敢的骑士,肩上背负着世界的重担. 如果你能帮助减轻体重...

source: For now, you bring him some peace, if only briefly, as you two spend the rest of the night chilling and watching the stars.
target: 现在,你给他带来一些平静, 哪怕只是短暂的, 你们两个度过了剩下的夜晚 寒冷和看星星。

source: The Crown's enemies
target: 皇室的敌人

source: The Merkingdom has two main threats. I guess you could say three, if you counted the dissidents and internal enemies of the Crown.
target: 默金多姆有两大威胁. 我想你可以说三, 如果你算 持不同政见者和王室内部的敌人。

source: But the main threat is the old entities trying to end reality.
target: 但主要的威胁是老实体试图终结现实.

source: Well, that's more of a threat to... basically everyone.
target: 嗯,这更是一个威胁... 基本上每个人。

source: That's true; but still, they're the Merkingdom's main focus when it comes to foes to vanquish.
target: 确实如此,但是在敌人征服的时候,他们仍然是默金多姆的主要焦点.

source: And if that wasn't enough... there's also Heaven.
target: 如果这还不够的话... 还有天堂

source: Heaven?!
target: 天堂吗?

source: Yes. What do you know about the realms' history?
target: 对 你对王国的历史了解多少?

source: Uh... not much.
target: 额... 没有太多。

source: Let me explain, then.
target: 让我来解释一下

source: Think of the realms as steps in an escape plan to put distance between mortalkind and the old deities.
target: 将王国视为一个逃生计划中的步子,将凡人和旧神的距离拉开.

source: Hell was the first mortal realm ever to exist outside of the Nothingness... but over time, it became corrupted by the deities trying to invade it.
target: 地狱是第一个在虚无之外存在的凡人之地... 但随着时间推移,它逐渐被那些试图入侵它的神灵所腐蚀.

source: And so mortalkind kept creating realms. The Human Realm and Heaven are the boldest moves yet, each in their own way.
target: 于是凡人不断创造出王国 人类王国和天堂是最大胆的一步, 每一个都以自己的方式。

source: But Heaven? It's a hermetic place set on extreme solutions in their war against the old ones.
target: 但是天堂吗? 在他们与老人们的战争中,这是一个 刻意寻找极端解决方案的地方。

source: How extreme are we talking here?
target: 我们这话有多极端?

source: They are set on destroying Hell and the Monster Realm, as they deem those realms to be too corrupted and "far beyond salvation."
target: 他们注定要毁灭地狱和魔兽王国, 因为他们认为这些地盘太腐败了,“远远超出了救赎”。

source: As you could expect, the Merkingdom doesn't love the idea of our realm being destroyed... hence the war against Heaven.
target: 正如你所预料的, 默金多姆不爱 我们的王国被摧毁的想法... 因此,与天相会战。

source: I disagree with the Crown on many of its choices on how to rule our motherland... but we're together on this one: Heaven must fall.
target: 我不同意王室关于 如何统治祖国的许多选择... 但是我们在一起 天堂必须倒下

source: I will pierce God's heart myself if that's what's necessary to save my people.
target: 如果有必要的话 我会亲自刺穿上帝的心

source: Whoa, Adrien...
target: 哇,阿德里安... ... 亚德里安...

source: You're basically in constant war, sandwiched between powerful old deities and... GOD?!
target: 你基本上在不断的战争, 三明治在强大的老神和... 老天爷!

source: Do you ever catch a break?!
target: 你有休息过吗?

source: I do sometimes... like right now. I enjoy the peace between battles.
target: 我有时会... 像现在一样。 我享受战斗之间的平和

source: It reminds me why I fight: so that everyone is able to sit and admire the night sky without fear or suffering in their hearts.
target: 它提醒我为什么我战斗:这样,每个人都能够坐下来崇拜夜空,而心中没有恐惧或痛苦.

source: And that's what you do tonight. But you also admire how this valiant knight remains full of determination, even against the most hopeless odds...
target: 这就是你今晚做的。 但你也钦佩这位英勇的骑士 如何仍然充满决心 即使面对最无望的机会...

source: Where he studied
target: 他学习的地方

source: I attended the most prestigious academy in the Merkingdom.
target: 我就读于默金多姆最有名的学院

source: It's exclusively available to the children of the highest-born families in all of Underwater.
target: 专供全地下水中出身最尊贵的家庭的子女使用.

source: Oooh, fancy!
target: 哦,帅呆了!

source: Yes, it certainly is.
target: 是的,当然是。

source: It accomplishes two goals.
target: 它实现了两个目标。

source: Firstly, it turns new generations of privileged merpeople into valiant knights, wise philosophers, powerful wizards, astute diplomats...
target: 首先,它把新一代的特权主义者变成了勇敢的骑士,智慧的哲学家,强大的巫师,精明的外交官......

source: Anything that can bring value to the Crown.
target: 任何能给王室带来价值的东西

source: It also keeps the most influential houses of the Merkingdom united.
target: 也使默金多姆最有影响力的家族保持了统一.

source: Like... yours?
target: 喜欢... 你的吗?

source: Exactly. I come from one of the most powerful houses from the deep end of the Merkingdom.
target: 没错 我来自最强大的房子之一 从默金多姆的深渊。

source: Ironically, the academy is such a rich, thought-provoking environment that all sort of ideas prosper.
target: 具有讽刺意味的是,学院是一个丰富而发人深省的环境,所有的想法都兴起.

source: So, while some students are blindly loyal to the Crown, you'll find a handful of them who see the downsides of our monarchy.
target: 所以,虽然有些学生盲目地忠于王室,但你们会发现少数学生会看到我们君主制的下流.

source: I've found myself sharing a table with bold minds who dare to discuss how our motherland could change and improve.
target: 我发现自己和勇敢的头脑分享了一张桌子,谁敢于讨论我们的祖国如何改变和改善.

source: I've heard quite a bit about the Merkingdom... and it definitely sounds like there's room for improvement.
target: 我听说过很多关于默金多姆的事... 听起来肯定有改进的余地

source: Yes...
But that makes me think: how come Miranda studied at our academy and not yours?
target: 但是,这让我想: 为什么? 米兰达 在我们的学院学习,而不是你的?

source: She did study at my academy. I shared some classes with Princess Miranda myself before she was transferred to an academy in the Monster Realm.
target: 她确实在我的学院学习。 我和公主同班上课 米兰达 在她被转到魔兽王国的学院之前

source: I surmise that was a tactical choice to enhance the opportunity of building alliances and coalitions with domains outside of the Merkingdom.
target: 我猜测这是一个战术选择,以增加与默金多姆以外的领域建立联盟和联盟的机会。

source: She was privileged, and annoying, and cute, and spoiled... living proof that the Merkingdom must change.
target: 她有特权 烦人 可爱 被宠坏... 活生生的证明 默金多姆必须改变

source: But I would have preferred that she stay. She could have been exposed to these daring ideas of change, and then... who knows?
target: 但我更希望她能留下来 她可能已经接触到 这些大胆的改变想法,然后... 谁知道呢?

source: True, but what better way to challenge her mind than show her how things work elsewhere?
target: 没错,但还有什么更好的方法挑战她的思想 比告诉她事情如何在别处运作?

source: Hmmm... you might be right.
target: 那个... 你也许是对的。

source: I wonder if she's capable of change...
target: 不知道她是否有能力改变...

source: I like to think everyone is, Adrien.
target: 我想每个人都是,阿德里安。

source: You two admire the night sky as you dream of a better, more just world.
target: 你们俩在梦到一个更美好、更公正的世界时 欣赏夜空

source: Being a merknight
target: 成为夜之夜

source: Truth be told, I haven't been a merknight for very long.
target: 老实说,我已经很久没玩过夜了

source: Until just recently, I was but a squire.
target: 直到最近,我只是一个侍从。

source: Oh, please, do tell!
target: 哦,求你了,告诉我!

source: Of course: I was a squire to Brigadier Beluga, and joined him on many of his quests and adventures.
target: 当然,我是贝卢加准将的侍从,并且和他一起从事他的许多探险和冒险.

source: Ah... I have such fond memories of that time, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 摆... 我对那段时间有美好的回忆 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: Brigadier Beluga was an incredible mentor. The man might appear goofy at first, but in reality he's an honorable warrior with countless victories and daring feats behind him.
target: Beluga准将是一位令人难以置信的导师。 这个人一开始可能看起来很愚蠢,但实际上他是一个光荣的战士,身后有无数的胜利和大胆的壮举.

source: He's always willing to sacrifice himself for the nation, and he firmly believes we merknights are the shield of the Merkingdom.
target: 他总是愿意为国家而牺牲自己,他坚信我们墨克奈特是默金多姆的盾牌.

source: Do you feel the same?
target: 你也有同感吗?

source: Hmmm... yes and no.
target: 那个... 是的,没有。

source: Beluga is a strong loyalist to the crown. He would see the wicked ways of those in power and blindly trust they have a good reason for it. He would always protect them.
target: 贝卢加是一位坚固的忠于王冠的人. 他看见掌权者的恶行,并且盲目信任他们,这是有道理的。 他将永远保护他们。

source: Me? I think the Merkingdom is made up of all its subjects equally.
target: 我吗? 我认为,默金多姆是 由它的所有主体平等组成。

source: I am proud to be the shield of the Merkingdom, but to me, that means being a shield for the people.
target: 我自豪地成为默金多姆的盾牌,但对我来说,这意味着成为人民的盾牌.

source: That's such a noble perspective, Adrien.
target: 这么高尚的观点,阿德里安。

source: Well, the people of the Merkingdom need a champion that fights for them too.
target: 默金多克的人民也需要一个 为他们而战的冠军

source: You two sound so different, yet you seem to truly admire Brigadier Beluga.
target: 你们俩听起来很不一样 但你们似乎很崇拜贝卢加准将

source: I do. During our travels, we used to set camp at night. The two of us in the middle of the woods, often drinking wine and talking about everything.
target: 我当然想。 在出行期间,我们经常在晚上设营. 二人于林中相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相会相

source: We had heated discussions about these political matters. We argued passionately (and a bit drunkenly) until dawn.
target: 我们对这些政治事项进行了激烈的讨论。 我们激烈地争论,直到黎明。

source: He could have me sent to the gallows easily, just by exposing my beliefs about the need for reform... and yet, here I am.
target: 他可以轻易地把我送入绞刑架 只要揭穿我对改革的信念... 然而,我在这里。

source: Instead, he listened to me, and chose to respect me even if he fully disagreed.
target: 相反,他听了我的话,并选择尊重我,即使他完全不同意。

source: So, while Brigadier Beluga would bleed for the Crown... I would bleed for him.
target: 当贝卢加准将为王室流血时... 我会为他流血的

source: It's beautiful to see you have so many kind things to say about your mentor.
target: 看到你有很多关于导师的好话 真是太美了

source: I think it says a lot not only about Brigadier Beluga, but also about you.
target: 我想它不仅说明了贝卢加准将的事 也说明了你的事

source: It's just the truth.
target: 唯实相相相.

source: You spend the rest of the night talking about Adrien's adventures as a squire. He has seen A LOT. What a humble, brave knight, this one!
target: 你整晚都在谈论阿德里安作为侍从的冒险 他已经看到很多。 多么谦卑而勇敢的骑士,这个!

source: Competitive Tarot
target: 有竞争力的塔罗牌

source: Oh, Competitive Tarot, sure!
target: 哦,有竞争力的塔罗,当然!

source: What do you wanna know? Which major arcanas are meta this season?
target: 你想知道什么吗? 本赛季哪些主要赛事是赛事?.

source: I meant it in a way more generic sense!
target: 我用更通俗的方式说!

source: I've watched a few videos about it, but I still have no clue what's happening in a match half of the time.
target: 我看过一些关于它的视频,但是我仍然不知道一半时间里 比赛中发生了什么。

source: Playing planets to gain their influences; summoning champions; doing actual tarot reads...
target: 玩行星以获得它们的影响;召唤冠军; 做真正的塔罗牌读取...

source: I get it. It can get confusing.
target: 我理解你的话 I get it. 可能会让人困惑。

source: With every expansion they add new mechanics and archetypes.
target: 每一次扩张,它们都增加了新的力学和原型.

source: The game keeps getting more complex and awesome...
target: 游戏越来越复杂和精彩...

source: ...but it admittedly gets more obscure for newcomers, too.
target: 但对于新来的人来说 情况也变得很不明了

source: But hey: git gud, right?
target: 但是,嘿,GT GUD,对不对?

source: Eh, I suspect I won't "git gud" at this anytime soon.
target: 嗯,我怀疑我不会"gitt gud"在任何时间 很快。

source: Yeah... I've looked into your future, and it's very likely you won't.
target: 对... 我调查过你的未来 很可能你不会

source: I can live with that, but I'd still love to understand why you like it so much.
target: 我可以接受 但我还是很想了解你为什么这么喜欢它

source: Well, a card game is like this hyper-complex mechanism.
target: 那么,一个纸牌游戏 就像这种超复杂的机制。

source: At first it feels a bit intimidating, but soon you start to understand how it works.
target: 起初感觉有点吓人,但很快你就会开始理解它是如何运作的.

source: Before you know it, you're thinking in terms of "tempo", "resource curves", and "card advantage". You might even build your own decks!
target: 在知道之前,你考虑的是"tempo","资源曲线"和"卡通优势". 你甚至可以造出自己的甲板来!

source: Taming such a beast and making it work in your favor feels amazing.
target: 欺负这只野兽 让它为你效劳 感觉好棒

source: But what about the most important part: believing in the heart of the cards?!
target: 但最重要的部分呢:相信牌心?

source: Well, you're actually not wrong: no matter how good you are, there's always a degree of randomness... of fate!
target: 其实你没有错 不管你有多好 总是有一定程度的随机性... 命运!

source: You never know what the next card you draw will be.
target: 你永远不知道下一张牌会是什么

source: THE HEART OF THE CARDS!!!
target: 车的心!

source: Hehe... yes.
target: 热... 对

source: Dang, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, this much tarot talk is making me wanna play a match...
target: 唐,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, 这么多塔罗牌的谈话 让我想玩一个比赛...

source: C'mon, what do you say? I can teach you as we go.
target: 来吧,你说什么? 我可以教你们,我们走。

source: Sure, why not?
target: 当然,为什么不呢?

source: You two spend the rest of the night playing Competitive Tarot matches.
target: 你们俩整晚都在玩有竞争力的塔罗牌比赛

source: Hope kicks your ass big time, but she's patient, and you actually learn a bit more about how the game works.
target: 不过她很有耐心,你更了解游戏的原理。

source: The whole Damien thing
target: 整个 达米恩 东西

source: "The whole Damien thing"... that's a way to put it, huh?
target: 整个 达米恩 东西... 这么说吧,哈?

source: I mean, I've noticed he has... or at least HAD this sort of big crush for you... what's the story there?
target: 我是说,我注意到他... 或至少有这种大 迷恋你... 里面有什么故事吗?

source: It's your classic teenage love story:
target: 这是你的典型的青少年爱情故事:

source: Girl is experimenting with her recently-awakened magic powers.
target: 女孩正在实验她最近意识到的魔法力量.

source: Girl sends herself to Hell and somehow ends up at an infernal palace.
target: 女孩把自己送入地狱 不知何故在地狱中

source: Boy is the Prince of that part of Hell.
target: 男孩是地狱的王子

source: Girl and boy lock eyes.
target: 女孩和男孩锁起眼睛。

source: Then there's a slow dance; a first kiss; lots of new, intense, complicated emotions...
target: 然后是慢舞;初吻;很多新的,激烈的,复杂的情绪......

source: And after that? Time happens, things fade, and people move on.
target: 在那之后呢? And after that? 那之后呢? 时间发生,事物消逝,人们继续前进.

source: Oh...
No, it's okay, that's how these things go. Teenage love burns bright, but it doesn't tend to last.
target: 不,没关系,这些事情就是这样进行的。 少年相爱会燃烧出光芒,但往往不会持续.

source: And that's beautiful too.
target: 那也太美丽了

source: Sure... but I don't think Damien ever got the memo about the not-lasting part, huh?
target: 当然... 但我不认为 达米恩 曾经得到备忘录 关于不持久部分,是吧?

source: Ha! Yeah...
It's a shame, because... look, the dude's an idiot, but it's not his fault that he's having such a hard time moving on.
target: 可惜,因为... 听着,这家伙是个白痴, 但他有这么困难的 前进不是他的错。

source: If only it was that easy for two people to be in the same place emotionally...
target: 如果两个人在感情上能在同一地段 就这么简单就好了...

source: I guess sometimes people grow apart, they drift away... they become different people.
target: 我想有时候人们会分道扬镳 他们会飘走... 他们变成了不同的人。

source: Still, I cherish our memories together, you know? Damien will always be an important chapter of my life... but one that I finished long ago.
target: 不过,我珍惜我们的记忆 在一起,你知道吗?  达米恩 永远是我人生中的重要篇章... 但它是一个我很久以前完成的。

source: I hope he starts an exciting new chapter of his own, too.
target: 我希望他也开始一个激动人心的新篇章

source: But hey, enough about me. Tell me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, do you have any Damiens in your past or what?
target: 但是,嘿,够了关于我。 告诉我 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%,你有没有 达米恩是在你的过去还是什么?

source: And so you spend the rest of the night exchanging corny love stories from your pasts.
target: 所以你用剩下的时间 来交换你过去那些无聊的爱情故事

source: The Coven
target: 巫师

source: Ugh... the Coven...
target: 唉哟... 巫师...

source: You don't like the Coven? I thought you were friends!
target: 你不喜欢巫师吗? 我以为你是朋友!

source: It's not that. I'd die for Faith and Joy.
target: 不是那样的。 我会为信仰和欢乐而死。

source: (I mean... I've technically died for them already.)
target: 我是说... 我从技术上说已经为他们牺牲了. "

source: But they're Faith and Joy; my best friends.
target: 但是他们是信仰和欢乐,我最好的朋友。

source: The Coven is more than that, y'know?
target: 巫师不止如此,知道吗?

source: It's our timeless duty; our inescapable fate...
target: 这是我们无时无刻的责任;我们不可逃避的命运......

source: ...it's basically our job.
target: ...这基本上是我们的工作。

source: And you know what, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? I believe in the importance of being more than your career.
target: 你知道吗,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%? 我相信做人比做你的事业更重要

source: Even if your career is "protector of all reality".
target: 即使你的事业是"所有现实的保护者"

source: Fair!
target: 公平点!

source: Then tell me, who is Hope beyond "a member of the Coven"?
target: 那告诉我 除了"巫师"还有谁是希望?

source: That's more like it!
target: 这才像话!

source: I play Competitive Tarot; I do some side-hustles here and there; I love the fun and thrill of getting myself in trouble.
target: 我扮演有竞争力的塔罗;我在这里和那里做一些侧壳;我喜欢让自己陷入麻烦的乐趣和刺激。

source: While Joy and Faith are researching a Big Bad, I'm the one that gets to have a fun subplot in the 4th Circle of Hell.
target: Joy和Faith在研究一个大坏蛋的时候 我才是那个在地狱第四圈里 拥有一个有趣的副片的人

source: That sounds risky... but fun.
target: 这听起来很冒险... 但乐趣。

source: Yes: in the Coven, I'm definitely the one who's fun.
target: 是: 在"巫统"里,我绝对是那个很有趣的人.

source: Sometimes I try to push those two out of their comfort zones and away from all the Coven stuff.
target: 有时我试图把这两个人 推出他们的舒适地带 并远离所有 科文的东西。

source: Stuff like "Girls' Night Out", "Drunk Minigolf", or "Death Dance in the Dark Domains".
target: 类似"少女之夜出道","醉倒迷你高尔夫","黑暗域中去死之舞"等.

source: Whoa... those definitely do NOT sound like the kind of things Faith or Joy would do.
target: 珃... 他们绝对不像 信仰或乔伊会做的事

source: Exactly!
target: 没错!

source: Faith is lovely, and the voice of reason, but she could use some thrill every now and then.
target: 信仰是可爱的, 和理性的声音, 但她可以需要一些刺激 时而。

source: And Joy? Best leader ever, but half the time she's too bossy... and the other half she's hella stressed.
target: 乔伊呢? 有史以来最好的领导, 但一半的时间,她太专横... 而另一半 她的地狱压力。

source: I've noticed.
target: 我已经注意到了。

source: Yeah... so that's me: the one who manages to have a personal life and does her best to help those two have one as well.
target: 对... 所以这就是我: 一个能过上个人生活 并尽力帮助那两个人的人, 也有一个。

source: Hope, you know what? That sounds fun, but also very necessary.
target: 希望,你知道吗? 这听起来很有趣,但也非常必要。

source: I think so too. A "Girls' Night Out" every now and then is what keeps us from losing our minds from the high stakes we face day after day.
target: 我也这么认为。 "女孩之夜出" 时不时地 阻止我们从我们日复一日面对的 重大利益中失去理智

source: I know I'm not saving the world constantly... but I'd be down for one of those plans one day...
target: 我知道我不是在不停地拯救世界... 但我总有一天会参与其中的一个计划...

source: Oh! Sure! I'm always down for some Drunk Minigolf.
target: 哦 当然! 我总喜欢喝醉的迷你高尔夫
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: For the next few hours, Hope tells you what alcohols are best for Drunk Minigolf.
target: 在接下来的几个小时里,希望告诉你什么酒精最适合醉酒迷你高尔夫.

source: Magic
target: 魔术

source: Magic... it can get boring because it involves lots of studying...
target: 魔术... 它会变得无聊,因为它涉及很多学习...

source: ...but it's also very cool, because it lets you make things explode. Kaboom!
target: 但它也非常酷,因为它让你 使事情爆炸。 Kab!

source: That sounds dangerous...
target: 这听起来很危险... ...

source: Well, danger IS my thing.
target: 嗯,危险是我的事。

source: Like... it's not as if we're limited to specific spells, but each of us surely has their strengths.
target: 喜欢... 我们并不局限于特定的咒语, 但是我们每个人都肯定有他们的长处。

source: I focus on my visions, all sorts of dangerous spells, and what we could call "attack" magic. I'm the glass cannon of the Coven!
target: 我专注于我的视觉,各种危险的咒语,以及我们可以称之为"攻击"的魔法. 我是巫师的玻璃大炮!

source: Faith is more of an "out of combat" witch. She specializes in healing and utility spells.
target: 信仰更是一个"脱离战斗"的女巫. 她专门研究治疗和功用咒语.

source: Joy is quite proficient at most things, but her specialty is defensive magic.
target: 乔伊在大多数事情上相当熟练,但她的特长是防御魔法.

source: She's also the one with the strongest connection to the Goddess.
target: 她也是与女神关系最紧密的一位.

source: What's the deal with that?
target: 这是怎么回事?

source: With the Goddess? Well, for starters, she isn't technically a goddess.
target: 和女神一起吗? 首先 她从技术上讲不是女神

source: (As a matter of fact, almost all things that call themselves "deities" tend not to be, in technical terms.)
target: (事实上,几乎所有自称"神"的事物,在技术方面都往往不是. )

source: Then... what's this Goddess if not a goddess?
target: 那麽... 如果不是女神,这个女神是什么?

source: It's complicated, and I'm not too clear on it myself, but I think it's like a collective consciousness of past Coven witches who live in some sort of immaterial plane.
target: 这很复杂,我自己也不太清楚,但我觉得这就像过去巫师的集体意识,他们生活在某种无关紧要的平面上.

source: ALL the past Coven witches?
target: 所有过去的巫师?

source: No idea. Maybe some? Just the first ones? Eh... magic stuff tends to be super obscure. It's pretty annoying.
target: 不知道,我还不知道呢。 也许一些? 就第一个吗? 额... 神奇的东西往往是超模糊的。 这很烦人。

source: What matters is that the Goddess is a good ally to have in our corner. She knows lots of stuff and gives very decent advice.
target: 重要的是,女神是一个很好的盟友 在我们的角落。 她知道很多东西 并给出非常体面的建议。

source: The Coven's virtual assistant!
target: 巫统的虚拟助手!

source: Don't let Joy hear you say that... but basically.
target: 别让乔伊听到你这么说... 但基本上说

source: Hope...
Yes?
target: 是吗?

source: Can you show me the spells that make things explode?
target: 你能给我看那些使事情爆炸的咒语吗?

source: NOW you're asking the right questions. Let's get to it!
target: 现在你问对问题了 让我们开始吧!

source: And so begins a beautiful night full of bombastic pyrotechnics. Kaboom!
target: 然后开始了一个美丽的夜晚 充满了炸弹的烟花。 Kab!

source: Office Life
target: 办公室生活

source: Hmmm... I actually don't work in the office that often anymore.
target: 那个... 其实我不再经常在办公室工作了

source: Being Mr. Pappas' personal assistant and all...
target: 做为先生 帕帕斯的私人助手和所有...

source: Do you miss working in the office?
target: 你想念在办公室工作吗?

source: Well, both jobs were sort of shitty in their own unique ways.
target: 两种工作都以自己独特的方式很烂

source: Yikes.
target: 唉哟!

source: In the office I didn't have to carry a heavy throne with my boss on it...
target: 在办公室里,我不用带着一个重的宝座 上面有我的老板...

source: Which was... an upside, right?
target: 这是... 一个反面,对不对?

source: Heh... yes, it was.
target: 哦... 是的,这是。

source: But doing a routine spreadsheet-based job in an office can get old fast.
target: 但是在一个办公室里做一个例行的基于电子表格的工作可以快速变老.

source: You input numbers for full hours... full days... full weeks...
target: 你输入全小时的号码... 满日... 整整几周...

source: Soon the numbers start losing their meaning...
target: 数字很快就失去意义了...

source: ...and they become these mysterious symbols you inscribe here as some sort of mysterious ritual.
target: ...它们成为了这些神秘的标志 你在这里写作某种神秘的仪式。

source: The ritual of... finance!
target: 仪式... 财经!

source: Sort of, yes.
target: 有点,是的。

source: It can be incredibly dull and numbing.
target: 它可能令人难以置信地无聊和麻木。

source: On the other hand... it can also be soothing. The unexpected ASMR of fingers pressing keys, of numbers filling cells...
target: 另一方面... 也可以是安抚。 意外的ASMR 手指按键,数字填充单元格...

source: Working in an office also has the upside of having coworkers.
target: 在一个办公室工作也有拥有同事的优势.

source: Were you friends with your coworkers?
target: 你们是同事的朋友吗?

source: I don't know about friends... I wouldn't meet any of them for coffee these days.
target: 我不知道关于朋友... 这些天我都不和他们一起喝咖啡了

source: But we were a tight squad. They may not have been "friends" exactly, but we were... comrades.
target: 但我们是一个很紧张的团队。 他们可能不是"朋友" 但我们是... 同志们

source: We had our little games and traditions that saved us all from terminal boredom.
target: 我们有我们的小游戏和传统 使我们所有人都免于终极无聊。

source: Oh, no! Not death by yawn!
target: 哦,没有! 不是因为打哈欠而死的!

source: You know it!
target: 笵

source: And so we fought against it with dumb little office competitions, secret gambling on menial things... or Crazy Hat Thursdays!
target: 于是我们用愚蠢的小办公室比赛 秘密赌博来对抗它... 或疯狂的帽子周四!

source: Crazy Hat Thursdays? I need to know more about that!
target: 疯狂的帽子周四? 我需要知道更多关于这一点!

source: Happy to oblige.
target: 乐意效劳

source: Finn shows you some of his best looks for Crazy Hat Thursday while you two listen to some Office ASMR. What a nice night!
target: Finn给你看他周四的"疯狂帽子" 最好的外表 而你们两个听一些办公室ASMR。 真是个美好的夜晚!

source: The Merkingdom
target: 默金多姆

source: So, I heard you say in the car that you're from the Merkingdom?
target: 我听说你在车里说你是默金多克人?

source: Yeah, I was born there... but I got out the minute I had the chance.
target: 对,我出生在那里... 但我一有机会就出去了

source: I get you. I've heard... not-so-great things about that place.
target: 我理解你,我爱她 I get you. 我听说过... 那地方可没那么好

source: Exactly.
target: 没错

source: I moved Abovewater, looking to be my own person.
target: 我移动了上水, 寻找我自己的人。

source: Rent an apartment; have a career; maybe even start a business... you know, the Abovewater Dream.
target: 租公寓,有事业,甚至创业... 你知道,水上梦。

source: But maaaaaan, after these few years, I'm not sure if I can call it a "dream" anymore.
target: 但是,maaaaan,在这几年之后,我不确定我是否可以把它称为"梦"了.

source: Abovewater grinds you in thankless jobs for pennies, always under the promise of bright futures that never come.
target: 上水会把你磨成一文不值的活儿 永远以永不来的未来为承诺

source: Tell me about it!
target: 告诉我!

source: They milk your dreams to push the limits of what's acceptable for a job.
target: 他们挤出你的梦想 来推 极限什么是可以接受的工作。

source: You go over forty hours a week, and you still somehow end up on an instant noodles diet.
target: 你每周要花40多个小时 最终还是吃一顿面条

source: Like... If I hear one more person tell me I don't have my dream job yet because I'm not "trying hard enough", I will cave their heads in with a hammer.
target: 喜欢... 如果我再听到一个人说,我还没有做梦的工作,因为我还没有"努力地努力",我会用锤子打倒他们的头.

source: Yikes... I'm sorry the Abovewater didn't live up to your expectations...
target: 哎哟... 对不起,上面的水没有满足你的期望...

source: Nah, it's not like it's your fault!
target: 不,这不是你的错!

source: If anything, I'm sorry for venting.
target: 如果有什么,我很抱歉 通风。

source: It's okay. I can see why you might have some pent-up frustration!
target: 没关系。 我理解为什么你可能会有些沮丧!

source: Look, in the end, Abovewater still beats an authoritarian monarchy that's trigger-happy with public executions and whatnot.
target: 看,最后,上水仍然击败一个专制的君主制国家,它与公开处决,什么的,都是令人高兴的.

source: But it's like when you live by yourself for the first time...
target: 但就像你第一次一个人生活的时候...

source: You're so excited to be on your own that ANYTHING does the trick.
target: 你这么兴奋 独自一个人, 任何事情都做诡计。

source: Your first apartment may very well be a hole in a wall.
target: 你的第一个公寓很可能是墙上的一个洞。

source: But by your third apartment, you realize you'd prefer a place with good lighting. On your fifth apartment, you learn you want central heating. And so on.
target: 但在你第三所公寓里 你会发现你更喜欢有良好照明的地方 在你的第五所公寓里 你学会了要中央暖气 等诸相.

source: That was me: I just wanted to escape the Vanderbilt regime, at any cost.
target: 这就是我:我只是想不惜一切代价逃离范德比尔特政权。

source: Today, I realize Abovewater could... still do better?
target: 今天,我意识到水上可以... 还是做得更好吗?

source: My man, I can assure you that I wholeheartedly agree.
target: 我向你保证,我完全同意

source: Who knows... maybe one day things will improve.
target: 谁知道... 也许有一天事情会好转。

source: Yeah, maybe... or maybe we should start searching for a third, better place to live... like Finland!
target: 是啊,也许... 或者我们该开始寻找第三个更好的地方... 像芬兰一样!

source: You two spend the rest of the night searching information about Finland. Apparently, it's the country with the most heavy metal bands per capita!
target: 有关芬兰的更多信息,请访问InfoFinland上的芬兰。 显然,这是全国拥有最重的金属乐队的人均!

source: His job
target: 他的工作是怎样的?

source: Well, I'm Mr. Pappas' personal assistant.
target: 嗯,我是先生。 额,我是先生。 帕帕斯的私人助手。

source: So... you... assist his personality?
target: 所以说... 你们... 帮助他的个性?

source: ...You have no idea what a personal assistant is, do you?
target: 你不知道什么是私人助理,是吗?

source: ...Maybe not. Explain it to me as if I had no idea.
target: ...也许不是。 跟我解释一下,好像我不知道一样

source: Sure.
target: 当然可以。

source: I devote myself to optimize Mr. Pappas' day-to-day life.
target: 我致力于优化先生。 帕帕斯的日常生活

source: From arranging meetings to organizing his schedule.
target: 从安排会议到安排日程

source: And many more things!
target: 还有很多事情!

source: It sounds like you liked the job!
target: 听起来你喜欢这份工作!

source: Yes, I do!
target: 是的,我会的!

source: I mean... Mr. Pappas is a HORRIBLE boss.
target: 我是说... 劳伦斯先生 帕帕斯是个可怕的老板。

source: But I like being a PA.
target: 但我喜欢当PA

source: Ideally, you work for someone you respect and admire, making their success your mission.
target: 理想的是,你为一个你尊敬和钦佩的人工作,使他们的成功成为你的使命.

source: It's like being the right hand to a valiant hero or a powerful commander.
target: 这就像一个勇敢的英雄或强大的指挥官的右手。

source: You help them reach their full potential.
target: 你帮助他们实现他们的全部潜力。

source: Sounds like a noble endeavor.
target: 听起来像一个崇高的努力。

source: It is.
target: 没错

source: But alas... I'm stuck with Mr. Pappas...
target: 但是,对不起... 我被卡住与先生吗? 帕帕斯 帕帕斯 帕帕斯 帕帕斯 帕帕斯

source: ...a dumb, greedy tyrant who's inexplicably obsessed with shopping malls.
target: ...一个愚蠢而贪婪的暴君, 他令人费解地沉迷于购物中心。

source: Jeez.
target: 天呐

source: Yeah... my main task is to carry him in a big-ass throne.
target: 对... 我的主要任务就是把他抬到一个大王位上

source: Dang, Finn...
target: 该死,芬恩...

source: How's... your back?
target: 怎么样... 你的背吗?

source: Not good.
target: 情况不妙。

source: I think I can help with that, if you're game.
target: 如果你玩了,我想我可以帮忙

source: You spend the rest of the night chatting while you give Finn a massage. His back is basically made of knots. Poor soul.
target: 你晚上闲聊 给Finn按摩 他的后背基本上是由结接而成的. 可怜的灵魂。

source: His hobbies
target: 他的爱好

source: Hmmm... I love going to the arcade late at night, when I have the chance.
target: 那个... 我喜欢深夜去游乐场 当我有机会的时候

source: Late night arcade?!
target: 深夜游乐场?

source: Yeah. I get burnt out from work, so sometimes I need to hit the streets in order to not lose my head.
target: 对 我从工作里被烧焦了,所以有时我需要去上街,以免失去理智.

source: Finn hitting the streets!
target: 费恩在街上打人!

source: Heh, yes... it sounded a little corny, didn't it?
target: 对... 听起来有点老套,不是吗?

source: Just a bit, but in a good way!
target: 只是一点点,但有一个好的方式!

source: The thing is, I need some activity that lets me release all the stress I've built up during the week.
target: 问题是,我需要一些活动 让我释放我在这个星期积聚的所有压力

source: Something fun, but also very high-energy.
target: 有趣的东西,但也非常高能

source: The arcade... laser tag... karaoke...
target: 游乐场... 激光标记... 卡拉OK 卡拉OK 卡拉OK

source: Nothing beats getting tipsy and trying to beat the high scores at DDR.
target: 没有什么比醉酒和试图打倒DDR的高分好。

source: Or going to karaoke with my coworkers and screaming my lungs out along to a good heavy metal song.
target: 或者和同事一起唱卡拉OK 大声叫喊我的肺 一起唱出一首好重的金属歌

source: Wow, Finn! I wouldn't have expected that from you!
target: 哇,费恩! 我没想到你会这样!

source: Ha! And you still haven't seen me drunk-dancing!
target: 你还没见过我醉舞!

source: And let me tell you: I hold half of the high scores at the arcade, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 让我告诉你,我持有一半的高分 在街机,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%。

source: Whaaaaa... you mean I'm sitting here... with a celebrity?
target: 哇,哇,哇,哇,哇,哇... 你是说我坐在这里... 和名人一起吗?

source: Well, depending on who you ask... yes!
target: 嗯,取决于你问谁... 没错!

source: (Just kidding.)
target: (只是开玩笑。)

source: Don't sell yourself short!
target: 别把自己卖了!

source: Anyway... I've had so many good nights... dancing 'til dawn, or hearing all my peers roar when I hit an impossible note... I love it.
target: 总之... 我有过很多美好的夜晚... 跳舞直到黎明 或者听到我的同龄人咆哮 当我打出一个不可能的音符... 我喜欢它。

source: I can tell! You have a twinkle in your eye when you talk about it.
target: 我看得出来! 你说话的时候眼睛有闪闪发光

source: Yeah. Like... it's my dream to grow as a personal assistant, and I spend way too many hours at the office...
target: 对 喜欢... 我梦想成为私人助理 我花了太多时间在办公室...

source: ...but it feels good to be something other than just my job, y'know?
target: ...但做别的事感觉很好 不只是我的工作,你知道吗?

source: Finn is so exhausted half of the time that you never imagined seeing such a fire in his soul. What an interesting fella...
target: 芬恩耗尽了一半的时间 你从未想象到他的灵魂里有这么一团火. 真是个有趣的家伙...

source: How to run a cult
target: 如何管理邪教

source: Uhm, that's a good question.
target: 嗯,这是一个很好的问题。

source: Running a cult is full of challenges!
target: 经营邪教组织充满了挑战!

source: I can only imagine! Convincing all those people to abandon their lives just to worship you like a deity...
target: 我只能想象 说服所有那些人放弃他们的生活 只是为了像神一样崇拜你...
notes: Argos en_zh 1.9; requires review; sanitized; sanitized

source: Oh, no, that part is actually quite easy.
target: 哦,不,那部分其实相当容易。

source: For some reason I keep walking into people who are ready to devote their lives to me.
target: 出于某种原因,我一直走进那些愿意为我奉献生命的人中间。

source: I knew I was charming, but not THAT charming!
target: 我知道我很迷人,但没那么迷人!

source: Even your biggest foes can become faithful followers!
target: 即使你最大的敌人也能成为忠实的追随者!

source: (If you hit them hard enough.)
target: 如果你打得够狠的话

source: Taking notes here.
target: 在这里做笔记。

source: Besides that, the hard part is keeping the helpless little cultists alive and appeased.
target: 除此之外,困难的部分是让无助的小邪教活下来并安抚.

source: Did you know that they need food and sleep EVERY DAY?
target: 你知道他们每天需要食物和睡眠吗?

source: No way!
target: 不会吧!

source: And they're always hanging around piles of poop and vomit! It's like they WANT to get sick and die!
target: 他们总是在一堆大便和呕吐物上晃来晃去 就像他们想生病和死亡一样!

source: Um, I'm sorry, did you say "piles of poop"?
target: 嗯,对不起,你是不是说"大便"?

source: Oh, yeah. You don't even want to KNOW about all the poop cleanup.
target: 哦,对了。 你甚至不想知道 所有的粪便清理。

source: Nobody ever warns you how much poop one cult can produce.
target: 没有人会警告你 一个邪教能产生多大的便便

source: Yikes. I guess being a cult leader isn't all glitz and glamor.
target: 唉哟! 我猜做一个邪教领袖 并不是所有的滑翔和魅力。

source: You betcha, my friend.
target: 当然,我的朋友。

source: But you know what? I love my little flock. I'd clean all the poop in the world for them.
target: 但是你知道吗? 我爱我的小羊群。 我愿意为他们清理世界上所有的粪便。

source: That's so sweet of you.
target: 你真贴心

source: It's the least I can do. I mean, they're willing to give their lives for me (and many of them probably will).
target: 至少我能做到这一点。 我的意思是,他们愿意为我献出自己的生命(其中许多人很可能会).

source: Why this sudden interest in cult leadership, though?
target: 为什么突然对邪教的领导感兴趣呢?

source: I just want to keep my career options open! You never know.
target: 我只是想保持我的职业选择权! 你永远不知道。

source: Oh, your own cult? That sounds fun!
target: 哦,你自己的邪教吗? 这听起来很有趣!

source: Our cults could even become friends.
target: 我们的邪教甚至可以成为朋友。

source: (Otherwise I may have to bring destruction upon you.)
target: (否则我可能会给你带来毁灭)

source: Duly noted.
target: 都记下来了

source: You two keep talking about the hardships and challenges of running a cult.
target: 你们两个一直在谈论 经营邪教的艰难和挑战

source: The Lamb seems like such a good cult leader that, for a moment, you consider becoming a cult follower instead of a cult leader.
target: 羔羊似乎是一个很好的邪教领袖,在一瞬间,你考虑成为邪教追随者而不是邪教领袖.

source: Cult rituals
target: 宗教仪式

source: Oooh, rituals are some of the most fun you can have while being in a cult!
target: 哦,仪式是你们在邪教中可以享受的最乐趣!

source: Especially considering most of the other activities are either "hard labor", "hours of prayer", or "dying."
target: 特别是考虑到其他大多数活动要么是"艰苦劳动","祈祷时数",要么是"去死".

source: I mean... some of the rituals also include dying; but the fun kind!
target: 我是说... 有的仪式也包括去死;有的则是取乐之类!

source: Eh... okay. What are some other rituals you do without the "dying" bit?
target: 额... 还好。 没有"去死"的仪式是什么?

source: Well, there's bonfires, feasts, funerals, holy days of rest...
target: 嗯,有篝火,宴会,葬礼,神圣的休息日...

source: ...fighting pits, necromantic resurrections, sacrifices of the flesh...
target: ...战斗坑, 阴道复活, 牺牲肉体...

source: Wait, no, I'm pretty sure that last one involves dying.
target: 等等,不,我敢肯定,最后一个涉及死亡。

source: Yeah, it sounds like it.
target: 是啊,听起来像它。

source: But does it involve the fun kind of "dying", though?
target: 但它是否涉及 有趣的类型"死亡",虽然?

source: Totally!
target: 绝对!

source: A big tentacle erupts from the ground and gives a big, warm hug to the follower.
target: 一只大触手从地上喷出并给跟随者一个大而温暖的拥抱.

source: The follower is all like "Aaaaaaaaah!", which you know is a fun sound, because it's the same sound you'd make if you were riding a roller coaster!
target: 追随者都像"Aaaaaaaaaah!",你知道这是一个有趣的声音,因为如果你骑起过山车,你会发出同样的声音!

source: And the tentacle is all like "(UNINTELLIGIBLE SCREECHING ELDRITCH NOISES)".
target: 触手就像"(UNINTELIGILIBLECH CHELDRICH NOISES)"。

source: Fun!
target: 开心!

source: Eh... ah... well, the feasts and the bonfires surely sound like a good time!
target: 额... 摆... 好了,宴会和篝火 听起来确实像一个好时机!

source: Yay! I can teach you some of the lyrics to the chanting we do. It involves a lot of arcane forbidden languages... and repeating my name a lot!
target: 赞! 我可以教你一些歌词 歌词我们做。 它涉及到很多的 北极的被禁语言... 经常重复我的名字!

source: Sounds like a plan!
target: 听起来像一个计划!

source: You spend the rest of the night learning cult chanting. The Lamb even improvises a bonfire and you do some silly ritual dancing together. And you know what? It IS fun!
target: 你整晚都在学习邪教的口号 羔羊甚至即兴的篝火 你们一起做一些愚蠢的仪式 你知道吗? 这很有趣!

source: Building the cult headquarters
target: 建立邪教组织总部

source: Building out the headquarters took FOREVER. But we've come a long way!
target: 建立总部 永远没有。 但我们已经走了很长的路!

source: When we started out, we were just a group of poor, starving souls in sleeping bags.
target: 当我们开始的时候,我们只是一群穷困,饿死的灵魂在睡袋里.

source: Morale was low, and poop levels were high.
target: 士气低落,而大便含量也很高.

source: So I asked myself, "What would make this poor, hungry flock of mine happy?" And then it came to me!
target: 于是我问自己:"什么能让这群可怜的,饥饿的我的羊群快乐?"然后它来到我身边!

source: They needed a huge statue of me to pray to every day!
target: 他们需要一个巨大的雕像 我每天祈祷!

source: Did it work?
target: 有用吗?

source: I think so! They sure chant at that statue a lot.
target: 我想是这样! 他们经常在雕像上高呼口号

source: That made me think: "Why stop at a big statue of myself?"
target: 这让我想:"为什么停在我自己的大雕像上?"

source: So I built a whole chapel for the followers to gather and listen to my holy word.
target: 于是我为追随者建造了一座完整的礼拜堂来聚集并聆听我的圣言.

source: They LOVE listening to my sermons. And sometimes there's even sacrifices!
target: 他们喜欢听我的布道 有时甚至有牺牲!

source: You spoil them!
target: 你宠坏他们了!

source: Hehe, those little rascals deserve that and more!
target: 嘿,这些小流氓 罪有应得!

source: Anyway, once I covered those basic necessities, I could move on to building less important structures, such as a cooking fire or a healing bay.
target: 总之,一旦我解决了这些基本必需品,我就可以着手建造一些不太重要的建筑,如烹饪用火或疗伤湾等。

source: Whoa, your headquarters doesn't sound half bad. I may end up moving there.
target: 哇,你的总部听起来还不错 我可能最终会搬到那里。

source: You're always welcome, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. The only price is eternal worship.
target: 你总是欢迎, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 唯一的代价是永远的崇拜。

source: And this is only the beginning. I wonder what new structures I can build now that I've covered all the essentials. Some sort of fun building perhaps...
target: 这仅仅是开始。 我不知道现在我能建造什么新结构 因为我已经覆盖了所有的基本。 某种有趣的建筑,也许...

source: Ooh, like a nightclub! Nightclubs are fun!
target: 哦,像一个夜总会! 夜总会很有趣!

source: Hmm, I was thinking more in the vein of demonic summoning circles and confession booths and statues made of the bones of my enemies...
target: 嗯,我更想的是 恶魔召唤圈 忏悔亭和雕像 由我的敌人的骨骼...

source: But a nightclub could be cool too!
target: 但夜总会也不错!

source: How many bones do you think I'd need to build one?
target: 你以为我需要多少骨头来造一个?

source: No idea. Let's figure that one out!
target: 不知道,我还不知道呢。 让我们想出一个!

source: You and the Lamb spend the rest of the night planning the new nightclub. It turns out you'll need a LOT of bones.
target: 你和"羔羊"一起过夜 策划新夜总会 事实证明你需要很多骨头

source: Doctrine
target: 理论

source: Ah, yeah, being an all-powerful cult leader isn't all fun and games and murder!
target: 啊,是的,作为一个全能的邪教领袖 不是所有的乐趣和游戏和谋杀!

source: Sometimes, I have to use my brain.
target: 有时候,我必须用我的大脑。

source: I can only imagine, with so many followers looking up to you.
target: 我只能想象, 这么多的追随者 仰望着你。

source: Totally! They kneel before me and go: "O almighty Lamb, enlighten us with your timeless wisdom".
target: 绝对! 他们跪在我面前说:万能的羔羊啊!你应当以你的智慧启示我们。

source: Way to put me on the spot, guys!
target: 如何把我放在现场,伙计们!

source: That's why I have these tablets.
target: 这就是为什么我有这些平板电脑。

source: Huh, yeah, I was actually curious about them. How do they work exactly?
target: 嗯,是的,其实我很好奇他们。 他们到底怎么工作的?

source: Well, I carry them around and write my doctrines there when I'm in a thinky mood.
target: 好吧,我带着它们到处走, 写我的理论在那里 当我有思想的心情。

source: My guys will do ANYTHING these tablets tell them to do!
target: 我的人会做任何事情 这些平板上让他们做的!

source: Really?
target: 真的吗?

source: Yeah! Like, one time I came back from an adventure and everyone was starving!
target: 对! 有一次我从一次冒险中回来 大家都在挨饿!

source: They're all like, "Bwaaa, we're hungry! If you're so all-powerful, why don't you make us a delicious fish bowl? We're tired of eating grass!"
target: 他们都说:"布瓦阿,我们饿了! 如果你这么全能,为什么不给我们做个美味的鱼碗呢? 我们厌倦吃草了!"

source: Everyone is a food critic these days, amirite?
target: 现在每个人都是食品评论家吗?

source: Yup. So I go over to the temple, I declare a 3-day ritual fast, and BOOM! Suddenly everybody's happy as a clam!
target: 对 所以我去庙会,我宣布一个3天的仪式快,还有BOOM! 突然间大家都像只蛤蛤一样快乐!

source: Wow!
target: 哗!

source: Well, not everybody. There was this follower who was plotting to murder me.
target: 嗯,不是每个人。 有个追随者想谋杀我

source: I'm blessing him every day, and there he is, spouting hatred... through a megaphone! Like... really?
target: 我每天都在祝福他,而他在那里, 喷出仇恨... 通过扩音器! 喜欢... 真的吗?

source: Rude!
target: 鲁德!

source: And then it hits me: of course, the tablets!
target: 然后它打我: 当然,平板电脑!

source: I get one of them and I write "Sacrificing a follower is A-OK".
target: 我得到了其中之一,我写"牺牲一个追随者是A -OK"。

source: Then I grab my knife and RIP! SLASH! SPLATTER!
target: 然后,我拿起我的刀 和RIP! SLASH(英语:SLSH)! 开枪!

source: The sounds are meant to be murder sounds. I murdered him.
target: 这些声音是谋杀的声音。 我杀了他。

source: Yeah, I got that. Dang, you play hard, don't you?
target: 是的,我得到了这一点。 该死,你玩得挺硬的,不是吗?

source: You betcha! And with these tablets I also play smart! No more traitors and the followers had no issue with it since it was all within the doctrines.
target: 当然了! 用这些平板电脑,我也会玩聪明的! 不再有叛徒和追随者对它有任何异议,因为这一切都属于理论范畴。

source: Ah, if only I could use the tablets to teach my followers how to cook...
target: 啊,如果我能用平板电脑 教我的追随者如何烹饪...

source: I guess there're miracles even the Lamb can't perform!
target: 我猜有奇迹 即使是羔羊也不能表演!

source: Oh, whatever! I can just tell them to eat each other! Hehe!
target: 哦,随便啦! 我可以叫他们互相吃东西! 热!

source: You spend the rest of the night learning about the Cult's doctrine. You hope the Lamb doesn't resort to cannibalism just yet: it'd be nice to visit and not be part of the menu.
target: 你彻夜学习邪教的教义 你希望羔羊不要采取吃人的做法, 只是:这是很好的参观,而不是成为菜单的一部分。

source: Death
target: 死亡情况

source: You want to talk about death? That's heavy, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!
target: 你想谈论死亡吗? 这很重, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%!

source: You can say I'm not your standard conversationalist!
target: 你可以说我不是你的标准对话家!

source: (Some say it's part of my charm.)
target: (有人说这是我魅力的一部分)

source: Fair!
target: 公平点!

source: I know a thing or two about death: I've been sacrificed, bled out, mangled, eaten, burnt to a crisp, crushed by a giant frog tongue...
target: 我知道一两件事 关于死亡: 我牺牲了,流血出血, 被干燥,被吃,被烧成焦土,被一个巨大的青蛙舌头压碎... ...

source: Ouch.
target: 哎哟。

source: Ouch indeed.
target: 哦,确实。

source: But at least I can come back after I die. My followers don't have that luxury.
target: 但至少我死后可以回来 我的追随者没有那种奢侈

source: Ah, a cult member dying is never good news, my friend.
target: 啊,一个邪教成员死了 永远不会是好消息,我的朋友。

source: For one, seeing a corpse really kills my living followers' vibes.
target: 首先,看到一具尸体 真正杀死了我活着的追随者的气息。

source: If that wasn't enough, dead people smell! Did you know?
target: 如果还不够的话,死人会闻到的! 你知道吗?

source: I've noticed.
target: 我已经注意到了。

source: Yeah... it was a big improvement the day I discovered you could actually bury the corpses to cover the smell.
target: 对... 那天我发现你能够埋下尸体 以掩盖气味 这是一种很大的改进

source: But wanna know a little trick?

target: "授权是没有羞耻的,gurl。 这可能需要一些信任, 但总比测试什么好 维拉 奥伯林的突破点是".

source: Delegating...

target: 问题通常在于其他人...

target: 尽管如此,我非常怀疑 解决我控制问题的方法 是控制更多的东西。

target: 在有人帮助我解决控制问题之前, 我有8个不同的电子表格要更新。

source: What she's done this summer

source: Well, I've been governing my village these past few months!
target: 过去几个月我一直在管理我的村庄!

source: Your village?
target: 你的村子吗?

target: 确实如此 我一直坚持要姐妹们成为更好的凡德比尔特,所以他们想出了这个想法:

source: They gave me a small village within the borders of the Merkingdom to rule.
target: 他们给了我一个小村庄 在默金多姆的边界上统治。

source: Wow, that sounds like a big responsibility.
target: 哇,这听起来是一个重大的责任。

source: You're absolutely right, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. I want to be the best ruler ever, and that means learning some responsibility.
target: 你说的对 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我想成为有史以来最好的统治者, 这意味着学习一些责任。

target: 虽然. 班上每个人似乎都认为 默金多姆的方法 不像我一直相信的那样完美无缺

target: 我的反应是假设他们是无知的叛徒 皇冠必须面对绞刑架。

source: That's very sensible of you.

target: 当然 你看,我被遗忘 似乎是唯一的东西 我们的同学和我的姐妹都同意。

source: "Maybe stop the serfdom thing?"
target: "也许停止农奴制的事情?"

target: "通过不断的媒体宣传大量群众控制".

target: 特别是因为他们的统治者是我 米兰达 范德比尔特,所有统治者中最可爱的!

target: 人们真的喜欢这样吗?

source: We do that, yes.

source: ...Wait.
Isn't this... propaganda?

source: I can't help but admire Bellanda's military prowess, but she has trained herself not to get too personal when waging war.
target: 我不能不钦佩贝兰达的军事能干,但她训练自己在发动战争时不会变得过于个人化.

source: She sees an army, not the individuals who form its ranks.
target: 她看到一支军队,而不是组成军队的人。

source: And Laudanda? She's playing the most complex game of chess in which we all are her pawns... she'd never accept change unless it directly benefitted her or the Crown.
target: 劳丹达呢? 她在玩最复杂的一局棋 我们都是她的棋子... 她不会接受改变 除非它直接使她或王室受益

source: What about Miranda?
target: 怎么样 米兰达?

source: Miranda?
target: 米兰达?

source: Yes, think about it: she was sent to study in the Monster Realm, making her the one least influenced by the Vanderbilt ways.
target: 是的,想想看:她被派去"魔兽王国"学习,使她成为受"范德比尔特"方法影响最小的一位.

source: And I've heard that she's recently started to question the ways of the Merkingdom!
target: 我听说她最近开始质疑默金多姆的行踪!

source: ...Really?
target: ...真的吗?

source: It does make sense... she's obnoxious, but Miranda is undoubtedly charming and easy to love...
target: 这确实有道理... 她很讨厌,但是... 米兰达 无疑是迷人和容易相爱的...

source: ...BY THE MERPEOPLE, THAT IS.
target: ...亲爱的,这是。

source: See? It looks we have the seed of a plan for real change in the Merkingdom!
target: 看到没? 看来我们有 真正改变默金多姆的计划的种子了!

source: Indeed, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. We can't rush this... it's still a delicate plan that should be executed perfectly.
target: 确实 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 我们不能急着... 它仍然是一个微妙的计划 应该被完美地执行。

source: But I could bring this idea to the other people craving change down there.
target: 但我可以把这个想法带到其他人 渴望那里的变化。

source: I can't stress enough how grateful I am. Is there anything I can do for you?
target: 我实在是太感激了 有什么我可以帮你的吗?

source: Well, your company is more than enough, Adrien. Let's watch the night sky together, shall we?
target: 你的公司已经足够了 阿德里安 让我们一起看夜空吧?

source: I'd love that.
target: 我很乐意

source: And so you do. Adrien is full of hope and excitement. Change might not happen soon... but now, it looks more possible than ever before.
target: 所以,你这样做。 阿德里安充满了希望和兴奋. 变化可能不会很快发生... 但现在,它看起来比以往更可能。

source: Huzzah!
target: 万岁!

source: Um... but that would be... quite the sudden change.
target: 那个... 但是,这将是... 突然变了

source: The suddenest of changes!
target: 最突然的变化!

source: Yet I made it quite clear that sudden changes are not good, ultimately.
target: 然而,我非常明确地说,突然的改变最终并不好。

source: Oh, did you? I have a pretty short attention span.
target: 哦,是吗? 我有很短的注意力跨度。

source: ...Right.
target: 对

source: The thing is, if we execute the ones in power -- which is a tall order in and of itself... soon someone will crawl up to take their place, and nothing will change.
target: 问题是,如果我们执行那些掌权者——这本身就是一个很高的顺序—— 很快有人会爬上来取而代之 没有什么会改变的

source: Well...
target: 这个...

source: ...you could guillotine them too.
target: ...你也可以断了他们。

source: Sure. Then, following the same rationale, someone else would take their place.
target: 当然可以。 然后,按照同样的理由,其他人将取代他们。

source: Maybe, but then you guillotine them too!
target: 也许吧,但你也会断了他们的头!

source: And should we keep doing this ad infinitum, or...?
target: 我们应该继续做这个广告 无限,还是... ?

source: Until the Merkingdom is the fairest, most headless kingdom in the whole realm!
target: 直到默金多姆成为整个王国中最美丽,最无头的王国!

source: I trust you can see the inefficacy of your proposal, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 我相信你能看出 你的提议是无效的 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: I do... it's just that I really like guillotines.
target: 我确实... 只是我真的很喜欢断头台

source: I hear you; but it's still a bad idea.
target: 我听见了,但还是个坏主意

source: Not to mention, it's basically jumping straight to using the same tactics the Crown uses.
target: 更别提了,它基本上直接跳到使用与王室相同的战术.

source: I'm sure your intentions are good, but your advice is honestly terrible.
target: 我敢肯定,你的意图是好的, 但你的建议是真正的可怕的。

source: I must depart now... this conversation has reminded me of the urgency of my many ventures.
target: 我必须马上离开... 这次谈话让我想起我众多事业的迫切性.

source: Farewell, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. Keep trying your best to give actually useful advice.
target: 再见, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%. 继续尽力给出实际有用的建议.

source: Practice makes perfect!
target: 练习很完美!

source: Adrien leaves, heading toward his next quest. You wish him the best... but it still tastes a bit sour, being a failure and all.
target: 阿德里安离开,前往他的下个征程。 你祝他一切顺利... 但它的味道还是有点酸, 是一个失败和所有。

source: That sounds like giving up on the Merkingdom, though.
target: 这听起来就像放弃了默金多姆号。

source: It's not giving up! It's just re-locating your efforts to a more promising kingdom: Belgium.
target: 它不会放弃的! 它只是将你的努力重新投向一个更有希望的王国:比利时.

source: Is Belgium even a kingdom?
target: 比利时甚至是一个王国吗?

source: As in, having a monarchy and all...?
target: 就像,拥有君主制和所有...

source: It is! Belgium is a hereditary parliamentary constitutional monarchy.
target: 没错! 比利时是世袭的议会君主立宪制国家.

source: Fine, but still, I told you: I want to change my motherland for the better.
target: 好吧,但还是,我告诉你:我想把祖国改好。

source: I refuse to give up on the Merkingdom.
target: 我拒绝放弃默金多姆

source: But Belgium has tens of types of Belgian Waffles!
target: 但比利时有数十种比利时华夫饼!

source: BELGIAN WAFFLES, Adrien!
target: 贝吉安・瓦夫斯,阿德里安!

source: Yes, I hear you, and yet...
target: 是的,我听见了,然而...

source: Did you know Belgians invented French fries?
target: 你知道比利时人发明了薯条吗?

source: That can't be right.
target: 这不可能是正确。

source: I know. The name sounds very French, but Belgians claim they invented French fries.
target: 我知道,我记得 I know. 这个名字听起来很法式,但比利时人声称他们发明了法式薯条.

source: And I, for one, believe them.
target: 而我,作为一个,相信他们。

source: Stop, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 停下来 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: I was clear in my quest for change, and here you are, trying to seduce me with these factoids about Belgium.
target: 我对变革的追求很明确,而你在这里,试图用这些关于比利时的事实片来引诱我。

source: Who are you? My friend, or some sort of influencer sponsored by the Belgian department of tourism?
target: 你是谁? 我的朋友 还是比利时旅游部赞助的某种影响者?

source: I must depart now, before your Belgian spell manages to charm me.
target: 在你的比利时咒语迷上我之前 我必须马上离开

source: Adrien leaves... probably not to go to Belgium.
target: 阿德里安的叶子... 可能不是去比利时

source: Fuck. You lost his chivalrous company... and you won't get the commission money the Belgian department of tourism promised you.
target: 他妈的。 你失去了他的骑士陪伴... 比利时旅游部答应你,你拿不到佣金

source: Preparing for the Future
target: 筹备未来

source: Nah, Joy and Faith are the boring ones that do the planning and all that.
target: 不,乔伊和费斯是那些无聊的人 做计划 和这一切。

source: Me? I've died three times already; who says I won't die a fourth time next week?
target: 我吗? 我已经死了三次了 谁说我下星期不会第四次死了?

source: Yikes, Hope...
target: 哎哟,希望...

source: Hey, the facts speak for themselves!
target: 嘿,事实本身就说明了!

source: Well, still!
target: 好吧,还是!

source: Still?
target: 还是?

source: I mean... I don't want to sound morbid: but what if you DO die soon? Have you planned for that?
target: 我是说... 我不想听病态,但如果你死了呢? 你计划好了吗?

source: Dang, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! I didn't know you were this hardcore!
target: 该死 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%! 我没想到你这么厉害!

source: Oh, sorry, I didn't want to overstep.
target: 哦,对不起,我不想越位。

source: Don't sweat it... you're not wrong.
target: 不要发汗... 你没有错。

source: I have this funny habit of dying, and it'd be very cool if I could leave something to the next Hope so she doesn't feel so lost or unready...
target: 我有一个可笑的死亡习惯, 如果我能留下一些东西给下一个希望,这样她就不会觉得迷茫或没有准备好... ...

source: Whoa, that's a bit dark.
target: 哇,这有点黑。

source: Dark, but necessary... but I'm still an awful planner...
target: 黑暗,但必须... 但我还是个糟糕的策划者...

source: But hey, you brought us here, so now you'll help me with this, right?
target: 但是,嘿,你把我们带到这里, 所以现在你会帮助我 这一点,对不对?

source: If that's what you want, I'm game.
target: 如果你想这样,我就是游戏。

source: That's the spirit!
target: 这就是精神!

source: It must be something actually useful, as in no sentimental bullshit.
target: 这一定是一些实际有用的东西, 像在没有多愁善感的废话。

source: I want to help this hypothetical Hope... but at the same time it's a bit about me, y'know?
target: 我想帮助这个假想的希望... 但与此同时,它有点 关于我,你知道吗?

source: How so?
target: 怎么会这样?

source: Well, this Hope will still be Hope. She will represent all of us Hopes!
target: 嗯,这个希望仍然是希望。 她会代表我们所有人的希望!

source: I worked too hard and kicked too much ass only for an uncool gal to mess that up.
target: 我太努力了 踢了太多的屁股 只为了一个不酷的女孩来搅乱这一切

source: So my legacy should be a powerful message from beyond that tells the new Hope: "you'd better be cool".
target: 因此,我的遗产应该是一个来自外部的强大信息,它告诉新的希望:"你最好冷静".

source: Dang, who's the hardcore one now?
target: 赣瞷琌街

source: I was born hardcore; I will die hardcore... and my next me should be hardcore too.
target: 我生来就是硬核 我会死活的... 我的下一个我也应该是硬核。

source: The question is: are you truly hardcore enough?
target: 问题是:你真的够狠吗?

source: You brought up this weird topic, so it's time to put your money where your mouth is: gimme your best idea, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.
target: 你提起这个怪事 所以是时候把你的钱放在嘴边了 给我你最好的主意 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%.

source: Your iconic shoes, so she can learn to... walk in your shoes.
target: 你的标志性鞋, 这样她可以学会... 穿着你的鞋走。

source: Never trust anyone to be as cool as you... not even future you! Write a comprehensive style-book on the Hope brand.
target: 永远不要相信任何人 像你一样酷... 甚至没有未来你! 在"希望"品牌上写出全面的风格手册.

source: A bag of fortune cookies with mysterious nonsensical fortunes... just to fuck with her.
target: 一袋幸运饼干 有神秘的无意识的财富... 只是想他妈的她。

source: Wow...
That's like... super corny.
target: 这就像... 超级古老。

source: Which is a good thing?
target: 哪个是好事?

source: Nah.
target: 没有。

source: Aside from the fact that it's a cheesy-AF motivational quote...
target: 除此外,这是一首俗取-AF动机的引文. .

source: ...the "metaphor" doesn't even hold.
target: ..."美塔克"甚至无法维持。

source: Like, as charming as it sounds (which isn't much anyway), it actually means nothing.
target: 就像,虽然听起来很迷人(反正也没什么大不了的),但实际上毫无意义。

source: I am effectively just leaving her some shoes.
target: 我只是给她留了几双鞋

source: I don't know, it sounded smart in my head.
target: 我不知道,这听起来很聪明在我的头上。

source: Well, it sure didn't sound smart when it got out of your head, pal.
target: 好吧,这听起来并不聪明 当它从你的脑子里出来,伙计。

source: But hey, you tried!
target: 但是,嘿,你试图!

source: Here, have this.
target: 来,拿着这个

source: She puts something on your forehead and leaves into the dark of the night.
target: 她把东西放在你的前额上, 离开进入黑夜。

source: When you check the thingie, it turns out to be a sticker depicting a smiling Hope saying "you tried!"
target: 当你检查这个东西, 发现它是一个贴纸 描绘一个微笑的希望说 "你试过了!"

source: You're onto something here.
target: 你发现什么了

source: I am indeed very cool... maybe so cool that not even future me can match my coolness.
target: 我确实很酷... 可能太酷了,甚至未来我都不能满足我的酷。

source: It's a craft refined over the last four lifetimes.
target: 这是过去四生以来精炼出的一种工艺.

source: I can't risk the next Hope not taking on my coolness and having to start all over again.
target: 我不能冒下一个希望的险 不采取我的冷静 和不得不重新开始。

source: She should continue this saga of cool Hopes, starting where I left off.
target: 她应该继续这种酷酷的希望 从我离开的地方开始

source: Yeah, it's like they say: "on the shoulders of giants".
target: 是啊,就像他们说:"在巨人的肩膀上"。

source: Except, I guess this giant is just four Hopes, one on top of the other.
target: 除了,我想这个巨人只是四个希望, 一个在另一个之上。

source: Which, you must admit, sounds like a pretty cool giant.
target: 你必须承认 听起来是个很酷的巨人

source: It does, yes.
target: 没错,是的。

source: Look, I know this all sounds a bit silly, but for real:
target: 听着,我知道这听起来有点傻, 但实际上:

source: It's frustrating to know I could die soon while fighting evil, and everything I built could suddenly turn into nothing.
target: 令人沮丧的是,我知道在与邪恶作斗争时,我可以很快地死去,而我所建造的一切却会突然变成一无所有.

source: I made my peace with that when I joined the Coven. It is what it is.
target: 我加入巫师团时就和他讲和了 这是它是什么。

source: But if I could pass the baton, so to speak...
target: 但是,如果我能通过 警棍,所以说...

source: ...at least it wouldn't feel like building a house of cards only for a gust of wind to blow it all away forever.
target: ...至少它不会觉得 仅仅为了一阵风来盖一栋牌楼 来永远把它吹走。

source: Yeah, I get it. I think we all want to leave this Earth feeling like we left something behind.
target: 对,我懂了 我想我们都想离开这个地球 就像我们留下了东西一样

source: Yes, like a style-book on the Hope brand.
target: 是的,就像一本关于"希望"品牌的风格书

source: Goddess forbid the next Hope even consider wearing something that's not black or black-adjacent.
target: 女神禁止下一个"希望"甚至考虑穿一件不是黑色或黑色相邻的东西.

source: The horror!
target: 恐怖! 恐惧! 恐怖!

source: Right?
target: 对吧?

source: You spend the night writing a first draft of the style-book. It's a bonding experience that teaches you what Hope holds most dear about her own identity.
target: 你整晚都在写一本风格书的初稿 这是一种亲身经历 教会你希望最珍惜的 关于她自己的身份。

source: ...Why?
target: 为什么?

source: It'd be fun!
target: 会很有趣的!

source: Except it wouldn't?
target: 除了它不会吗?

source: Also, what's the point at all?
target: 还有,有什么意义呢?

source: I want to leave some legacy to help future me...
target: 我想留下一些遗产 来帮助未来我...

source: ...not some random fortunes to prank her.
target: ...不是随便找点钱来骗她

source: One could say "beware of that which is blue".
target: 人们可以说"注意蓝色的"

source: She wouldn't know what the fuck this "blue danger" is, and she'd get frightened by all things blue!
target: 她不会知道这他妈的什么是"蓝色危险", 她会因为一切被蓝色所吓倒!

source: Oh, and another one could say "NEVER VISIT FRANCE".
target: 哦,还有一个可以说 "NEVERVISIT FRANCE"。

source: And she would be all like, "but why?", and maybe she was planning a trip to France, but then she wouldn't be so sure about it.
target: 她会想,“为什么呢?” 也许她计划去法国, 但是她不会这么确定。

source: Believe me, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, all of this is way less funny than you think.
target: 相信我,%CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, 所有这一切 比你想象的有趣。

source: It's just dumb... and a bit annoying when I'm a fortune teller myself.
target: 这太蠢了... 有点烦 当我自己是算命的。

source: Oh, right. Then I guess the prank wouldn't work.
target: 哦,没错。 那我猜恶作剧是行不通的

source: It wouldn't, no.
target: 不会的,不会的。

source: And... wait... I am having a vision of the future.
target: 还有... 单单... 我对未来有远见。

source: It's me... and I'm at risk... if I stay here any longer... I'm in danger... of listening to more of your dumb ideas.
target: 是我... 我... 我... 我... 我... 我... 我身处险境... 如果我再呆在这里... 我有危险... 倾听你更多愚蠢的想法。

source: Dang, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... I can't take that risk. I'm sure you understand.
target: 该死 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... 我不能冒这个险。 我敢肯定,你明白这一点。

source: Bye.
target: 再见。

source: She leaves into the dark of the night.
target: 她走入了黑暗的夜晚。

source: She was probably not wrong, as you had a couple more ideas for what the fortune cookies could say.
target: 她可能没说错,因为你对幸运饼干有什么想法。

source: His Boss
target: 他的老爷

source: Oof, Mr. Pappas...
target: 哦,先生。 。 。 。 帕帕斯 帕帕斯 帕帕斯 帕帕斯 帕帕斯

source: Not a fan, huh?
target: 不是粉丝,是吧?

source: He makes me carry him on a big-ass throne; you tell me.
target: 他让我把他抬上大宝座,你告诉我。

source: Being the personal assistant for a good boss would be a dream come true.
target: 做一个好老板的私人助手 梦想成真了

source: Not for a deranged man who's obsessed with shopping malls.
target: 对一个痴迷于购物中心的人来说不是

source: I'm sure there's a better boss out there for you. You'll meet them one day...
target: 我敢肯定,有一个更好的老板 在那里为你。 有一天你会见到他们...

source: ...and you'll be a boss/personal assistant match made in heaven!
target: ...你会成为上司/私人助理的配角!

source: In the meantime... Mr. Pappas it is...
target: 同时... 劳伦斯先生 帕帕斯,这是...

source: He might be the worst boss of all time.
target: 他可能是有史以来最糟糕的老板

source: Always busting my balls with the dumbest, most useless tasks...
target: 总是用最笨,最没用的任务来打我的蛋蛋...

source: Hmmm... can't you bust his balls in return? Even a bit?
target: 那个... 你不能打碎他的蛋蛋作为回报吗? 甚至一点点?

source: I don't want to have anything to do with his balls!
target: 我不想跟他的蛋蛋有任何关系!

source: Nah, I meant like pulling some sort of prank on him.
target: 不,我的意思是像 对他进行某种恶作剧。

source: A prank you say... that's not a half-bad idea...
target: 你说的恶作剧... 这不是一个半坏主意...

source: Yes! Something big enough that you can find some solace in knowing you had your payback.
target: 没错! 足够大的东西,你可以找到一些安慰 知道你得到了你的回报。

source: Yes... yes... and yet not so big that it's outright absurd or makes me invest too much into it...
target: 对... 对... 也没那么大 简直太荒谬了 或者让我投资太多...

source: The perfect prank balance!
target: 完美的恶作剧平衡!

source: (If only Polly and Scott aimed for that...)
target: (如果仅限 波莉 财务报告和审定财务报表 斯科特 目标在那... )

source: Well, I think I can give this idea of yours a chance...
target: 好吧,我想我可以给你这个想法一个机会...

source: Let's just make sure the prank can't be tracked back to me, so I don't get fired!
target: 让我们确保恶作剧不能被追踪到我身上,这样我就不会被解雇了!

source: Right! Haha! No pressure at all!
target: 没错! 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 哈哈! 一点压力都没有!

source: So, what should this prank be?
target: 那么,这个恶作剧应该是什么?

target: 你也许是对的。

source: Such a weak idea... you're fired!
target: 这么弱的主意... 你被开除了!

source: She throws herself at you. It knocks you down because, you know, she's a big-ass washing machine.
target: 她朝你扔东西 它把你打倒,因为,你知道, 她是一个大屁股洗衣机。

source: When you recover your consciousness, she's left, probably disappointed by you. Sigh.
target: 当你恢复意识时 她就离开了 也许对你很失望 叹曰.

source: Oh, no! Not a heavily-condimented hot dog!
target: 哦,没有! 不是严重受损的热狗!

source: They lure you with their many delicious toppings... but in reality, they're a stain tragedy waiting to happen.
target: 他们用很多美味的上衣来引诱你... 但实际上,他们是一个污点 悲剧等待着发生。

source: When you eat one, it's almost as if you can hear your shirt crying for its life.
target: 当你吃到一个, 它几乎可以听到你的衬衫哭喊它的生命。

source: It's twelve different kinds of stain held together by two weak buns in what might be one of the most unreliable bread architectures out there.
target: 这是12种不同的污点 由两个弱小的面包包粘在一起 可能是最不可靠的面包建筑之一

source: Dahlia, you're describing it like that, and I'm already craving a big hot dog...
target: 达莉娅你这样形容我,我已经在想一条大热狗了...

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%, no!
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%不,没有!

source: I'd shove it in my mouth, as if there were no tomorrow...
target: 我会把它塞进我嘴里, 仿佛没有明天...

source: With lots of mustard and ketchup...
target: 有很多芥末和番茄酱...

source: Nooooo!
target: 不许!

source: And some melted cheese...
target: 还有一些被融化了的起司...

source: No! Not the melted cheese!
target: 没有! 不是被熔化了的起司!

source: And lots of caramelized onions...
target: 和很多焦糖洋葱...

source: You've gone mad...
target: 你疯了...

source: And some pickled jalapeños... and chili too!
target: 和一些腌取的鸡尾酒... 还有辣椒!

source: It's okay, Dahlia. I don't fear for my life, because I know you'll have my back.
target: 没关系 达莉娅. 我不怕我的生命 因为我知道你们会支持我

source: Always.
target: 永远

source: But yeah, you've fully convinced me: a heavily-condimented hot dog sounds like a dreadful foe.
target: 但是,你已经完全说服了我: 一个严重受损的热狗听起来就像一个可怕的敌人。

source: If I'm a washing machine, that delicious devil is surely a staining machine... and a worthy rival.
target: 如果我是洗衣机 那美味的魔鬼肯定就是一出污秽的机器... 和一个值得称道的对手

source: Is this a new character arc I'm seeing?
target: 这是新角色弧吗?

source: Maybe, %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... maybe.
target: 也许吧 %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... 也许吧。

source: You two spend the rest of the night brainstorming the most obscene hot dog that any mind has ever conceived.
target: 你们俩彻夜集思广益 最下流的热狗 任何头脑都想不出来。

source: It's so over-the-top that it would probably be deemed illegal in some countries. Yum!
target: 这太过头了 很可能在某些国家被认为是非法的 汤!

source: What did you just do?
target: 你刚才做了什么?

source: Nothing...
target: 没什么...

source: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... was that... an attempt at a tackle?
target: %CURRENTPLAYERNAME%... 那个... 尝试去钓鱼?

source: ...Maybe.
target: 也许吧

source: Pfft... you silly bastard!
target: 额... 你这个傻逼混蛋!

source: That right there proves you would be no match for me!
target: 那证明你跟我不配!

source: Even less so in my new, more powerful form!
target: 更别提我这种新的更强大的形式了!

source: I don't know... I could surprise you, eventually.
target: 我不知道... 我不知道... 我不知道,这是什么? 我最终会给你惊喜的

source: I doubt it!
target: 我不这么认为!

source: That was cute in a way, but hella weak!
target: 这在某种意义上是可爱的, 但地狱的软弱!

source: Here, let me show you how a tackle looks like!
target: 在这里,让我告诉你 如何一个钩子看起来像!

source: But it's too late: she tackles you.
target: 但是现在太晚了,她要对付你

source: And since she's basically a washing machine, "tackling you" means she hurls herself upon you.
target: 既然她基本上是个洗衣机,"打你"就意味着她朝你扔了自己.

source: Have you ever had a big-ass washing machine thrown at you? It isn't pleasant.
target: 你曾经有过一个大屁股的洗衣机扔给你吗? 这太不愉快了

source: Hours later, when you finally recover your consciousness, she's gone.
target: 几小时后,当你终于恢复了意识,她就走了.

source: She probably left in search of a worthy rival... who will most definitely not be you. Ouch.
target: 她可能为了寻找一个值得称道的对手而离开... 谁肯定不会是你。 哎哟。

source: Nobody shows up. You sit in silence, wondering if you have been out here way too long.
target: 没有人出现。 你静静地坐着 不知道你是否在这里待了太久了

source: This should not appear. Fake event to trigger specific pc event.
target: 这不应该出现。 触发特定 pc 事件的假事件 。

source: This is strange, bros... where is everyone?
target: 这很奇怪,兄弟... 每个人都在哪里?

source: Huh, weird.
target: 怪怪的 怪怪的 怪怪的

source: Noodles isn't even here! What happened to that little bro?
target: 面条甚至不在这里! 那个小兄弟怎么了?

source: There's something about this place that's giving me the creeps.
target: 这个地方有些东西让我毛骨悚然.

source: Let's just sleep in the car and call it a night, yeah?
target: 我们睡在车里吧 今晚就到此为止 好吗?

source: Gotcha!
target: 抓到他们了!

source: You spend the night crammed in the car together.
target: 你整晚都挤在车里

source: Something is off.
target: 有点不对劲

source: This is strange, bros... where is everyone?
target: 这很奇怪,兄弟... 每个人都在哪里?

source: Huh, weird.
target: 怪怪的 怪怪的 怪怪的

source: Noodles isn't even here! What happened to that little bro?
target: 面条甚至不在这里! 那个小兄弟怎么了?

source: Wait... and where's %LASTHITCHHIKER%?
target: 单单... 和哪里来的 %LASTHITCHHIKER%?

source: %LASTHITCHHIKER%? What do you mean?
target: %LASTHITCHHIKER%? 你说什么?

source: We picked up %LASTHITCHHIKER%, remember?
target: 我们接了 %LASTHITCHHIKER%记得吗?

source: Uhm, no. I'm pretty sure we've been by ourselves for a while now.
target: 呃,没有。 我敢肯定,我们 已经一个人一段时间了。

source: Hmmm... you might be right.
target: 那个... 你也许是对的。

source: Regardless, there's something about this place that's giving me the creeps.
target: 不管怎么样,这个地方有些东西 让我毛骨悚然。

source: Let's just sleep in the car and call it a night, yeah?
target: 我们睡在车里吧 今晚就到此为止 好吗?

source: Gotcha!
target: 抓到他们了!

source: You spend the night crammed in the car together.
target: 你整晚都挤在车里

source: Something is off.
target: 有点不对劲

source: Finally! A rest stop! I need to lie down for a bit. These last few days have been intense.
target: 终于来了! 一个休息站! 我需要躺一会 这几天很紧张

source: Empty? Again?
target: 空的吗? 又来了?

source: What if we turn around? We might just be going in the wrong direction.
target: 如果我们转身呢? 我们可能走错方向了

source: I don't know, buddy. Maybe we can't find another place that's less... fucked-up.
target: 我不知道,伙计。 也许我们找不到别的地方了... 胡说八道

source: But if we turn back? We know for sure that there's a bunch of fucked-up places waiting for us.
target: 但如果我们回头呢? 我们肯定有一堆鬼地方等着我们

source: That's true...
target: 这是真的...

source: I don't know if I can take another round of visiting those places all over again.
target: 我不知道我能不能再去一次那些地方

source: But what if we're like... like, in the eye of a storm, Polly? What if all the paths we can take are wrong choices?
target: 但如果我们像... 就像,在暴风雨中, 波莉? 如果我们能走的路都是错误的选择呢?

source: ...Let's cross our fingers and hope that's not the case, Scott.
target: ...... 让我们交叉我们的手指 希望不是这样, 斯科特.

source: Well, you know what? Even if it is, at least we're together, bros!
target: 你知道吗? 就算是,至少我们在一起,兄弟!

source: Yeah, you're right.
target: 是啊,你说得对。

source: (Let's just hope we're not in the eye of a fucking storm...)
target: (让我们只是希望我们不是 在他妈的风暴的眼睛... )

source: So, should we keep driving forward, then?
target: 那么,我们应该继续前进吗?

source: Hmmm... yeah, let's do that.
target: 那个... 是啊,让我们做到这一点。

source: Perfect! Better get some rest, then!
target: 完美无缺! 那就好好休息一会吧!

source: Yes. Tomorrow might be a long day.
target: 对 明天可能会是漫长的一天。

source: And so you all go to sleep. You try not to think too much about all this.
target: 所以你们都去睡觉了 你尽量不要想太多这一切。

source: Why is all this happening...?
target: 为什么这一切发生... ?

source: Well, you're only supposed to drive until you either lose or reach a Destination. But you're not doing either this time.
target: 好吧,你只应该开车 直到你要么失去 要么到达目的地。 但这次你也没做

source: We didn't count on you going for longer than eight weeks or so.
target: 我们没有指望你走 超过8周左右。

source: So, I imagine the game is starting to malfunction because you're pushing it to its limits.
target: 所以,我想这个游戏开始出故障了 因为你把它推到了极限。

source: ...Game?
target: 盖姆?

source: Ah, yes: this is all a game.
target: 啊,是的,这是一场游戏。

source: I guess there's no point in hiding it now. You've come to this very same realization yourself a few times in the past.
target: 我想现在藏起来没有意义了 你过去也去过很多次这样的觉悟。

source: It always disrupts things a bit...
target: 它总是打乱事物 一点点...

source: What...?
Sorry... this is probably a tad overwhelming.
target: 对不起... 这可能是一个微弱的压倒性。

source: Normally, the loop ends and resets, and everything goes back to normal.
target: 通常,循环会结束和重回,一切会恢复正常.

source: The problem now is that you're not ending the loop. Some other loops have even been created by these errors, and they are now overlapping with this one.
target: 现在的问题是,你没有结束循环。 还有一些循环甚至被这些错误所创造,现在它们与这个循环重叠了.

source: You're overtaxing the system, and the malfunctions are spreading exponentially.
target: 你对系统征税过重 故障成倍地扩散

source: I don't know: fuck up your resources, reach a Destination...
target: 我不知道 浪费你的资源 到达目的地...

source: Just end the loop, okay?
target: 停止循环,好吗?

source: So, if this is a game...
target: 所以,如果这是个游戏...

source: Does that mean you are...?
target: 也就是说你是... ?

source: Yes.
target: 对

source: And we just keep going on the road trip in repeating loops...?
target: 我们只是继续 道路旅行 重复循环?

source: Yes, you do.
target: 是的,你这样做。

source: What's the point of everything? Why...?
target: 何等为一切相. 为什么... ?

source: ...I don't even know where to start.
target: 我甚至不知道从哪里开始。

source: It's okay.
target: 没关系。

source: I can imagine this is a lot to take in.
target: 我可以想象,这是很多需要接受的。

source: At least the road trip has been nice, hasn't it?
target: 至少这趟公路旅行很愉快,不是吗?

source: (Up until it all went to shit...)
target: (直到一切都变得一团糟... )

source: Yeah, we tried to make it nice... chaotic, but in a fun way. Good memories, you know?
target: 是啊,我们试图让它好起来... ... 混乱,但以有趣的方式。 美好的回忆,你知道吗?

source: Yeah. Good memories...
target: 对 美好的回忆...

source: The sky looks nice tonight, doesn't it?
target: 天空看起来不错 今晚,不是吗?

source: I guess it does, yeah...
target: 我想是这样,是的...

source: What's happening to Scott?
target: 发生什么事了? 斯科特?

source: Hmmm... it's hard to tell.
target: 那个... 很难说

source: The system is using most of its processing power to deal with all of these malfunctions.
target: 该系统正在利用其大部分的处理能力来处理所有这些故障.

source: My guess is Scott is subconsciously forfeiting most of his internal processes so the system can deal with this whole mess.
target: 我猜是这样的 斯科特 潜意识中放弃了他的大部分内部程序 所以系统可以处理这整个混乱。

source: He truly is a good boy, isn't he?
target: 他真的是个好孩子,不是吗?

source: Yeah, that's Scott for you.
target: 是啊,这是 斯科特 为你。

source: But as a result, he might be running his core processes and character cornerstones only...
target: 但结果,他可能只管理着他的核心过程和人物基石. .

source: ...becoming the simplest expression of what Scott is meant to be.
target: 成为最简单的表达什么 斯科特 这是注定的。

source: Character cornerstones?
target: 人物基石吗?

source: Well, characters are a complex thing. You develop one cornerstone first... a sort of thematic pillar. Then you build a few more...
target: 人物是一件复杂的事情。 先开发出一个基石... 某种主题支柱。 然后再建几个...

source: ...then it's a snowball effect: the character starts to get fleshed out from all those pillars.
target: ...然后是雪球效应: 角色开始从这些柱子上取出肉.

source: And thus, Scott is slowly regressing to his main cornerstone.
target: 因此, 斯科特 他正在慢慢地倒退到他的主要基石。

source: What would that be?
target: 那会是什么?

source: I guess you'll find out if you all keep going.
target: 我猜你们会发现你们是否继续走下去的

source: Is he in danger, or...?
target: 他有危险吗 还是... ?

source: No. I'm quite sure things will go back to normal once we solve all this malfunctioning.
target: 没有。 我敢肯定,一旦我们解决了这些故障,事情就会恢复正常。

source: But you all need to end the loop, Polly.
target: 但是你们都需要结束循环 波莉.

source: Have you looked at that? What the fuck is it?
target: 你看过吗? 什么他妈的是什么?

source: The system is cannibalizing itself, it seems.
target: 看来这个系统正在吞噬自己

source: It's doing all kinds of somersaults to avoid completely imploding.
target: 它在做各种活塞来避免被完全冲出.

source: It looks intense; almost beautiful.
target: 它看起来很强烈,几乎很美。

source: It looks dangerous, and imminent. You have to end the loop.
target: 它看起来危险, 和迫在眉睫。 你必须结束循环。

source: That sanctuary was fucked up, man.
target: 那个避难所被搞砸了,伙计。

source: All my suffering is... what? A narrative device? My character's cornerstone? A twist?
target: 我所有的痛苦是... 什麽? 叙事装置? 我的角色的基石? 扭来扭去?

source: Not exactly.
target: 不尽然。

source: The way I wrote you, your tragedy isn't supposed to be your cornerstone, Polly.
target: 我写你的方式, 你的悲剧不应该是你的基石, 波莉.

source: If anything, it's what comes next: how you always choose to embrace life, no matter what curveball it throws you.
target: 如果有的话,这就是接下来的结局: 你总是选择拥抱生命, 无论它扔给你什么曲线球。

source: First of all: cheesy.
target: 先曰:俗也. 师曰.

source: Second: it's all nice and positive; but it still stings when you're on my end.
target: 第二:都是好和正的;但当你在我身后时仍然会刺痛.

source: I'm not arguing with that. But you know conflict is also part of fiction.
target: 我不是在争论这一点。 但你知道冲突也是虚构的一部分。

source: Why are we even arguing, anyway? What's the point of these conversations when this is all just code and script?
target: 我们为什么要争吵呢? 当这一切只是代码和脚本时,这些对话有什么意义?

source: Look, I'm not gonna pretend there isn't a script behind all this. There is one.
target: 听着 我不会假装这一切背后没有剧本 有一个。

source: But when you create a character, it soon grows past its cornerstones. It's almost as if you set them free.
target: 但是当你创造了一个角色,它很快就会超越它的基石. 这几乎就像你放他们自由。

source: Yes, I do write your words; but while writing you, I also wonder to myself, "What would Polly do? What would she say?"
target: 是的,我确实写了你的话;但是,在写你的时候,我也在想: 波莉 怎么样? 她会说什么?"

source: It's like an object you've set into motion, you know?
target: 这就像一个物体 你已经启动,你知道吗?

source: Once it's moving, you're not necessarily applying force anymore, and yet they keep moving.
target: 一旦它动了,你不一定再施用武力了,然而他们却不停地动.

source: I can imagine where you may be headed, but ultimately I don't entirely know.
target: 我可以想象你可能要去哪里, 但最终我并不完全知道。

source: Like... a road trip where you don't know what destination you're headed for.
target: 喜欢... 公路旅行,在那里你不知道 你要去的目的地。

source: Oh, shut up!
target: 哦,闭嘴!

source: My point is you can be fictional and still, in a way, be real.
target: 我的观点是,你可以虚构 并且,在某种程度上,仍然是真实的。

source: You're made of pieces of myself and people I love. Traits, beliefs, anecdotes...
target: 你由我和我爱的人组成 特质、信仰、传闻...

source: I've seen the sun rise after a party, and for a moment I set all my worries aside and just thought, "Fuck, life's good."
target: 我看过一个聚会后太阳会升起, 有一瞬间,我把所有的忧虑放在一边, 只想,"他妈的,生活是好的"。

source: And that's you.
target: 这就是你。

source: Now people will get to meet you, and I wish... I trust that some people will look at life differently thanks to you.
target: 现在人们会来见你 我希望... 我相信,有些人会 以不同的眼光看待生活 感谢你。

source: That effect will be very real.
target: 这种效果将是非常真实的。

source: I wanna think that after this, there's a Polly who stays in these stories: having misadventures and creating more good memories.
target: 我想想,在这之后,有一个 波莉 他们留在这些故事中: 错误的冒险和创造更多的好回忆。

source: But there's another Polly, one that goes beyond the story, beyond the game: the Polly that stays in motion even after I'm gone.
target: 但还有另一个 波莉超越故事,超越游戏: 波莉 即使在我走了之后 仍然保持运动状态

source: You asked why we have these conversations.
target: 你问为什么我们有这些谈话。

source: To me? I think these conversations are about reflecting on the meaning and purpose of the characters I create; where they come from and where they go.
target: 对我? 我认为这些对话是关于思考我创造的人物的意义和目的;他们来自何处和去向.

source: To you? I sincerely don't know.
target: 对你? 我诚心不知.

source: I'm sorry I can't give you better answers.
target: 对不起,我不能给你更好的答案。

source: To the Polly who will stay, I can only do my best to write you faithfully and with care.
target: 给 波莉 我只能尽我所能 忠实和小心地写信给你

source: To the Polly who will go... wherever you go, I'll be rooting for you.
target: 给 波莉 谁会去... 无论你去哪,我都会为你加油的
